paper.title: Numeracy in Large Language Models: Fundamental Limitations and Paths to Improvement
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong results on mathematical reasoning benchmarks yet remain unreliable on elementary numerical tasks, including magnitude comparison, large-integer arithmetic, fractions, and scientific notation. This survey examines basic numerical understanding as a capability distinct from high-level mathematical reasoning. We propose the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF), which decomposes numeracy into Representational Grounding (RG), mapping numeral forms to value,

summary.core_problem: 现有前沿LLM在高阶数学推理任务上表现接近人类水平，但在最基础的数值任务（大数量级比较、大整数加法、基础分数运算、科学计数法操作）上存在系统性失效。已有研究多将这类问题归为高阶数学推理能力不足的附属表现，未将基础数感作为独立研究对象，缺乏统一分析框架区分基础数感与高阶数学推理，也没有系统梳理数感失效的模式、根因与改进路径。
summary.importance: 数感缺陷的根源来自预训练阶段的基础设计选择，包括tokenizer构造、训练数据中的数值表示方式、模型原生的算法执行能力，这些问题无法仅靠SFT/RL阶段刷高阶数学benchmark解决。提出的二维接地框架可以帮助研究者在改进定量能力时，区分是表示层缺陷还是过程层缺陷，避免干预方向错位——只针对高阶推理做优化，却没有修复底层数值处理的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出数值接地框架（Numerical Grounding Framework, NGF），将数值能力拆解为两个正交维度：表示接地（Representational Grounding, RG），即数字表面形式到内部表示的映射能可靠保留序关系、量级大小、不同格式的等价性；过程接地（Procedural Grounding, PG），即算术操作的执行过程与输出符合数学定义。基于该框架，工作系统梳理了8个与LLM数感相关的研究方向，整理了评测体系从GSM8K、MATH这类饱和的高阶数学基准，向NumericBench、Number Cookbook、GSM-Symbolic等新一代诊断性数值基准演进的脉络，将典型数值失效归为四类：对问题表面表述的脆弱性、Tokenizer引入的伪影、长度泛化失败、算法不对称性，并逐类对应分析架构、数据、训练流程层面的根因与已验证的缓解方案。
summary.experiments: 作为综述类工作，未开展新的大规模模型训练实验，核心贡献是对现有实证结果做结构化整合：已公开的测试显示，前沿模型会稳定出现9.11>9.9这类基础量级比较错误，大整数加法精度随数字位数增加快速下跌，基础数感能力随模型规模的scaling效应极弱——参数规模增长不会自然带来基础数值处理能力的可靠提升。现有干预手段中，调整数字的tokenization策略、显式构建数值内部表示、过程监督对过程接地类失效有可测量的改善，但表示接地类失效目前尚无通用解决方案。
summary.reading_guide: 该工作为综述体裁，无需逐字通读。重点关注第3章的NGF框架定义、失效模式分类，以及根因与改进方案的映射关系，核心内容约1小时可读完。无需花费时间在罗列相关工作的部分，重点关注其中提到的Tokenizer对数字的拆分影响、基础数感不随模型规模有效scaling的实证结论，这些内容对预训练阶段的tokenizer设计、数据构造有直接参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: Frontier LLMs achieve near-human performance on high-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks but systematically fail on elementary numerical tasks including magnitude comparison, large-integer addition, fraction arithmetic, and scientific notation operations. Existing work treats these failures as secondary side effects of poor general mathematical reasoning, and does not treat basic numeracy as a distinct research object. No unified analytical framework exists to separate basic numeracy from high-level mathematical cognition, or to systematically map failure modes, root causes, and mitigation paths.
summary_en.importance: These numeracy failures trace back to fundamental pretrain design choices including tokenizer construction, numeric representation in training data, and the model's native capacity for algorithmic execution—issues that cannot be resolved by post-training on advanced math benchmarks alone. The proposed two-dimensional grounding framework helps researchers disentangle representational flaws from procedural flaws when improving quantitative capability, avoiding misaligned interventions that target high-level reasoning while leaving primitive numeric processing unaddressed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF), which decomposes numeric competence into two orthogonal dimensions: Representational Grounding (RG), the faithful mapping from surface numeral forms to internal representations that preserve ordering, magnitude, and format equivalence; and Procedural Grounding (PG), the faithful execution of arithmetic procedures consistent with formal mathematical definitions. Using NGF as an organizing lens, the work synthesizes eight related research strands, traces the evaluation shift from saturated high-level math benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH) to new diagnostic numeracy benchmarks (NumericBench, Number Cookbook, GSM-Symbolic, etc.), categorizes numeracy failures into four classes (fragility to surface phrasing, tokenization artifacts, length generalization failure, algorithmic asymmetry), and maps each failure class to architectural, data, and training root causes alongside documented mitigation strategies.
summary_en.experiments: As a research synthesis, the work does not report new large-scale model training results. It consolidates existing empirical findings: frontier models routinely produce magnitude comparison errors such as claiming 9.11 > 9.9, large-integer addition accuracy degrades rapidly with digit length, and basic numeracy exhibits very weak scaling with model size—increasing parameter count does not reliably improve primitive numeric processing. Among documented interventions, adjusted numeric tokenization, explicit internal numeric representations, and process supervision show measurable effects on PG failures, while no general solution exists for RG failures.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a structured review; close line-by-line reading is not required. Focus on the NGF definition, failure mode taxonomy, and the mapping between root causes and mitigation strategies in Section 3. Core content can be covered in roughly one hour. Skip exhaustive listings of tangentially related work, and pay specific attention to documented effects of tokenizer digit splitting and the weak scaling of basic numeracy, as these carry direct implications for pretraining data and tokenizer design.

recommendation.zh: 把数值能力拆解为表征接地和过程接地两个维度，覆盖tokenizer、预训练数据分布的影响，做预训练数据或tokenizer设计的重点看§3的NGF框架和失败模式梳理。
recommendation.en: Decomposes numeracy into representational and procedural grounding, covering tokenizer and pretraining data distribution effects. Teams working on pretraining data or tokenizer design should focus on §3 for the NGF framework and failure mode review.

paper.title: Epiplexity Guided Data Selection and Generation for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
paper.abstract: Modern systems are increasingly expected to transfer across tasks not specified during training. What data facilitates generalization in these new, unanticipated settings? One hypothesis is that data with more structural information could contain shared circuits and subprograms that could be recycled in a wider array of downstream settings. Epiplexity, a recently proposed measure of the structural information a compute-bounded learner can extract from data, provides a mechanism to reason about t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想解决一个数据选择问题：如果目标是提升未预先指定任务上的 OOD 泛化，应该选择什么数据，而不是只按领域、质量分或去重规则做经验混合。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发在于，它把“有用数据”从静态质量判断转成了训练过程中的可学习结构信号。epiplexity 不是简单的信息量，也不是 loss 高低；它关注模型在训练中能否持续从数据里提取结构。这个视角对数据受限、多 epoch 训练、合成数据生成都有意义。不过目前更像一个可操作化的数据信号原型，贡献量级主要在方法和诊断框架，而不是已经给出大规模预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 论文围绕 epiplexity 做了两个算法。EpiSelect 用每个自然数据域的 loss 曲线拟合 scaling law，预测继续在该域训练会带来的 epiplexity 增益，再用这个增益做在线 batch/domain 选择。这样做的动机是：直接计算完整 epiplexity 代价高，而 loss 曲线的面积可以近似表示“模型还能从该数据中学到多少结构”。EpiGen 则把 epiplexity 增益作为 reward，训练一个数据生成器为 learner 产生更有学习价值的数据，并用 REINFORCE 做策略梯度优化。这个目标会同时排斥两类无效数据：过于重复的数据很快学完，epiplexity 低；纯噪声学不动，epiplexity 也低。与常见 data selection 方法相比，它不是直接优化验证集 loss 或领域权重，而是试图优化训练过程中的结构学习进展。
summary.experiments: 实验核心有三点。第一，EpiSelect 在数据选择上优于已有强基线，说明用 epiplexity gain 做在线选择可以带来更好的 OOD 泛化。第二，EpiGen 生成的数据能提升 learner 表现，说明 epiplexity 可以作为合成数据的训练信号，而不只是分析指标。第三，论文指出 The Pile 作为数据选择评测存在明显偏差：只用 PileCC 训练的简单 baseline 竟然可以超过已有数据选择方法，因此作者转向 Common Pile，以控制不同 domain size 对结果的影响。论文还验证了一个关键假设：较高 epiplexity 与更好的 OOD 泛化在多个设置下相关。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议看三部分，约 30–45 分钟。先看 epiplexity 的定义和图 1，重点理解为什么重复数据和噪声都会得到低 epiplexity。然后看 EpiSelect 的 scaling-law 估计方式，关注它如何把 per-domain loss curve 转成在线选择信号。最后看 The Pile 评测问题和 Common Pile 设置，这部分对做数据 mixture 实验的人很有参考价值。EpiGen 可以略读，重点看 reward 设计和 REINFORCE 是否稳定，而不必深陷生成器实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to select or generate training data when the target is out-of-distribution generalization to tasks that were not known during training.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is a process-based view of data quality. Epiplexity measures how much learnable structure a compute-bounded learner can extract from data during training. This is different from static notions such as domain label, token count, loss, or heuristic quality score. The work is most useful as a data-selection signal and diagnostic framework, rather than as a fully validated large-scale pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper operationalizes epiplexity in two ways. EpiSelect fits scaling laws to per-domain loss curves and predicts the expected epiplexity gain from additional in-domain training tokens. Batches or domains are then selected to maximize this predicted gain. EpiGen trains a generator to produce data that increases the learner’s epiplexity, using REINFORCE with epiplexity gain as the reward. The objective naturally avoids both trivial data, which is learned too quickly, and random noise, which does not produce sustained loss reduction. Compared with validation-loss-driven selection, the method tries to optimize the learner’s structural learning progress.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments support three claims. EpiSelect improves data selection over strong baselines for OOD generalization. EpiGen shows that epiplexity can be used as a reward for synthetic data generation. The paper also identifies a limitation of The Pile as a data-selection benchmark: training only on PileCC can outperform existing selection methods, suggesting that domain-size effects can dominate the evaluation. The authors therefore use Common Pile to better control domain-size confounds and report that higher epiplexity correlates with better OOD generalization across several settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes. Read the epiplexity definition and the intuition figure first, especially the contrast between repetitive sequences, noise, and structured data. Then read the EpiSelect section to understand how loss-curve scaling laws become an online selection rule. Finally, read the benchmark discussion around The Pile and Common Pile, which is directly relevant to data-mixture experiments. The EpiGen section is worth a lighter pass, focusing on the reward definition and whether the policy-gradient setup is stable.

recommendation.zh: 用epiplexity量化数据结构信息做预训练数据选择的思路很新，scaling law拟合采样权重的方法可直接在内部数据配比实验中测试。
recommendation.en: The idea of using epiplexity to quantify data structural information for pretraining data selection is novel; the scaling-law-fitted sampling weight method can be directly tested in internal data mixture experiments.

paper.title: Can Released LLM Vocabularies Support Token-Level Estimation of Hidden Corpora?
paper.abstract: Pretraining corpus composition shapes LLM capabilities, but it often remains hidden even when model weights are released. Prior work has inferred corpus mixtures or traced specific token groups from released tokenizer vocabularies; in contrast, we estimate corpus ratios for arbitrary target tokens. We first show that BPE tokenizers trained on different corpora share stable token ID--ratio distributions, motivating distribution transfer from known corpora to a target tokenizer trained on hidden c

summary.core_problem: 在模型权重公开但预训练语料保密时，能否仅凭公开 tokenizer 词表，对隐藏语料中的任意目标 token 或类别占比做细粒度估计。
summary.importance: 这是预训练数据可解释性与数据审计工作。贡献点不是简单做 corpus mixture 反推，而是把估计粒度推进到任意 token 级别，直接触及 tokenizer 泄露多少上游语料信息这个问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先观察到：在不同语料上训练的 BPE tokenizer，其 token ID 与语料占比之间存在相对稳定的分布关系。基于这一经验规律，提出 Quantile-Guided Density Estimation（QGDE），用多个分位趋势近似隐藏 tokenizer 的 token-ratio 分布，再通过局部密度加权完成 token 级占比估计，并可进一步聚合到类别级 mixture。
summary.experiments: 在受控设置和更接近真实的 released SmolLM tokenizer 设置上评估。QGDE 的 token-level mean relative error 最低可到 3.00%，聚合到类别级 mixture 后为 3.08%。论文核心实验不是下游性能，而是估计精度与分布迁移稳定性，说明 released vocabulary 本身就能暴露相当多的上游语料结构。
summary.authors_note: 来自清华大学与阿里 Qwen 相关团队，方向贴近 tokenizer、预训练语料组成与模型可审计性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a released tokenizer vocabulary alone can support fine-grained estimation of hidden pretraining corpus composition for arbitrary target tokens or categories.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining-data interpretability and auditing paper. The contribution is not just inferring coarse corpus mixtures, but pushing the estimation granularity down to arbitrary token-level ratios, directly probing how much upstream corpus information leaks through the tokenizer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first show that BPE tokenizers trained on different corpora exhibit relatively stable token-ID-to-ratio distributions. Based on this empirical regularity, they propose Quantile-Guided Density Estimation (QGDE), which models the hidden tokenizer’s token-ratio distribution with multiple quantile trends and local density weighting to estimate token-level corpus ratios, then aggregates them into category-level mixtures.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate QGDE in controlled settings and a more realistic setup using the released SmolLM tokenizer. The method reaches mean relative error as low as 3.00% for token-level estimation and 3.08% after aggregation to category-level mixtures. The main result is not downstream accuracy but estimation fidelity and transfer stability, showing that released vocabularies leak substantial information about upstream corpus structure.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from Tsinghua University and Alibaba/Qwen-affiliated teams, closely aligned with tokenizer design, corpus composition, and model auditability.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对 tokenizer 泄露面的直觉：若结论站得住，公开词表已足够做不少语料逆向分析，建议立刻纳入内部 release 风险评估。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on tokenizer leakage: if the result holds, a released vocabulary alone already exposes a surprising amount of corpus structure, so it belongs in any serious release-risk review.

paper.title: Auditing Chinese Web-scale Corpora via Sampled BPE Token Statistics
paper.abstract: Chinese web pollution has surfaced in LLMs, motivating audits of upstream Chinese corpora. However, auditing such corpora faces three challenges: (1) their web-scale size makes full scan costly; (2) prior analyses are often too coarse to expose token-level pollution; (3) Chinese web pollution is implicit and rapidly changing. We propose Sampled-BPE, a lightweight token-level auditing pipeline that sample a small subset and train BPE tokenizer to surface polluted tokens. Experiments show that Sam

summary.core_problem: 如何在不全量扫描超大中文网页语料的前提下，做细粒度、可扩展、能跟踪时变污染的预训练语料审计。
summary.importance: 这是预训练数据治理工作。价值不在训练新模型，而在给中文 web-scale 语料提供低成本 token 级污染审计方法，并把“中文网页污染”从模糊印象变成可量化对象。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Sampled-BPE：先从超大语料中抽样，再在样本上训练 BPE tokenizer，用 token 统计暴露污染模式；随后基于 token 级分布估计不同污染类别的占比。方法重点是用小样本近似全量语料的 token 污染结构，从而显著降低时间和内存成本，同时保留可用精度。
summary.experiments: 在 11 个开源中文语料和 2021-2026 年 6 个 Chinese Common Crawl 快照上做审计。结果显示，相比全量分析，Sampled-BPE 带来 148.4× 速度提升和 35.8× 内存下降，污染类别估计仅有 4.25% 相对误差。实证上发现开源中文语料污染普遍但分布不均，且中文网页污染具有明显时间漂移。
summary.authors_note: 机构来自清华大学、阿里巴巴及相关团队，属于中文预训练数据与安全审计方向的强执行型工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to audit web-scale Chinese pretraining corpora at token level without fully scanning the entire corpus, while remaining sensitive to evolving web pollution.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining data governance paper. Its value is not in training a new model, but in turning vague concerns about Chinese web pollution into a scalable token-level auditing pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Sampled-BPE: sample a small subset from a massive corpus, train a BPE tokenizer on the sample, and use token statistics to surface pollution patterns. The key idea is that a sampled tokenizer can approximate token-level pollution structure of the full corpus with much lower runtime and memory cost.
summary_en.experiments: They audit 11 open Chinese corpora and 6 Chinese Common Crawl snapshots from 2021 to 2026. Compared with full analysis, Sampled-BPE yields 148.4× speedup and 35.8× memory reduction with only 4.25% relative error on pollution categories. Empirically, pollution is widespread but uneven across open corpora, and Chinese web content shows strong temporal drift in pollution patterns.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from Tsinghua University and Alibaba-affiliated teams, and fits the recent push toward Chinese pretraining data auditing and corpus hygiene.

recommendation.zh: 做中文预训练数据的人应直接看方法和审计结果；不是新建模，但它把“网页污染”变成了可操作的数据管线问题，适合内部语料体检复现。
recommendation.en: If you work on Chinese pretraining data, read the method and the audit tables; it is not a modeling paper, but it turns vague web pollution concerns into an actionable corpus-auditing pipeline.

paper.title: The Announcement Carries the Cue: Markup, Boundaries, and the Notation of Pre-Training Corpora
paper.abstract: How a document's arrangement is written down, its notation, is a training variable that no dataset card records. The field has established that text-extraction choices change model behaviour, and has never once measured the notation of what those choices put into the corpus. We define clean-window survival, a deterministic count of how much of a stream still demands the boundary inference, and measure notation on three fronts. What corpora carry: a census of thirteen public corpora, where surviv

summary.core_problem: 该工作讨论预训练语料中的 markup、章节标题、边界符号等“notation”如何改变模型面对的边界推断任务，并提出可复现指标来量化语料里有多少长文本仍需要模型自己推断结构边界。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究有直接启发。现有 dataset card 常记录来源、许可证、语言、过滤规则、去重等信息，但很少记录文本抽取后保留了多少结构提示。该工作把“结构是否被显式标出来”从抽取质量问题拆成一个训练分布问题：保留 markup 有利于依赖结构的任务，但也可能减少模型在长连续文本中学习边界推断的机会。它不否认 structure-preserving extraction 的收益，而是指出预训练混合中可能需要同时保留 marked copy 和 pure copy。
summary.technical_approach: 核心指标是 clean-window survival S(W) 和 clean-run distribution。S(W) 是一个确定性表面统计：在给定窗口长度 W 下，文本流中有多少窗口没有显式边界 announcement，因此仍要求模型从内容中推断边界。它不依赖模型、不需要人工标注、没有随机种子。论文用 Moby-Dick 做直观例子：删除章节号、章节标题、running heads 等 143 行、1,442 tokens，只占 283,267 tokens 正文的 0.51%，但会把 8,192-token packing 下每个完整窗口都含有边界提示的状态，变成所有窗口都没有显式提示。一个关键区分是：简单去掉 Markdown 并不等于去掉 announcement。如果 “CHAPTER 1. Loomings.” 仍单独成行，传统 clean 统计可能认为文本干净，但按 ground-truth 边界看它仍是 marked text。论文主张把被删除的边界行放到 sidecar，保持可逆，并在训练 mixture 中让 marked copy 与 pure copy 共存。
summary.experiments: 实验包含一个公共语料 census 和若干预注册检验。公共语料侧覆盖 13 个 corpora，报告了 clean-window survival 的明显差异：Dolma 3 的 olmOCR slice 中，文档 markup 比例为 74.0%，survival 降到 0.153；C4 的 survival 为 0.889。Moby-Dick 案例给出了机制级数字：原始 Gutenberg 文件 packed 到 8,192-token 窗口时有 35 个 fragments，平均每个 fragment 带 4.1 个 announcement，34 个完整窗口全部至少含一个 announcement；删除 announcement 后，8,192 和 32,768 两种窗口下 clean-window survival 都从 0.000 变为 1.000，最长无 announcement span 从 10,595 tokens 变成整本书。删除成本很小：Moby-Dick 删除 1,442 tokens，占 0.51%；27 部作品包平均 0.71%，15 部叙事作品 0.25%，最坏单部 2.6%。这些数字支持一个工程判断：为了制造长 unmarked spans，删除结构提示的 token 成本通常低于 1%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 Moby-Dick 例子，它把变量讲得最清楚：markup 删除很少 token，却大幅改变边界推断分布。然后看 clean-window survival 的定义和 13 个语料的 census 表，重点关注 C4、Dolma 3 olmOCR、PDF 转换语料之间的差异。最后看作者提出的 reversible sidecar 和 marked/pure mixture 方案。对预训练数据团队来说，最值得带走的是一个数据卡字段：记录 markup / announcement density，以及长 clean-run 的分布，而不只是记录抽取器名称。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how much explicit notation in pretraining corpora—markup, headings, chapter labels, and boundary announcements—changes the boundary-inference task that a language model sees during training.
summary_en.importance: The pretraining relevance is concrete. Dataset documentation often records source, license, language, filtering, and deduplication, but rarely records how much structural notation survives text extraction. This work separates two issues that are often conflated: preserving structure can improve tasks that read structure, while excessive boundary announcements may reduce the amount of long text where the model must infer segmentation from content. The practical implication is not to discard markup everywhere. It is to measure it, and possibly train on both marked and purified versions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central metric is clean-window survival S(W), together with the clean-run distribution. S(W) is a deterministic surface count: for a packing window of length W, it measures how much of the stream remains free of explicit boundary announcements and therefore still requires boundary inference. It uses no model, no annotation, and no random seed. The Moby-Dick example makes the mechanism clear. Removing chapter numbers, chapter titles, running heads, and similar apparatus deletes 143 lines and 1,442 tokens, only 0.51% of a 283,267-token text, yet it changes the training stream sharply. At 8,192-token packing, the original book yields 35 fragments with 4.1 announcements per fragment, and every one of the 34 full windows contains at least one announcement. After deletion, the full windows contain none. A subtle point is that stripping Markdown is insufficient if strings such as “CHAPTER 1. Loomings.” remain on their own lines. The paper therefore treats the announcement itself as the variable, keeps deleted lines in a reversible sidecar, and suggests mixing marked and pure copies rather than choosing one representation globally.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section includes a census over 13 public corpora and several preregistered tests. The corpus census reports large variation in clean-window survival: the olmOCR slice of Dolma 3 has 74.0% markup-bearing documents and survival of 0.153, while C4 reaches 0.889. The Moby-Dick case gives the mechanism-level numbers: deleting 1,442 tokens changes clean-window survival from 0.000 to 1.000 at both 8,192 and 32,768 tokens, and the longest span without an announcement grows from 10,595 tokens to the entire book. The deletion cost is small in the broader book pack: 0.71% of tokens across 27 works, 0.25% across 15 narratives, and 2.6% in the worst single case. These numbers support the engineering point that creating long unmarked spans usually costs far less than one percent of tokens.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Start with the Moby-Dick example, because it isolates the variable better than the abstract. Then read the definition of clean-window survival and the 13-corpus census table, with attention to C4, Dolma 3 olmOCR, and PDF-derived corpora. The reversible sidecar and marked/pure mixture proposal is the most actionable part for pretraining data pipelines. The main practical addition to dataset cards would be markup or announcement density, plus long clean-run statistics, not just the name of the extractor.

recommendation.zh: 首次量化预训练语料的结构标记残留，做数据清洗 pipeline 时可把这个指标加进去，重点看 §3 的指标定义和语料普查结果。
recommendation.en: First quantitative measurement of structural markup residue in pre-training corpora; add this metric to data cleaning pipelines, focus on §3 for metric definition and corpus census results.

paper.title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
paper.abstract: Context lengths of language models (LMs) have dramatically increased, driven by the demands for in-context learning, self-improvement, and long-horizon agentic workflows. Existing long-context corpora, however, are dominated by books, academic articles, and code repositories, which are finite resources and often scarce in long-distance dependencies. In this work, we introduce OctoLong, a context engineering pipeline that instruments an AST parser, a language server backend, and a package manager

summary.core_problem: 现有长上下文预训练语料（书籍、学术论文、单仓库代码）的长距离依赖密度不足，跨文档长上下文构造方法多依赖超链接、分类标签、事件共指等弱关联信号，上下文耦合度低，导致模型扩展上下文窗口时，长距离推理性能出现衰减。同时代码语料的利用大多停留在单仓库序列化层面，跨仓库的紧耦合多跳依赖这一高密度长程依赖数据源未被有效挖掘。
summary.importance: 属于长上下文预训练数据工程方向的实质性进展。第一，提出可规模化的跨仓库代码依赖挖掘管线，为长上下文语料构造提供了新的高密度数据源；第二，验证了mid-training阶段长上下文继续预训练（LCFT）的有效性，可将Qwen3基座的上下文长度提升4倍至128K，且不损失短上下文能力；第三，跨仓库代码数据的训练收益可迁移到通用长上下文任务和agent场景，说明结构化的长程代码依赖对通用长上下文建模有正向迁移作用。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是OctoLong数据管线，结合抽象语法树（AST）解析器、语言服务器协议（LSP）后端、包管理器三个组件，递归检索跨仓库的代码依赖。具体流程：1）筛选高质量Python仓库（≥15个GitHub星标、≥5名贡献者）；2）利用LSP的类型与作用域感知能力，结合包管理器解析的依赖关系，递归获取导入的类、函数的实现代码（突破仓库边界）；3）将这些依赖按调用关系拼接，构造出依赖密度极高的长代码上下文，长度可达百万token。基于该管线构建两类语料：一是约62亿token的跨仓库长上下文代码数据，与其他长文本数据混合成约500亿token的OctoLong-LCFT语料，用于mid-training阶段的长上下文继续预训练；二是约100亿token的OctoLong-SFT混合语料（开源指令数据+agent数据），用于指令微调。训练流程以Qwen3稠密基座模型（600M至14B参数）为起点，先做LCFT将上下文长度扩展至128K（原生的4倍），再做SFT得到OctoLong-Instruct系列模型。与现有方法的核心区别：现有跨文档长上下文构造依赖弱关联信号，上下文耦合度低；单仓库代码序列化受限于仓库边界，依赖范围有限。OctoLong通过LSP实现精确的跨仓库依赖检索，得到的上下文是紧耦合的多跳依赖，且可依托开源包生态无限扩展。
summary.experiments: 1）数据层面：通过注意力图分析和模型似然验证，OctoLong构造的跨仓库代码上下文的长距离依赖密度显著高于现有长上下文数据（单仓库代码、书籍、学术论文等）。2）模型层面：基于Qwen3 600M-14B基座训练的OctoLong-Instruct，在长上下文代码任务上获得大幅提升，在通用领域长上下文任务（包括agent用例）上也有明显增益，且短上下文LM能力无损失。3）消融实验：从LCFT数据混合中移除跨仓库代码数据后，长上下文任务性能出现明显下降，证明该数据成分是长上下文性能提升的关键来源。
summary.reading_guide: 精读优先级：1）第3章OctoLong数据管线：重点看LSP、AST、包管理器三者的协作方式，以及跨仓库依赖递归检索的实现逻辑（对应图2的流程图），这是全文核心创新点。2）第4章训练流程：重点看mid-training阶段LCFT的数据配比、训练步数、上下文长度设置等配方细节，以及SFT阶段的数据构成。3）第5章实验与消融：重点看两组对比——跨仓库代码 vs 单仓库代码/普通长文本的长上下文性能差异，以及长上下文训练后短上下文能力的保持情况。值得深挖的方向：如何量化长上下文的依赖密度，mid-training阶段上下文扩展的scaling规律，以及跨文档依赖挖掘方法能否迁移到非代码领域（如学术论文、网页）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-context pretraining corpora (books, academic papers, single-repository code) have low density of long-distance dependencies. Current cross-document long-context construction methods rely on weak correlation signals such as hyperlinks, category tags, and event co-reference, resulting in loosely coupled contexts that cause performance degradation on long-distance reasoning tasks when extending model context windows. Meanwhile, code corpora usage is mostly limited to single-repository serialization, leaving cross-repository tightly-coupled multi-hop dependencies — a high-density source of long-range dependencies — largely untapped.
summary_en.importance: This work represents a concrete advance in long-context pretraining data engineering. First, it introduces a scalable cross-repository code dependency mining pipeline, providing a new high-density data source for long-context corpus construction. Second, it validates that mid-training long-context continued pretraining (LCFT) can quadruple the context window of Qwen3 base models to 128K without degrading short-context capabilities. Third, the training gains from cross-repository code data transfer to general-domain long-context tasks and agent scenarios, demonstrating that structured long-range code dependencies have positive transfer effects on general long-context modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core of the work is the OctoLong data pipeline, which combines three components: an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parser, a Language Server Protocol (LSP) backend, and a package manager, to recursively retrieve cross-repository code dependencies. The pipeline works as follows: 1) Curate high-quality Python repositories (≥15 GitHub stars, ≥5 contributors); 2) Use LSP's type- and scope-aware analysis, paired with package manager-resolved dependencies, to recursively fetch implementations of imported classes and functions across repository boundaries; 3) Concatenate these dependencies in call order to form high-density long code contexts up to millions of tokens in length. Two corpora are built from this pipeline: the ~6.2B-token cross-repository long-context code dataset, mixed with other long-text data to form the ~50B-token OctoLong-LCFT corpus for mid-training long-context continued pretraining; and the ~10B-token OctoLong-SFT mix (open instruction data + agent data) for supervised fine-tuning. The training pipeline starts from Qwen3 dense base models (600M to 14B parameters), first performs LCFT to extend the context window to 128K (4x the native length), then runs SFT to produce the OctoLong-Instruct suite. The key difference from prior work: existing cross-document long-context construction relies on weak correlation signals with low context coupling, while single-repository code serialization is limited by repository boundaries. OctoLong achieves precise cross-repository dependency retrieval via LSP, producing tightly coupled multi-hop dependency contexts that scale infinitely with the open-source package ecosystem.
summary_en.experiments: 1) Data-level validation: attention map analysis and model likelihood measurements confirm that cross-repository code contexts from OctoLong have significantly higher long-distance dependency density than existing long-context data (single-repository code, books, academic papers, etc.). 2) Model-level results: OctoLong-Instruct models, trained on Qwen3 600M-14B bases, achieve large gains on long-context code tasks, consistent improvements on general-domain long-context tasks (including agent use cases), and no degradation in short-context LM capabilities. 3) Ablation studies: removing cross-repository code data from the LCFT data mix causes a clear drop in long-context task performance, verifying that this data component is a key driver of long-context performance gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Reading priority for deep dive: 1) Section 3 (OctoLong data pipeline): focus on how LSP, AST, and the package manager work together, and the implementation logic of recursive cross-repository dependency retrieval (see Figure 2 for the pipeline flowchart) — this is the core innovation of the paper. 2) Section 4 (training pipeline): focus on the mid-training LCFT recipe details, including data mixture ratio, training steps, and context window configuration, as well as the composition of the SFT dataset. 3) Section 5 (experiments and ablations): focus on two key comparisons — the long-context performance gap between cross-repository code and single-repository code / general long text, and the retention of short-context capabilities after long-context training. Open directions for further exploration: quantitative metrics for long-context dependency density, scaling laws for mid-training context extension, and whether cross-document dependency mining methods can be transferred to non-code domains such as academic papers and web pages.

recommendation.zh: 跨仓库代码依赖构造高密度长上下文语料的思路极具价值，应立刻在内部长上下文mid-training中做消融验证。
recommendation.en: The idea of constructing high-density long-context corpora from cross-repository code dependencies is highly valuable; immediately run ablation validation in internal long-context mid-training pipelines.

paper.title: Scalable Frequency- and Length-Aware Subdocument Deduplication for Large Language Model Pretraining
paper.abstract: Large-scale pretraining corpora contain substantial duplicate content. Although document-level deduplication is widely used, removing subdocument-level redundancy remains challenging. At corpus scale, suffix-array-based methods are commonly applied independently within shards, leaving cross-shard duplicates undetected and making the resulting retention behavior sensitive to the sharding configuration. Hash-based methods enable global exact duplicate counting, but often rely on fixed copy-retenti

summary.core_problem: 大规模预训练语料里“子文档级重复”（模板、导航栏、版权段、引用、重复代码块、版本演化带来的长片段复用）普遍存在。现有做法要么停留在文档级去重，难以清掉局部重复；要么用 suffix array 做可变长子串匹配但通常分 shard 处理，导致跨 shard 重复不可见、去重结果对 sharding 配置敏感；即便用哈希能全局计数，常见的 keep-one/keep-k 又无法根据重复频率与长度的异质性做自适应保留。论文要解决的是：在 corpus scale 上，如何可扩展地做子文档去重，并且让“检测重复”和“保留多少份拷贝”解耦、可控、对 sharding 不敏感。
summary.importance: 这是典型的 pretraining_data 方向硬问题：把去重从“工程经验 + 固定策略”推进到“可解释的全局频次统计 + 显式保留函数”。直接收益是更高 token 效率（少训练无信息模板）、更低记忆化风险、以及更稳定的数据管线（不再被 shard 切分方式左右）。更重要的是它把 copy retention 变成一个可调的函数（依赖频率与长度），为后续做 data mixture / curriculum / compute-optimal 数据压缩提供了接口，而不是一次性拍脑袋阈值。
summary.technical_approach:
框架核心是“检测-保留解耦”。
1) Duplicate detection（全局可扩展）：
- Natural-boundary segmentation：先按自然边界切分子文档单元（段落/行/代码块等，论文强调自然边界以减少跨边界漏检与语义破坏）。
- Normalized exact hashing：对分段做规范化（例如空白、大小写、标点、可能还有语言/代码的轻量归一；具体以正文为准），再做精确哈希，使同一重复单元在不同来源/不同格式下仍能落到同一 key。
- Distributed aggregation：用分布式 key–value 聚合全局统计每个 hash 的出现次数，从而跨 shard 也能得到真实频次，避免 suffix-array shard-local 的“可见性偏差”。
2) Copy retention（显式策略）：
- 引入 retention function：为每个重复组分配保留预算 k=f(freq, length)。直觉是：频次越高越像模板/低信息结构，应更强压缩；重复跨度越长越可能是整段拷贝/模板复用，也应更少保留。低频重复则更保守，避免误删合理引用或版本演化带来的少量复用。
- Coherence-preserving deletion：在文档内删除重复片段时，尽量保持连贯性，减少“碎片化文档”对训练的副作用（例如留下大量断裂短段）。
与 suffix-array 子串去重相比：牺牲了跨边界、任意子串的完全覆盖，换来全局频次可见、对 sharding 不敏感、以及更可控的保留策略。与 keep-one/keep-k 相比：保留预算随频次与长度自适应，能处理真实语料里重复模式的长尾与异质性。
summary.experiments:
论文在 FineWeb-Edu 与一个含代码的 web 语料上做实验，结论是：在 FineWeb-Edu 上总体表现最好；在含代码语料上对所有评测基准都有一致增益。给出的全文片段未包含具体数字与设置细节，精读时需要补齐：
- 语料规模（token 数、文档数）、分段粒度、规范化规则。
- retention function 的具体形式与超参（freq/length 的分段、幂律、对数等），以及与 keep-one/keep-k、sharded suffix-array 的对照。
- 训练设置（模型大小、训练 token、是否固定 compute）、以及“token 节省”与“下游提升”的对应关系。
- 关键消融：只做全局计数但固定 keep-k；只做频次自适应不考虑长度；不做 coherence deletion 的影响。
- 对记忆化/重复生成的指标（例如重复片段的 memorization probe）是否有量化。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（建议 60–90 分钟，偏工程实现）：
- 先读 Introduction 里对 suffix-array sharding 敏感性的论证，明确它为什么会导致 retention 行为“隐式且不可控”。
- 重点看方法章节中三块细节：自然边界如何定义（对代码/HTML/纯文本是否不同）、normalized hashing 的规范化规则、以及 distributed aggregation 的实现与复杂度。
- retention function 是全文的“可迁移资产”：把它当作一个可调的 data compression policy 来读，关注它如何同时用 freq 与 length 控制保留预算，以及边界条件（freq=1、超长重复、极高频模板）。
- 实验部分优先看：不同 sharding 配置下结果是否稳定；token 保留率 vs 性能曲线；以及对代码语料的影响（代码重复往往既有模板也有高价值片段，最能检验策略是否过删）。

summary_en.core_problem: Large pretraining corpora contain pervasive subdocument-level duplication (templates, boilerplate, quoted passages, repeated code blocks, versioned copies). Document-level dedup misses local redundancy; suffix-array substring dedup is often run per-shard, making cross-shard duplicates invisible and outcomes sensitive to sharding; global hashing can count duplicates but typical keep-one/keep-k retention policies cannot adapt to heterogeneous repetition patterns. The paper targets scalable subdocument deduplication with global frequency awareness and an explicit, controllable copy-retention policy.
summary_en.importance: A high-leverage pretraining-data contribution: it turns dedup from a shard-dependent heuristic into a globally counted, policy-driven compression step. Practically, it improves token efficiency (less compute on boilerplate), reduces verbatim memorization risk, and stabilizes pipelines across different sharding layouts. Conceptually, the explicit retention function (dependent on frequency and span length) is a reusable interface for future work on data mixture, curriculum, and compute-optimal data compression—more actionable than fixed thresholds.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework explicitly decouples duplicate detection from copy retention.
Detection (scalable and shard-invariant): documents are segmented at natural boundaries; each segment is normalized (formatting/casing/whitespace etc., per the paper’s rules) and exact-hashed; distributed key–value aggregation computes global occurrence counts for each hash, ensuring cross-shard visibility.
Retention (explicit policy): instead of keep-one/keep-k, the method defines a retention function k=f(global_frequency, segment_length). High-frequency segments (likely boilerplate/templates) are aggressively compressed; longer repeated spans get smaller budgets as they more often reflect direct copying or templated reuse; low-frequency repeats are treated conservatively to avoid deleting legitimate quotations or mild reuse. A coherence-preserving deletion step reduces fragmentation when removing repeated spans.
Trade-off vs suffix arrays: less coverage for arbitrary cross-boundary substrings, but far better scalability, shard invariance, and controllable retention behavior.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on FineWeb-Edu and a code-containing web corpus. The paper claims best overall results on FineWeb-Edu and consistent gains across all evaluated benchmarks on the code corpus. The provided excerpt does not include concrete numbers; when reading the full paper, verify corpus scale, segmentation granularity, normalization rules, the exact retention function form and hyperparameters, compute-controlled training settings, and ablations (frequency-only vs frequency+length, fixed keep-k vs adaptive, with/without coherence-preserving deletion). Also check whether memorization/duplication probes are quantified.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Deep-read focus (60–90 minutes, implementation-heavy):
- Understand the failure mode of sharded suffix-array dedup: why shard-local visibility implicitly induces retention and makes results shard-sensitive.
- Study the three engineering-critical components: natural-boundary segmentation (including code/HTML handling), normalization for hashing, and the distributed aggregation design/complexity.
- Treat the retention function as the main transferable artifact: inspect how it allocates budgets across frequency and length regimes and what safeguards exist for edge cases.
- In experiments, prioritize shard-sensitivity tests, token-retention vs quality curves, and the code-corpus breakdown (where duplication can be both low-value boilerplate and high-value reusable snippets).

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得认真看，因为它把“找重复”和“留几份”拆开了；如果实验里真做了 shard-invariant 计数和 retention 曲线，应该立刻纳入内部数据管线对照。
recommendation.en: This is worth real attention because it separates duplicate detection from retention policy; if the paper reports shard-invariant counts and clean retention curves, it should go straight into your internal data-pipeline ablations.

paper.title: Pruned BPE: Post-training Visibility Pruning and Token Reallocation for Byte Pair Encoding
paper.abstract: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) is widely used for subword tokenization, but standard BPE exposes every learned merge token to the downstream model, including tokens that mainly serve as intermediate construction units and rarely appear in the final encoded corpus. This paper proposes Pruned BPE, a post-training visibility-pruning and token-reallocation method that separates merge construction from model-visible vocabulary selection. After standard BPE training, tokens are evaluated by final exposure.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 BPE 词表分配里的一个老问题：BPE 的训练目标是逐步构造高频 merge，但语言模型真正看到的是最终编码后的可见 token 集。两者并不一致。很多 merge token 在训练过程中有用，只是作为更长 token 的中间节点存在；等最终编码完成后，这些 token 几乎不会真正出现在语料里。标准 BPE 仍然把它们放进模型可见词表，等于把有限的词表预算花在低暴露、低训练频次的 token 上。论文要解决的不是“怎么剪小词表”，而是“在保持可见词表大小不变的前提下，如何把可见词表从中间构造节点里解耦出来，重新分配给更值得暴露给模型的 token”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在 tokenizer 设计，而不是建模或训练 recipe。本工作提出了一个很具体也很实用的观点：BPE 的 merge 学习过程和 LM 的可见词表选择不必绑定。这个切分是有价值的，因为 tokenizer 往往被当成一次性离线组件，但它直接决定序列长度、embedding 参数利用率、不同语言脚本的分词质量，以及低频 token 的训练充分性。论文尤其点到了 byte-level BPE 在 Unicode 多字节脚本上的问题：中文、日文、韩文等更容易产生只对 merge 树有用、对模型无直接价值的中间 byte 片段。如果全文实验成立，这类后处理式词表重分配提供了一条低成本改进路径：不改模型结构，不改 BPE 主训练流程，只在 tokenizer 训练后做可见性筛选和 token 槽位重分配。量级上，它更像是 tokenizer 工程层面的稳健增益，而不是会改写 scaling 行为的大改动。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步。第一步，先按标准 byte-level BPE 正常训练，得到完整 merge 树和一批按 merge 顺序生成的 token。这里没有改 BPE 的核心学习规则，也没有在训练时引入额外目标。第二步，训练完成后，用 fully encoded corpus 统计每个 learned token 的 final exposure，也就是在最终编码结果里它真正作为输出 token 出现的频次，而不是它在 merge 过程中被使用的次数。作者据此把 token 分成两类：可见 token 和 internal-only token。低 exposure token 仍保留在 merge 树里，继续作为内部构造节点参与更长 token 的形成，但不再分配给模型可见词表 ID。第三步，为了保持目标可见词表大小不变，作者继续在原 BPE 训练基础上 resumed training，训练到超过原目标词表大小，从后续候选 merge 中挑选 exposure 更好的 token，回填被剪掉的可见槽位。

编码时的关键设计是：先按完整 merge 规则做标准 BPE 编码，得到最终 token 序列；如果其中某个 token 被标记为 internal-only，则递归展开成其可见子节点，直到输出序列只包含 visible vocabulary 中的 token。这样做保留了 merge 树的构造能力，但把模型接口限制在重新筛选后的可见词表上。论文强调这不是普通 vocabulary pruning，因为词表大小不变，merge 顺序也尽量保持；变化的是哪些 token 对模型可见。

从方法取舍看，这个设计比“直接按频次删 token”更稳，因为它不破坏更长 token 的生成路径；也比“重新训练一个更大的 tokenizer 再截断”更可控，因为它显式区分了构造节点和可见节点。作者还做了 vocabulary-only evaluation，用共享的 exact minimum-token objective 去剥离 native BPE merge-order 编码差异，试图证明收益来自可见词表组成，而不只是编码器实现细节。这一点是全文里比较关键的论证。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可以确认，实验重点不是大规模下游 LLM 预训练，而是 tokenizer 层面的词表质量评估与编码效果比较。作者提供了 shared exact minimum-token objective 的 vocabulary-only evaluation，用来在相同最短分词目标下比较标准 BPE 与 Pruned BPE 的可见词表组成差异。论文还强调实现支持 Unicode-aware pretokenization、自然语言与代码边界、CPU 并行训练、sharding 和 checkpoint，说明实验应覆盖多语种或至少包含非拉丁脚本场景。

就方法预期而言，关键观察应包括几类：一是低 final exposure token 在标准 BPE 词表中占比不低；二是把这些 token 改成 internal-only 后，最终编码长度不会明显恶化，否则说明只是把问题转移到了更长序列；三是回填的新 token 在最终语料中暴露更高，词表利用率更好；四是在中文等多字节脚本上收益可能更明显，因为中间 byte 片段更多。当前提供的全文片段没有完整表格数字，无法可靠复述具体提升幅度、词表规模、阈值设置和不同语料上的 token 数变化，因此不应编造数值。精读时需要重点核对：final exposure 的分布图、不同阈值下 visible/internal 划分比例、编码长度变化、以及 vocabulary-only evaluation 的具体指标和绝对差值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓住两个问题：为什么标准 BPE 会把中间 merge 节点错误地暴露给模型；作者如何在不破坏 merge 树的前提下把这些节点藏起来。阅读顺序上，先看 Introduction 里关于 final exposure 和 Unicode 多字节脚本的动机，再看 Proposed Method 中 internal-only token、resumed training、recursive expansion 这三处机制。然后直接找实验部分里三类图表：1）token exposure 分布；2）pruning threshold 与编码长度/词表利用率的关系；3）vocabulary-only evaluation。若时间有限，预计 20 到 30 分钟可以判断这是不是一个值得在自家 tokenizer pipeline 里复现的小改动。真正值得深挖的点有两个：其一，final exposure 是否足够，还是应该结合 PMI、跨语种覆盖率、embedding 更新频次等更贴近 LM 训练的指标；其二，递归展开后的分词序列是否会改变下游模型对形态边界和多语种字符边界的学习方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a mismatch inside standard BPE: merge learning optimizes for constructing frequent longer units, while the language model only cares about the final emitted tokens. Many learned merge tokens are useful only as intermediate nodes in the merge tree and rarely survive in the fully encoded corpus. Standard BPE still exposes all of them to the model-visible vocabulary, which wastes scarce vocabulary slots on low-exposure tokens that receive little direct training signal. The paper asks a narrower and more practical question than vocabulary compression: with the visible vocabulary size fixed, can we decouple merge construction from model-visible token selection and reallocate those slots to tokens that are actually emitted?
summary_en.importance: This is a tokenizer paper with direct relevance to pretraining efficiency and vocabulary design. Its main contribution is conceptual but practical: BPE merge learning and visible vocabulary exposure do not need to be the same object. That matters because tokenizer choices affect sequence length, embedding utilization, multilingual coverage, and how well token embeddings are trained. The motivation is especially plausible for byte-level BPE on UTF-8 text, where non-Latin scripts can generate many byte fragments that are necessary for building characters or words but are poor model-facing units. If the empirical results hold, the method offers a low-friction improvement path: no change to the LM architecture, no change to the core BPE training loop, only a post-training visibility filter plus slot reallocation. The likely impact is incremental but real, closer to a robust tokenizer engineering improvement than a change in language-model scaling behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three stages. First, train a standard byte-level BPE tokenizer as usual and keep the full learned merge tree. There is no modification to the merge-learning objective itself. Second, after training, compute each learned token’s final exposure, meaning how often it actually appears in the fully encoded corpus after all merges are applied. Tokens with low final exposure are marked as internal-only: they remain in the merge tree and can still serve as construction nodes for longer tokens, but they are removed from the model-visible vocabulary. Third, to preserve the target visible vocabulary size, the tokenizer training is resumed beyond the original vocabulary budget, producing additional candidate merges. Better-exposed candidates are then used to fill the visible slots vacated by the pruned tokens.

The encoding design is the key implementation detail. Encoding first follows the full merge rules exactly as in standard BPE. If a resulting token is internal-only, it is recursively expanded into visible child tokens until the returned token sequence contains only visible vocabulary items. This preserves the learned merge structure while changing the model interface. The paper is careful to distinguish this from ordinary vocabulary pruning: the visible vocabulary size is preserved, and the merge tree is not discarded. What changes is which learned tokens are exposed to the LM.

This design is more conservative than simply deleting low-frequency tokens, because it does not break the construction path for longer merges. It is also more controlled than retraining a larger tokenizer and truncating it, because it explicitly separates internal merge nodes from model-visible units. A notable part of the paper is the vocabulary-only evaluation under a shared exact minimum-token objective, intended to isolate the effect of visible vocabulary composition from native BPE merge-order artifacts.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the experimental focus is clearly tokenizer-level evaluation rather than end-to-end large-scale LM pretraining. The paper includes a vocabulary-only evaluation with a shared exact minimum-token objective, which is meant to compare standard BPE and Pruned BPE under the same segmentation target and isolate the effect of visible vocabulary composition. The implementation also supports Unicode-aware pretokenization, language/code-friendly boundaries, CPU-parallel training, sharding, and checkpointing, suggesting experiments likely include multilingual or at least non-Latin-script settings.

The important empirical questions are straightforward: how many learned BPE tokens have low final exposure; whether hiding them as internal-only harms encoded sequence length; whether the replacement tokens have materially better exposure in the final corpus; and whether gains are larger for byte-heavy scripts such as Chinese, Japanese, or Korean. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact numbers for vocabulary size, threshold settings, token-count changes, or downstream gains. When reading the paper, the critical figures to verify are the exposure distribution, the visible/internal split under different thresholds, the effect on encoded length, and the exact margins in the vocabulary-only evaluation.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, focus on two ideas: why standard BPE exposes the wrong tokens, and how the paper hides intermediate merge nodes without breaking the merge tree. Start with the motivation around final exposure and UTF-8 byte fragmentation in the introduction. Then read the method section for three mechanisms: internal-only tokens, resumed training beyond the target vocabulary size, and recursive expansion at encoding time. After that, jump to the experiments and look for three things: exposure histograms, the trade-off between pruning threshold and sequence length, and the vocabulary-only evaluation. In about 20 to 30 minutes, you should be able to decide whether this is worth reproducing in a tokenizer pipeline. The deeper questions are whether final exposure is the right criterion by itself, and whether recursive expansion changes the linguistic units the downstream LM ends up learning.

recommendation.zh: 这个点抓得准：BPE 确实把不少词表浪费在“只参与构造、不该暴露给模型”的节点上；建议立刻做 internal ablation，看 token 数下降能否换成真实 pretrain gain。
recommendation.en: This targets a real inefficiency in BPE: too many vocabulary slots are spent on construction-only nodes; worth reproducing internally to see whether shorter sequences translate into actual pretraining gains.

paper.title: Discriminative Axis, Not Data Volume: What a Contrastive Corpus Teaches an Audio Embedding
paper.abstract: Scaling the corpus is the default remedy when a contrastive representation lacks an attribute. We report a case where it does nothing, and identify what does: adding a lexical-speech round to a frozen-base multimodal embedding model raises zero-shot keyword spotting by 76 points while reducing speech-emotion recognition by 14. The loss is not a capacity limit: fine-tuning on 7,442 clips from a prosody-controlled corpus recovers emotion past its pre-speech level at a five-point keyword cost. Nor

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“多加数据是否有用”，而是更尖锐的问题：在对比学习的多模态音频嵌入里，某个属性究竟在什么条件下才会被表示出来。作者抓住了一个很干净的反例：给模型加入大规模 lexical speech 语料后，零样本关键词识别大幅上升，但语音情感识别明显下降。两者都属于 speech，都在同一个共享嵌入空间里评测，因此“更多语音数据会带来更全面的语音理解”这个直觉在这里失效。全文的核心结论是，决定属性是否进入表示的关键不是数据量，也不是 caption 里有没有把该属性写出来，而是训练语料是否把这个属性变成了区分 batch 内负样本所必需的判别轴。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义在于，它把“数据质量/数据结构”往前推进了一步：不是泛泛地说高质量数据更好，而是指出 contrastive pretraining 学到什么，取决于负样本可分性要求模型依赖哪些属性。这对音频 embedding、VLM 对比学习、统一多模态表示都很有启发。很多预训练工作默认只要把目标属性写进文本标注、再扩大语料，就能把能力补回来；这篇文章给出的证据是否定的。它说明 corpus construction 的作用可以强到压过 corpus size。对基座研究员来说，最有价值的地方不是音频任务本身，而是它提供了一个可操作的机制解释：属性学习受“判别需求”约束，而不是受“属性出现频率”直接驱动。这个判断也自然连接到数据配比、负样本设计、batch 构造、caption 风格，以及多任务预训练中的能力 trade-off。
summary.technical_approach:
模型侧并不复杂，重点在实验设计。底座是一个 2B 参数的 frozen vision-language embedding model，只训练音频 connector 和每层 decoder 上的 modality-gated deep adapters；非音频输入时 gate 关闭，因此文本、图像、视频路径不被改动。嵌入是 Matryoshka-nested，默认读出 1024 维。预训练总语料约 888.8K clips，新增的 lexical-speech round 包含约 150K spoken-word clips、70K read-speech clips 和 audiobook 数据。训练中使用 frozen-text memory bank、false-negative masking 和 soft labels。

真正的创新在于作者如何排除其他解释，并把“判别轴”这个说法做成可检验机制。第一步，先观察 lexical speech round 带来的能力交换：关键词识别大涨，情感识别下滑。第二步，用一个 120 倍更小、但在设计上控制 lexical content 的 prosody corpus（Crema-D）做微调，证明情感能力可以快速恢复，因此不是容量不够。第三步，构造 matched-exposure negative control：用 29,428 条显式提到 emotion 的 mined clips，在相同 recipe 和 exposure 下微调，结果情感几乎不动，说明“caption 里写了情感”并不等于模型会学到情感。第四步，再排除 representational truncation 和 general degradation：前者只能解释一小部分差距，后者通过九任务板证明并不存在普遍退化。最后，作者提出 separability statistic，从语料本身估计某属性是否是区分负样本所必需的轴，并在同一批音频上做结构化干预：只改变语料组织方式，让 emotion 成为必须依赖的判别维度，情感能力就恢复；如果只是提高 caption 相似度而不改变判别需求，则恢复不了。这一步把相关性推进到了因果层面的证据。

和常见做法相比，这篇文章不是再发明一个 loss，也不是改模型容量，而是把预训练数据的“结构”拆成了更细的机制变量：同样的音频、同样的 exposure、甚至 caption 明确写出目标属性，都不足以保证属性进入表示；关键是 batch 内负样本能否在不看该属性的情况下被分开。
summary.experiments:
最关键的结果有四组。第一组，加入 lexical-speech round 后，零样本 keyword spotting 提升 76 个点，而 speech emotion recognition 下降 14 个点。作者用的是 MAEB audio embedding benchmark / mteb 框架下的 SpeechCommands（35-way）和 Ravdess，评测方式都是把音频和类别文本映射到共享空间后做匹配。

第二组，容量假设被直接否掉。用只有 7,442 clips 的 Crema-D，从同一个 post-speech checkpoint 出发、固定 fine-tune recipe（batch 128，peak lr 3e-5，无 grad accumulation，关闭 false-negative masking 和 soft labels），只训 150 steps，emotion 从 0.211 恢复到 0.508，超过 pre-speech 的 0.348；同时 keyword 只降到 0.845，仍远高于 pre-speech 水平。训到 400 steps 时 trade-off 继续恶化，说明短 schedule 反而是更好的 operating point。作者还给了一个很直观的“交换率”：150 steps 左右大约是每损失 1 个 keyword 点，换回 6 个 emotion 点；150 到 400 steps 之间这个比率降到约 2。

第三组，数据量假设也被否掉。用 29,428 条 mined clips，caption 明确命名 emotion，且 exposure 匹配，结果 emotion 变化只有 -0.0007，几乎为零。这说明“更多带标签的数据”在这里没有触发目标属性学习。

第四组，机制验证。representational truncation 最多只能恢复约 18% 的差距；九任务板没有显示普遍性退化，因此情感下降不是被其他损伤掩盖。更重要的是，在同一音频上重组语料，让 emotion 成为 required discriminative axis 后，三种随机种子平均恢复 +0.089；而单纯提高 in-batch caption similarity 并不能带来同样效果。这个对照很关键，因为它把“相似文本更利于学情感”与“必须依赖情感才能区分负样本”区分开了。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓机制链条，不必一开始陷进音频细节。优先看 Introduction 和 Section 4，先确认现象本身是否足够反常：同样是 speech，为什么一个涨一个跌。然后看 Section 5 和 Section 6，这两节是全文最重要的排除法：容量不是原因，数据量也不是原因。这里建议重点看 Table 2、Figure 2、Table 4，把 checkpoint、step 数、数据规模和指标变化对应起来。接着看 Section 9 关于 separability statistic 的定义和解释，再看 Section 11 的干预实验，这是作者把机制从观察推进到因果验证的地方，重点看 Tables 8、9 和 Figure 4。Section 7、8 可以快速扫，用来确认作者确实检查了 truncation 和 collateral damage。

如果你做预训练数据或对比学习，阅读时最值得深挖的点有三个：一是 batch negatives 的构造如何决定表示里保留哪些属性；二是“caption 显式命名属性”为什么仍然不够，这和 text side supervision 的信息瓶颈有什么关系；三是 separability statistic 能否推广到图文对比、视频-文本、语音-文本甚至 tokenizer/data mixture 设计。预计 25–35 分钟可以完成一轮高质量泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than “does more data help”: under contrastive multimodal pretraining, when does a target attribute actually enter the learned representation? The authors exploit a clean failure case. Adding a large lexical-speech round to an audio embedding model dramatically improves zero-shot keyword spotting, yet substantially hurts speech-emotion recognition. Both are speech tasks evaluated in the same shared embedding space, so the usual intuition—more speech data should improve speech understanding broadly—fails here. The central claim is that attribute learning is governed not by corpus size, nor by whether captions explicitly mention the attribute, but by whether the corpus makes that attribute a necessary discriminative axis for separating in-batch negatives.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the contribution is not the audio benchmark itself but the mechanism it isolates. The paper moves beyond the vague statement that “data quality matters” and gives a more operational account: contrastive objectives encode an attribute only when the training setup requires that attribute for discrimination. This matters for audio-text embeddings, VLM contrastive pretraining, and unified multimodal representation learning. Many practitioners implicitly assume that if the target attribute is named in captions and enough data is added, the model will eventually absorb it. The evidence here argues otherwise. Corpus construction can dominate corpus volume. For foundation-model work, this has direct implications for data mixture design, negative sampling, batch composition, caption style, and capability trade-offs in multitask pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The model architecture is relatively standard; the novelty is in the experimental logic. The system starts from a frozen 2B vision-language embedding model, then trains only an audio connector—a query-based resampler—and modality-gated deep adapters attached to each decoder layer. The gate is closed for non-audio inputs, so text, image, and video pathways remain unchanged. The embedding is Matryoshka-nested with a default 1024-dimensional readout. Total pretraining data covers about 888.8K clips, and the added lexical-speech round contributes roughly 150K spoken-word clips, 70K read-speech clips, plus audiobook data. Pretraining uses a frozen-text memory bank, false-negative masking, and soft labels.

The paper’s real contribution is how it rules out alternative explanations and turns the “discriminative axis” idea into a testable mechanism. First, it establishes the capability trade-off induced by lexical speech: keyword recognition rises sharply while emotion recognition drops. Second, it uses a much smaller prosody-controlled corpus, Crema-D, to show that emotion can be recovered quickly, so the issue is not representational capacity. Third, it constructs a matched-exposure negative control using 29,428 mined clips whose captions explicitly name emotions; this produces essentially no emotion recovery, showing that explicit textual mention is not sufficient. Fourth, it rules out representational truncation and broad collateral degradation: truncation explains only a small fraction of the gap, and a nine-task board shows no general collapse. Finally, the authors define a separability statistic computed from the corpus itself to estimate whether an attribute is required for negative separation, and they validate the mechanism causally by restructuring the same audio so that emotion becomes the required discriminative axis. Emotion performance recovers under this intervention, whereas merely increasing in-batch caption similarity does not.

Compared with typical work, this is not a new loss or a larger model. It is a careful decomposition of “data quality” into a more precise variable: whether the training corpus structurally forces the model to rely on the target attribute during contrastive discrimination.
summary_en.experiments:
There are four key result blocks. First, after adding the lexical-speech round, zero-shot keyword spotting improves by 76 points, while speech-emotion recognition drops by 14 points. Evaluation is done on SpeechCommands (35-way keyword spotting) and Ravdess from the MAEB audio embedding benchmark in the MTEB framework, using shared-space matching between audio embeddings and class-text embeddings.

Second, the capacity explanation is directly rejected. Starting from the same post-speech checkpoint and using a fixed fine-tuning recipe—batch size 128, peak learning rate 3e-5, no gradient accumulation, false-negative masking and soft labels disabled—the authors fine-tune on Crema-D, a prosody-controlled corpus with only 7,442 clips. After just 150 steps, emotion rises from 0.211 to 0.508, surpassing the pre-speech level of 0.348, while keyword accuracy only falls to 0.845, still far above the pre-speech level. At 400 steps, the trade-off worsens, suggesting that the shorter schedule is the better operating point. The paper also quantifies the exchange rate: around 150 steps, roughly six emotion points are recovered per keyword point lost; between 150 and 400 steps, that rate drops to about two.

Third, the data-volume explanation is also rejected. Fine-tuning on 29,428 mined clips with captions that explicitly mention emotion, under matched exposure, changes emotion by only -0.0007—effectively zero. So more data, even with explicit attribute naming, does not trigger attribute learning.

Fourth, the mechanism is tested more directly. Representational truncation recovers only about 18% of the gap, and a nine-task board shows no broad degradation that could hide a positive effect. Most importantly, when the same audio is reorganized so that emotion becomes the required discriminative axis, emotion improves by +0.089 on average across three seeds. By contrast, simply increasing in-batch caption similarity does not produce the same recovery. This is the crucial control that separates “more similar text supervision” from “a corpus structure that forces reliance on emotion.”
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim-level read, focus on the causal chain rather than the audio specifics. Start with the Introduction and Section 4 to verify that the phenomenon is genuinely nontrivial: two speech tasks move in opposite directions under the same added supervision. Then read Sections 5 and 6 carefully. These are the core elimination steps: not capacity, not data volume. Pay close attention to Table 2, Figure 2, and Table 4, and map checkpoint choice, step count, corpus size, and metric movement. After that, jump to Section 9 for the separability statistic and then Section 11 for the intervention experiment; this is where the paper moves from observational evidence to a causal test. Tables 8 and 9 plus Figure 4 are the most informative artifacts. Sections 7 and 8 can be read quickly to confirm that truncation and collateral damage were checked.

If your work touches pretraining data or contrastive learning, the most useful questions to carry while reading are: how batch negatives determine which attributes survive in the representation; why explicit attribute naming in captions is still insufficient; and whether the separability statistic can transfer to image-text, video-text, speech-text, or broader data-mixture design. A solid skim should take about 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 反常识的对比学习机制发现，直接挑战数据堆量的默认思路，重点看§3因果干预实验，结论可迁移到多模态预训练数据构造
recommendation.en: Counter-intuitive contrastive learning finding that challenges default data scaling intuition, focus on §3 causal intervention experiments, results transfer directly to multimodal pretraining data design

paper.title: Beyond Rephrasing: Book-Level Organization Improves Synthetic Textbook Data for Mid-Training
paper.abstract: Synthetic textbook data has improved language model pre-training, but prior work largely treats the benefit as a property of generated content or local rewriting style. We study a different factor: whether related content is organized into coherent book-level documents. We contribute both a scalable synthesis pipeline and controlled evidence that this organization matters. The pipeline retrieves source material from a pre-training corpus, clusters it into topical units, plans hierarchical tables

summary.core_problem: 现有合成教科书数据研究大多将收益归因于生成内容本身或局部改写风格，未系统研究「相关内容是否被组织为连贯的书籍级文档」这一独立变量——包括生成阶段的全局结构规划，以及训练阶段是否保留完整书籍的文档边界、连续位置编码和文档内注意力（而非拆分为独立段落）。
summary.importance: 属于预训练数据方向的核心贡献，具备范式级影响：1）首次通过严格控制变量实验证明，书籍级结构化组织本身（而非内容质量、文档长度、局部改写）是合成教科书提升mid-training效果的核心来源；2）提供了可扩展的检索驱动书籍级合成数据流水线，产出覆盖15000+学科的32B token高质量mid-training语料；3）为预训练数据工程提供了新的设计原则——长程结构化的文档组织（而非碎片化段落堆叠）可显著提升模型能力，将改变后续合成预训练数据的构造范式。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是五阶段的检索驱动合成流水线，分为两大阶段：
Phase I（知识提取，步骤0-2）：1）构建四层学科分类体系，前三层（62个L1/754个L2/2730个L3节点）来自中国国家标准学科分类，通过LLM将L3扩展为12657个L4子领域，再经LLM辅助去重后最终覆盖15387个学科；2）对每个叶子学科，用LLM生成10-15个陈述式查询（覆盖核心概念、方法、应用、局限等角度），选择陈述式是因为其更匹配预训练文本的 declarative 语域，预实验显示聚类保留率更高；3）每个查询从预训练语料检索top100段落，聚合同一学科的所有查询结果并去重，再聚类为主题单元。
Phase II（结构化生成，步骤3-4）：4）基于主题单元规划分层目录（TOC）并做质量过滤；5）按TOC基于检索源材料生成各章节内容，组装为完整书籍，同时支持不同受众、不同风格的多变体生成以保证分布多样性。
为隔离变量设计四个对照设置：Full（保留完整TOC规划的书籍为单个训练文档）、Split（与Full使用完全相同的生成章节和token预算，但每个章节作为独立文档、重置位置编码和文档内注意力）、RandomConcat（将Split的章节跨书籍随机拼接以匹配Full的长度分布，分离文档长度与规划相邻性的影响）、Rephrase（从同一检索池独立改写单个文档，不做聚类、TOC规划和书籍组装，控制内容与风格变量）。
summary.experiments: 1）语料规模：生成68.6万本教科书，共32B token，覆盖15000+学科；2）主实验：在mid-training混合语料中用Full语料替换自然书籍部分，28个基准的平均得分提升+1.09；3）控制变量：Full consistently优于三个对照组，Split排除了内容本身的影响，RandomConcat排除了纯文档长度的影响，Rephrase排除了局部改写的影响，确认书籍级结构化组织是增益核心；4）组件消融：检索接地、聚类引导的TOC规划、分层生成三个设计互补，缺一不可；5）架构泛化：增益在两种不同模型架构上均成立；6）幻觉控制：每个生成阶段均做检索接地，降低事实错误。
summary.reading_guide: 精读建议：1）先读引言前两段的核心假设，明确「将组织结构作为独立变量研究」的创新性；2）重点关注第3节的控制变量实验设计（四个对照组的定义），这是论文结论可信的核心，结合图1的流水线示意图理解各阶段作用；3）仔细看第4节的主实验表和控制变量消融表，重点关注Full与各对照组的性能差值，以及推理、知识、代码等不同基准类别的增益差异；4）可深挖的方向：不同学科的增益差异、TOC层级深度对效果的影响、书籍长度的最优区间，以及该组织原则是否可迁移到通用预训练语料构造（而非仅mid-training合成教科书）。

summary_en.core_problem: Prior research on synthetic textbook data for LLM training mostly attributes performance gains to generated content quality or local rewriting style, without systematically studying an independent variable: whether related content is organized into coherent book-level documents. This covers both global structural planning during generation, and whether complete book boundaries, continuous position embeddings, and intra-document attention are preserved during training (instead of splitting books into isolated passages).
summary_en.importance: This is a core contribution in the pretraining_data domain with paradigm-level implications: 1) It delivers the first rigorously controlled evidence that book-level structural organization itself (rather than content quality, document length, or local rewriting) is the primary source of synthetic textbooks' effectiveness in mid-training; 2) It provides a scalable retrieval-grounded pipeline for book-level synthetic data, producing a 32B-token high-quality mid-training corpus covering 15,000+ disciplines; 3) It introduces a new design principle for pretraining data engineering: long-range structured document organization (not fragmented passage stacks) delivers measurable capability gains, which will reshape future synthetic pretraining data construction paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core is a five-stage retrieval-grounded synthesis pipeline split into two phases:
Phase I (Knowledge Extraction, Steps 0-2): 1) A four-level discipline taxonomy: the first three levels (62 L1 / 754 L2 / 2,730 L3 nodes) are adopted from the Chinese National Standard of Discipline Classification; L3 nodes are expanded into 12,657 fine-grained L4 subfields via LLM, followed by LLM-assisted deduplication under each L2 node to cover 15,387 total disciplines. 2) For each leaf discipline, an LLM generates 10-15 statement-form queries covering core concepts, methods, applications, and limitations; statement-form queries are chosen because they match the declarative register of pretraining text and deliver higher cluster retention rates in pilot tests. 3) Each query retrieves the top 100 passages from the pretraining corpus, passages from all queries of the same discipline are aggregated, deduplicated, and clustered into thematic units.
Phase II (Structured Generation, Steps 3-4): 4) Hierarchical tables of contents (TOCs) are planned based on thematic units with quality filtering applied. 5) Source-grounded section content is generated per TOC entry and assembled into complete books, with multi-variant generation across different audiences and writing styles to ensure distributional diversity.
Four controlled settings are designed to isolate variables: Full (retain each TOC-planned textbook as a single training document), Split (use identical generated sections and token budget as Full, but treat each section as an independent document with reset position embeddings and intra-document attention), RandomConcat (randomly concatenate Split sections across books to match Full's length distribution, separating the effect of planned adjacency from raw document length), and Rephrase (independently rewrite individual documents from the same retrieval pool under matched audience/style constraints, without clustering, TOC planning, or book assembly).
summary_en.experiments: 1) Corpus scale: 686K textbooks totaling 32B tokens, covering 15,000+ disciplines. 2) Main result: Replacing the natural-book portion of a mid-training mix with the Full corpus improves average performance across 28 benchmarks by +1.09. 3) Controlled comparisons: Full consistently outperforms all three controls; Split rules out content-only effects, RandomConcat rules out raw document length effects, and Rephrase rules out local rewriting effects, confirming book-level structural organization as the core gain source. 4) Component ablation: Retrieval grounding, cluster-informed TOC planning, and hierarchical generation are complementary, each delivering non-trivial gains. 5) Architecture generalization: Gains hold across two distinct model architectures. 6) Hallucination mitigation: Retrieval grounding is applied at every generation stage to reduce factual errors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Close reading recommendation: 1) Start with the core hypothesis in the first two paragraphs of the Introduction to grasp the novelty of studying structural organization as an independent variable. 2) Focus on the controlled experimental design (four comparison settings) in Section 3 — this is the foundation of the paper's credible conclusions, paired with the pipeline illustration in Figure 1. 3) Examine the main result tables and controlled ablation tables in Section 4, with special attention to performance gaps between Full and each control, and gain variations across benchmark categories (reasoning, knowledge, coding, etc.). 4) Deep dive points: Check gain variations across different disciplines, the impact of TOC hierarchy depth on performance, optimal book length ranges, and whether the organizational principle can be extended to general pretraining corpus construction (not just mid-training synthetic textbooks).

recommendation.zh: 受控消融做得干净，把“合成书有用”归因到文档级组织而非内容，应立刻在自己的 mid-training 数据里复现这个边界条件。
recommendation.en: Clean controlled ablation attributing synthetic-textbook gains to document-level organization, not content; worth reproducing in your own mid-training mix.

paper.title: Harnessing the Potential of Optimizing Data Mixtures via Bayesian Domain Reweighting
paper.abstract: The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is fundamentally influenced by the distributional composition of multi-domain pre-training data. While manual heuristics were prevalent in early models, they increasingly fail to capture the intricate synergies between domains as data complexity grows. To overcome the issue, a dominant approach seeks to fit a proxy function mapping between domain weights and their corresponding validation losses, and then find the optimal domain weights to minimize

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是预训练数据配比的在线优化问题：如何在不完整遍历大规模语料的情况下，稳定、低成本地学到多域数据的 mixing weights。现有函数拟合类方法依赖 rank invariance、scaling law 等结构假设，小规模试验得到的域重要性在放大到完整训练时会偏移。DoReMi 这类直接优化方法少一些建模假设，但在 one-pass 预训练里权重轨迹振荡明显，收敛慢，成本接近完整预训练。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发主要在两个点。第一，它把 data mixture 从确定性权重搜索改成带不确定性的概率推断，适合处理训练早期信号噪声大、域间收益随 token budget 改变的问题。第二，它关注的是可执行的成本约束，而不是只追求最终权重最优。对于真实预训练，mixture search 的试验预算通常很小，能否用 1% 左右训练成本给出可靠方向，比在小模型小数据上拟合漂亮曲线更有用。贡献量级属于数据配比方法上的有意义改进，但还不是完整替代大规模 mixture ablation 的方案。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法 ByDoRe 将域权重 w 建模为 Dirichlet 分布，而不是直接维护一个确定性 simplex 向量。这样做的动机是：在线训练中每个域的损失和梯度信号都有很强噪声，确定性更新容易把短期波动当作长期域价值，导致权重来回震荡。Dirichlet 分布提供了对权重不确定性的表达，相当于在更新时引入概率平滑。论文进一步使用 Gamma-Dirichlet 分层贝叶斯模型，用 Gamma 先验约束 Dirichlet 参数。为避免手工设定先验，又引入 prior prediction network，根据训练过程中观测到的数据和域级信号自适应预测 Gamma 先验的超参数。这接近 empirical Bayes 的思路：先验不是固定常数，而是由当前训练状态估计。与 RegMix、AutoScale、MDE 这类先拟合 mixture-to-loss 代理函数的方法相比，ByDoRe 不把小数据阶段的域排序假定为可迁移；与 DoReMi 相比，它没有直接追逐每一步的域损失差异，而是用分布参数吸收短期振荡。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕 The Pile 多域预训练设定展开。论文强调两个成本数字：在通用下游零样本评测上，ByDoRe 用约 0.8% 的训练成本达到 RegMix 在 Pile 上训练得到的平均准确率；在特定目标下游任务上，用约 1.2% 的训练成本比 RegMix 高 5.2 个百分点。Figure 1 用来说明域重要性随数据规模变化会发生不一致偏移，这是函数拟合类方法估计偏差的来源。Figure 2 展示 DoReMi 的权重轨迹振荡，以及 ByDoRe 更平滑的学习过程。Table 3 对比 RegMix、AutoScale、MDE 等方法在尺度迁移时的性能退化。给定摘录没有提供模型参数量、token 总量、各 benchmark 的完整分项数字，因此精读时需要回到实验表确认：proxy 训练成本如何定义，0.8%/1.2% 是否包含 prior predictor 训练，目标任务是否预先选定，以及 mixture learned on small budget 在不同模型规模上是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 RegMix、AutoScale、MDE、DoReMi 失败模式的拆解；看 Figure 1 和 Table 3，确认“域重要性不随规模保持排序”这个经验事实是否充分；看 Methods 中 Gamma-Dirichlet 层级模型和 prior prediction network 的输入、输出、更新频率；看 Figure 2，判断稳定性改善是来自贝叶斯建模，还是来自额外平滑和更新节奏。实验部分需要特别检查训练成本口径、域划分数量、目标验证集选择方式，以及是否存在对特定下游任务调 mixture 的风险。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies online optimization of pretraining data mixtures: how to learn stable domain weights for a multi-domain corpus without spending a near-full pretraining run. Proxy-fitting methods often assume rank invariance or scaling-law structure, but domain importance can shift with data scale. Direct methods such as DoReMi avoid some of these assumptions, yet their deterministic weights fluctuate heavily in one-pass LLM training and converge slowly.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea for pretraining is to treat mixture search as noisy inference rather than deterministic weight fitting. This matters because early domain-level losses are high-variance signals, and the value of a domain can change with token budget. The paper is also framed around a realistic constraint: mixture search must be cheap enough to run before the real training job. The contribution is a meaningful improvement in data-mixture optimization, especially for low-budget search, but it should still be validated against larger-scale mixture ablations.
summary_en.technical_approach: ByDoRe models the domain-weight vector as a Dirichlet distribution instead of a fixed point on the simplex. The uncertainty in the Dirichlet parameters acts as a stabilizer when domain losses oscillate during online training. The method further introduces a Gamma-Dirichlet hierarchical Bayesian model: Gamma priors guide the Dirichlet parameters, and a prior prediction network estimates the Gamma hyperparameters from observed training signals. This is close to an empirical-Bayes design. Compared with RegMix, AutoScale, and MDE, ByDoRe does not rely on transferring a small-scale mixture-to-loss fit to the full-scale run. Compared with DoReMi, it does not chase per-step domain loss changes directly; it uses a distributional parameterization to absorb short-term noise.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are centered on The Pile. The reported headline results are cost-oriented: ByDoRe reaches the average general-purpose downstream accuracy of RegMix with about 0.8% of the training cost, and improves targeted zero-shot downstream accuracy over RegMix by 5.2 percentage points with about 1.2% of the training cost. Figure 1 supports the claim that domain importance profiles shift with data scale. Figure 2 compares the unstable DoReMi trajectory with the smoother ByDoRe trajectory. Table 3 is used to show degradation of proxy-based methods under scale transfer. The provided text does not expose the full model sizes, token counts, or per-task numbers, so the key checks are the exact cost accounting, whether prior-predictor training is included, and how target validation tasks are selected.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure modes of RegMix, AutoScale, MDE, and DoReMi. Inspect Figure 1 and Table 3 to judge whether the scale-shift evidence is strong. In the method section, focus on the Gamma-Dirichlet hierarchy, the inputs and outputs of the prior prediction network, and the update schedule. In the experiments, check the definition of the 0.8% and 1.2% training cost, the number of domains, the validation set design, and whether the learned mixture is robust across model scales.

recommendation.zh: 数据配比是预训练核心性能杠杆，贝叶斯思路避开了代理法的强假设，值得在内部小范围ablation验证
recommendation.en: Data mixture is a core pretraining performance lever; this Bayesian approach avoids strong assumptions of proxy-based methods, worth small-scale internal ablation

paper.title: CG-World: A Large-Scale World-State Dataset and Protocol for World Models
paper.abstract: World models must learn the joint dynamics of states, actions, events, and observations, yet existing video, robotics, and simulation datasets usually capture only part of this structure. We introduce CG-World, a large-scale world-state dataset and protocol derived from industrial computer graphics production pipelines. CG-World explicitly records intermediate states, including multimodal semantics, spatial structure, skeletal and controller states, motion curves, camera and lighting parameters,

summary.core_problem: 为 world model 预训练提供同时包含状态、动作、事件、观测和分支关系的大规模时序数据，而不是只提供视频帧或机器人轨迹。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据与协议。它把工业 CG 生产管线中的中间状态显式导出，补齐了现有视频、机器人、仿真数据只覆盖部分因果结构的问题；对多模态 world model、具身模型、反事实学习的数据设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: CG-World 从计算机图形生产流程中抽取 temporally aligned samples，记录语义、空间结构、骨骼与控制器状态、运动曲线、相机与光照、物理缓存、接触事件、多通道渲染等中间变量，并将 latent states、observations、relations、events、branch metadata 分层组织。协议还定义 factual trajectories、observation interventions、action interventions、mechanism interventions 和 strict counterfactual branches，用于支持干预和反事实建模。
summary.experiments: CG-World v1 包含约 85 万个 1-5 秒的时间对齐片段。摘要没有给出模型规模、训练 recipe 或具体 benchmark 数字；重点是数据覆盖范围、结构化 schema 和干预分支协议。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a large-scale temporal dataset for world-model pretraining that exposes states, actions, events, observations, and branch structure instead of only rendered video or robot trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a data and protocol contribution. By exporting intermediate variables from industrial CG pipelines, it addresses the partial-observability problem in common video, robotics, and simulation datasets, and is relevant to multimodal world models, embodied modeling, and counterfactual data design.
summary_en.technical_approach: CG-World extracts temporally aligned samples from computer-graphics production pipelines, including semantics, spatial structure, skeleton and controller states, motion curves, camera and lighting parameters, physics caches, contact events, and multi-pass renderings. It separates latent states, observations, relations, events, and branch metadata, and defines factual, observation-intervention, action-intervention, mechanism-intervention, and strict counterfactual lineages.
summary_en.experiments: CG-World v1 contains roughly 850,000 aligned segments of 1-5 seconds. The abstract does not report model scale, training setup, or benchmark numbers; the main evidence is dataset scale, schema coverage, and the intervention protocol.

recommendation.zh: 预训练研究员可只读数据 schema 和 branch lineage；它提醒 world-model 数据不能再只存 RGB 结果。
recommendation.en: For pretraining work, read the schema and branch-lineage design; the useful signal is that world-model data should not stop at RGB outcomes.

paper.title: DenseOn with the LateOn: Fully Open Dense and Late-Interaction Models for Multilingual, Long-Context, and Code Search
paper.abstract: State-of-the-art retrieval models increasingly rely on closed training data, creating a reproducibility gap. We present an open end-to-end recipe for training retrieval models and study how English supervision transfers to multilingual retrieval through translate-train. We first reconstruct and curate 665M English contrastive pre-training pairs from 1.4B pairs across 34 public sources and build 1.88M supervised fine-tuning pairs with mined hard negatives. Training yields two 149M-parameter model

summary.core_problem: 构建完全开放的检索模型训练配方，缓解强检索器依赖闭源训练数据导致的可复现性问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是数据与训练 recipe：公开重建大规模对比预训练对、监督微调对和 hard negatives，并比较 dense 与 late-interaction 检索器在多语言、长上下文和代码检索中的迁移行为。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 34 个公开来源的 14 亿英文 pair 中重建和清洗 6.65 亿对比预训练 pair，再构建 188 万监督微调 pair 和 mined hard negatives；训练 DenseOn 单向量 dense retriever 与 LateOn ColBERT-style late-interaction retriever，并通过 translate-train 扩展到 8 种语言和跨语言样本。
summary.experiments: 训练两个 149M 参数英文模型 DenseOn 和 LateOn，在 BEIR 上平均 nDCG@10 分别为 56.20 和 57.22，在同等规模段达到很强结果。多语言阶段产生 28 亿 pair，训练基于 mmBERT-base 的 307M 参数 mDenseOn 和 mLateOn。摘要称两者使用相同 backbone、数据和目标，但表示行为不同。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a fully open recipe for retrieval-model training to address the reproducibility gap caused by closed retriever training data.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is data and training recipe: large-scale reconstructed contrastive pairs, supervised fine-tuning pairs, mined hard negatives, and a comparison of dense versus late-interaction retrievers across multilingual, long-context, and code search.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors reconstruct and curate 665M English contrastive pretraining pairs from 1.4B pairs across 34 public sources, build 1.88M supervised fine-tuning pairs with hard negatives, and train DenseOn and LateOn. They then use translate-train to create multilingual and cross-lingual samples across eight languages.
summary_en.experiments: The English models are 149M parameters: DenseOn reaches 56.20 average nDCG@10 on BEIR and LateOn reaches 57.22. The multilingual setup contains 2.8B pairs and trains 307M-parameter mDenseOn and mLateOn on mmBERT-base. The abstract reports different representation behavior despite shared backbone, data, and objectives.

recommendation.zh: 检索器不是基座 LM，但开放数据清洗和 translate-train 配方可复用；看数据构建和 BEIR 表即可。
recommendation.en: Not base-LM work, but the open data curation and translate-train recipe are reusable; read data construction and BEIR tables.

paper.title: CuraWeb: Joint Optimization of Quality, Redundancy, and Diversity for Web-Scale Pretraining Data
paper.abstract: Open-web corpora curated via highly selective filters, such as FineWeb-Edu and DCLM, constitute the core of LLM pretraining data and have significantly advanced LLM performance. However, these pipelines typically rely on singular optimization objectives, which inevitably narrows distributional diversity and marginalizes long-tail knowledge, thereby restricting data coverage and underutilizing the vast potential of the open web. To address this limitation, we propose a novel curation paradigm tha

summary.core_problem: CuraWeb 解决的是 web-scale 预训练数据筛选中的单目标偏置问题。FineWeb-Edu、DCLM 这类流程通常用一个质量分类器或单一质量信号做强过滤，能提升平均文本质量，但会压窄分布、多次放大同一种偏差，并损失长尾知识。CuraWeb 把清洗、去重、采样放到同一组多维信号下优化，目标是在质量、冗余和多样性之间做可控折中。
summary.importance: 这是预训练数据方向值得精读的工作，因为它把“高质量过滤”推进到“多目标数据治理”。贡献不只是又做了一个 corpus，而是明确指出：stage-wise pipeline 如果每一步都追逐同一个质量分数，会在 cleaning、dedup、sampling 中连续削掉相同类型的数据。对基座训练的影响主要有三点。第一，web 数据不应只按教育质量或写作风格排序，还要显式保留领域覆盖和 token diversity。第二，去重不能只看 exact / n-gram overlap，web 中大量模板化页面和近阈值重复会绕过传统 LSH。第三，采样阶段应承担分布塑形，而不是简单从过滤后的池子里均匀抽样。这个量级属于 pretraining data recipe 级别的贡献，对 1T-token 规模训练有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线是一个端到端 CuraWeb curation framework。原始数据来自 2013–2024 年的 12 年 Common Crawl snapshots。先用 Resiliparse 从 WARC 抽取正文，去掉 header、footer 和广告噪声；再用 FastText 语言分类器保留 English confidence > 0.5 的文档；exact dedup 用全局 SHA-256 文档哈希；随后用扩展 URL blacklist 去掉 spam 和成人内容域。这个基础漏斗从 184.9B raw documents 压到 41.4B unique documents，保留率 22.4%；URL blacklist 后得到 39.1B documents，保留率 94.5%。
