核心创新有三块。第一是 dual-track cleaning。规则过滤不再使用统一阈值，而是根据 domain 调整阈值，避免数学、代码等高价值领域因符号密度、长度分布或格式特征被误杀。模型驱动部分使用 data understanding model 给文档打多维标签，包括 writing quality、content value 和 domain tags。第二是 hybrid deduplication。传统 n-gram / LSH 能处理显性重复，但对两类 hidden redundancy 不够：一种是 templatized clusters，即页面结构高度相同但局部参数不同；另一种是 redundant crawling，即相似度刚好落在 LSH 阈值下方的重复抓取。CuraWeb 用 soft semantic deduplication 和 weighted voting：不是单条相似边超过阈值就删除，而是累计多个相似边的 penalty score，超过总阈值才判为冗余。这样比硬阈值更不容易误删边界样本。第三是 multi-objective sampling。writing quality 用 harmonic mean 聚合，因为任何一个严重缺陷都应显著拉低分数；content value 用线性求和，因为专业性、信息密度等维度可以累加贡献；再把质量指标与 diversity score 结合，保证 domain coverage。最终采用 Power Sampling，提高高信息量文档的抽样概率，同时不把分布完全压成单一高分区域。
summary.experiments: 数据漏斗数字清楚：184.9B raw documents 经 SHA-256 exact dedup 后得到 41.4B unique documents，保留率 22.4%；URL blacklist 后为 39.1B documents，保留率 94.5%。语义去重部分报告了一个关键消融：在最高相似度区间，soft semantic deduplication 将 false positive rate 从 37.5% 降到 28.03%，说明 weighted voting 比硬阈值更稳。训练评估在 1T-token scale 上进行，比较对象包括 FineWeb-Edu、Dolma3 和 DCLM。作者报告 CuraWeb 在知识密集型任务和推理任务上更强，支持“质量—冗余—多样性联合优化”比单一质量过滤更有 token efficiency。给出的片段没有包含完整 benchmark 表格和逐项提升数字，精读时需要回到实验表确认每类任务的收益分布，以及是否存在通用语言能力或代码/数学能力之间的 trade-off。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读，预计 60–90 分钟。优先看五个部分。第一，数据漏斗统计图，确认每一步保留率、过滤强度和最终池子的规模。第二，pre-training data understanding system，重点看 quality score、content value、domain tag 的定义、标注模型来源和校准方式；这决定了后续优化是否可靠。第三，domain-specific cleaning thresholds，关注哪些规则从全局阈值改成了领域阈值，以及数学、代码、学术文本是否被特别处理。第四，semantic dedup 的 weighted voting 公式和误删分析，尤其是 templatized clusters 与 near-threshold redundant crawling 的案例。第五，sampling objective 和 1T-token 训练结果，重点看 Power Sampling 的指数或温度参数、diversity score 的计算方式、以及和 FineWeb-Edu / DCLM 的逐 benchmark 差异。值得深挖的问题是：多维质量模型本身是否引入新的偏差；semantic dedup 的相似度模型在不同领域是否等价可靠；Power Sampling 在继续扩大 token budget 时是否会导致高分文档重复暴露过多。

summary_en.core_problem: CuraWeb addresses a central failure mode in web-scale pretraining data curation: overly selective, single-objective filtering improves average text quality but narrows the distribution, compounds bias across cleaning, deduplication, and sampling, and removes long-tail knowledge that can matter for general model capability.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining-data recipe paper rather than just another web corpus release. Its main contribution is the shift from quality-only pruning to joint control of quality, redundancy, and diversity. For foundation model training, the message is practical: a high-quality classifier is not enough. The same quality signal, if reused across all stages, can repeatedly suppress the same domains and styles. CuraWeb instead treats sampling as distribution shaping, treats semantic redundancy as a first-class issue, and keeps domain coverage visible throughout the pipeline. The work is directly relevant to 1T-token-scale pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The pipeline starts from twelve years of Common Crawl snapshots from 2013 to 2024. Main-body text is extracted from WARC files with Resiliparse, removing headers, footers, and advertisement noise. A FastText language classifier keeps English documents with confidence above 0.5. Global SHA-256 hashing performs exact document deduplication, reducing 184.9B raw documents to 41.4B unique documents, a 22.4% retention rate. An extended URL blacklist then removes spam and adult domains, leaving 39.1B documents with a 94.5% retention rate after that stage.

The main design has three components. First, dual-track cleaning combines domain-aware heuristic rules with model-driven document understanding. Instead of applying uniform thresholds, the rules are calibrated per domain so that math, code, and other structurally unusual but useful content are not removed simply because they violate generic web-text statistics. A data understanding model annotates documents with multi-aspect writing quality, content value, and domain tags. Second, hybrid deduplication combines n-gram-style filtering with semantic deduplication. The paper highlights two hard cases: templatized clusters, where pages share a structural skeleton but differ in local parameters, and redundant crawling cases that fall just below an LSH threshold. CuraWeb uses a soft semantic deduplication strategy based on weighted voting over multiple similarity edges. A document is removed only when its accumulated penalty exceeds a threshold, which reduces over-filtering compared with hard similarity cutoffs. Third, multi-objective sampling combines writing quality, content value, and diversity. Writing quality is aggregated with a harmonic mean to penalize severe defects on any single dimension. Content value is summed linearly to reward expertise and information density. A diversity score is added to preserve domain coverage, and Power Sampling increases the probability of selecting high-value documents without collapsing the sample into a narrow high-score slice.
summary_en.experiments: The reported scale is substantial. Exact SHA-256 deduplication reduces 184.9B raw documents to 41.4B unique documents, and blacklist filtering leaves 39.1B documents. In the semantic deduplication analysis, the soft weighted-voting strategy reduces the false positive rate from 37.5% to 28.03% in the highest-similarity interval, indicating better behavior near ambiguous duplication boundaries. The pretraining evaluation is conducted at the 1T-token scale and compares CuraWeb against strong web-data baselines including FineWeb-Edu, Dolma3, and DCLM. The reported gains are concentrated in knowledge-intensive and reasoning benchmarks. The provided text does not include the full benchmark tables, so exact per-task deltas should be checked in the experimental section before drawing conclusions about capability trade-offs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully, around 60–90 minutes. Start with the data funnel figure to understand retention rates and where most pruning happens. Then inspect the data understanding system: the definitions of writing quality, content value, domain tags, model source, and calibration procedure are central to the method. The domain-specific cleaning rules are worth checking because they determine whether specialized data such as math and code survive the first pass. The semantic deduplication section is the technical core; focus on the weighted-voting formulation, the treatment of templatized clusters, and the false-positive analysis. Finally, read the sampling objective and 1T-token evaluation tables together. Key questions to track are whether the quality model introduces its own bias, whether semantic similarity behaves consistently across domains, and whether Power Sampling remains stable as the token budget increases.

recommendation.zh: 数据构建范式从「质量优先线性剪枝」转向「质量-冗余-多样性联合优化」的代表性工作，做预训练数据的人应立刻对标其多目标采样器设计。
recommendation.en: A representative work shifting data curation from quality-first linear pruning to joint quality–redundancy–diversity optimization. Anyone working on pretraining data should immediately benchmark against its multi-objective sampler design.

paper.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
paper.abstract: Pretraining data processing is critical to the downstream performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, many existing approaches define a fixed processing strategy at the corpus or domain level and apply it uniformly to many examples, without adapting to the needs of each example. We propose DataOrchestra, a framework that unifies different processing operations and orchestrates an example-specific pipeline for each example. Given a chunk of pretraining data, an orchestrator decides whet

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决的是预训练数据清洗中的“逐样本决策”问题：不同文本块需要不同处理，有的应丢弃，有的应保持不动，有的只需去噪，有的需要重写或教学化增强。固定清洗流水线会浪费算力，也容易把高质量样本改坏；单一 LLM 改写提示又难以覆盖不同类型的数据缺陷。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发在于，它把 LLM-based data curation 从“统一规则或统一流水线”推进到“可学习的数据处理策略”。贡献不在某一个清洗算子，而在调度层：如何为每个样本选择 drop、untouch、noise pruning、surface rectification、pedagogical augmentation 的组合，并控制改写目标。这个方向直接影响大规模预训练的数据效率和数据风险管理，尤其是当 LLM 改写被用于万亿 token 级语料处理时，调度策略比单个改写模型更接近实际瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: DataOrchestra 由一个 orchestrator 和若干 tool model 组成。输入一个文本 chunk 后，orchestrator 先判断 drop、untouch 还是 clean；若需要 clean，再选择要执行的处理阶段，并为涉及 LLM 改写的阶段生成样本级 instruction。三个主要处理动作是：noise pruning，用于删除广告、导航栏、HTML 残留等行级噪声；surface rectification，用于修复格式、语法、表格、破碎 token 等表层问题；pedagogical augmentation，用于对数学、百科、推理类文本补充解释或提高教学性。训练方式也值得看：先用 teacher LLM 生成初始处理计划，再实际调用下游 tool model 执行，然后根据执行结果做 plan evolution。若某个阶段改动很小或损害原文，就移除；若输出丢信息、引入事实错误或仍有噪声，就细化改写指令。这样得到 300K 个训练样本，用来微调 orchestrator。关键区别是，计划不是只依赖 teacher 的静态判断，而是用 tool model 的真实执行反馈来校正。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四类常见 web 预训练数据：RedPajama-V2、DCLM-RefinedWeb、C4、FineWeb。tool model 控制在 4B 以内，包括 0.6B noise pruning model 和 Qwen3-4B rewrite model。作者从头预训练 0.5B 到 7B 模型，并在 11 个 benchmark 上报告相对单一数据处理方法的稳定平均收益。该框架还用于数学 continued pretraining，处理 OpenWebMath 和 MegaMath，并在科学推理 benchmark 上带来提升。对比对象包括：只做单一操作的方法、用 fastText 过滤并混合 rewritten data 与原始语料的改写方法、以及若干固定多阶段 pipeline。结果显示 DataOrchestra 在质量上更好，同时通过跳过不必要阶段降低处理算力。给出的全文片段没有包含具体分数表，因此不应过度解读提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。重点看 Introduction 的 Figure 1，它把三个痛点讲得很清楚：单一操作不够、固定 pipeline 浪费且可能破坏样本、统一 prompt 不适配不同文本。方法部分应重点看 orchestrator 的输出空间、plan evolution 的验证规则、300K 训练样本的构造流程。实验部分建议关注两点：一是从头预训练的设置是否足够排除 proxy metric 偏差；二是 rewritten data 是否引入分布漂移、事实错误或风格同质化。若要复现或借鉴，最值得深挖的是执行反馈如何定义，以及不同处理阶段的触发分布。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets per-example decision making in pretraining data curation. Different chunks require different actions: some should be dropped, some left untouched, some lightly pruned, and some rewritten or pedagogically augmented. A fixed cleaning pipeline wastes compute and can damage already-good examples, while a single generic rewriting prompt cannot cover the diversity of web-data defects.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea for pretraining research is the policy layer above LLM-based data cleaning. The contribution is not a new individual cleaning operator, but a learned orchestrator that decides, for each example, whether to drop, keep, prune noise, rectify surface form, or add educational explanations. This matters when LLM rewriting is applied at pretraining scale: the main bottleneck is often deciding when and how to intervene, not only making the rewriting model stronger.
summary_en.technical_approach: DataOrchestra combines an orchestrator with downstream tool models. Given a text chunk, the orchestrator first chooses among drop, untouch, and clean. For examples to be cleaned, it selects a subset of processing stages and generates example-specific instructions for LLM rewriting stages. The stages include noise pruning for line-level boilerplate and ads, surface rectification for formatting and grammar repairs, and pedagogical augmentation for math, Wikipedia-like, or reasoning-heavy content. Training uses a teacher LLM to propose initial plans, executes those plans with the actual tool models, and then evolves the plans using execution feedback. Stages that make minimal changes or harm the original content are removed; instructions are refined when the output loses information, introduces factual errors, or leaves residual noise. This produces 300K training pairs for fine-tuning the orchestrator. The important design choice is grounding the policy in the observed behavior of the tool models, rather than relying only on a teacher model’s high-level plan.
summary_en.experiments: The framework is applied to RedPajama-V2, DCLM-RefinedWeb, C4, and FineWeb. The tool models are kept small: a 0.6B noise-pruning model and a Qwen3-4B rewriting model, with no tool model larger than 4B. The authors pretrain models from scratch in the 0.5B to 7B range and report stable average gains over single-operation data-processing baselines across 11 benchmarks. They also test math continued pretraining on OpenWebMath and MegaMath, with gains on scientific reasoning benchmarks. Baselines include single processing methods, rewriting methods that filter and mix rewritten data with the original corpus using fastText, and several fixed multi-stage pipelines. The provided text does not include the detailed result tables, so the magnitude of the gains should be read from the experimental section rather than inferred from the introduction.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is enough for the main idea. Figure 1 in the introduction is the best entry point because it shows why single operations, fixed pipelines, and shared prompts are insufficient. In the method section, focus on the orchestrator output space, the plan-evolution procedure, and how the 300K supervised examples are built. In the experiments, check whether the from-scratch pretraining setup is strong enough to avoid misleading proxy metrics. Also look for analyses of distribution shift, hallucination, and style homogenization caused by rewriting. For reuse, the most important details are the execution-feedback criteria and the empirical distribution of selected processing stages.

recommendation.zh: 从"规则清洗"走向"按样本编排清洗"是正确方向，值得看 §3 orchestrator 设计和 7B 结果表，但要警惕 LLM-rewrite 引入的分布偏差。
recommendation.en: The move from corpus-level rules to per-example curation policies is the right direction; read §3 and the 7B table, but watch for distribution drift introduced by LLM-based rewriting.

paper.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
paper.abstract: Multimodal foundation models learned to see and to speak by consuming the whole internet. Embodied agents admit no such shortcut, since they require data that couple observations with physical states and actions. These signals can be provided, to varying degrees, by multiple data sources. In this work, we organize the embodied data ecosystem as a "pyramid" spanning five complementary sources: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric data, simulation data, and general vision-lan

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是具身基础模型的数据组织问题：机器人预训练不能直接复用互联网文本和图像的规模化路径，因为它还需要状态、动作、接触、动力学和可执行监督。不同数据源在可扩展性、机器人对齐和物理真实性之间有明显取舍，但社区缺少一个稳定的分类框架来比较和组合这些数据。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练研究的直接价值不高，但对“多模态/具身预训练的数据配比”有启发。它把具身数据看成一个数据生态，而不是单一 robot trajectory 数据集问题。这个视角类似文本预训练里的 web、code、math、synthetic、high-quality corpus 配比问题：不同数据源提供不同训练信号，关键不只是数据量，而是信号是否能迁移到目标行为。局限也比较清楚：这是一篇数据中心视角的综述和框架整理，不提供新的 scaling law、训练配方或可复现实验结论。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是提出一个五层 Data Pyramid。自上而下分别是 real-robot data、UMI-style data、egocentric/exocentric human interaction data、simulation data、general vision-language data。排序依据是两个主轴：scalability 和 robot alignment。real-robot 数据最接近部署机器人，动作可直接执行，物理反馈真实，但采集成本高、重置和安全监督昂贵。UMI-style 数据去掉机器人本体，用手持或端执行器中心的采集方式保留操作轨迹，因此比真机数据更容易扩展，也比普通视频更接近可执行动作。ego/exo 视频覆盖人类交互、任务阶段和 affordance，但动作空间和机器人控制之间有映射缺口。simulation 可大规模生成带状态和动作的轨迹，但受资产、任务设计和 sim-to-real 差异限制。general vision-language 数据规模最大，提供语义和视觉先验，但缺少物理交互和动作监督。除两个主轴外，工作还用 quality、diversity、reusability、physical fidelity 四个维度解释为什么“更多数据”不一定带来更好的具身能力。
summary.experiments: 没有新的模型训练实验或严格消融。主要证据来自对已有 embodied foundation models 和代表性数据集的整理分析。文中强调的经验结论包括：真机数据的机器人对齐和物理真实性最高，但规模最受限；UMI-style 数据在可扩展性和可重定向性之间提供折中；人类第一/第三视角视频适合学习任务分解、手物交互和 affordance，但不能直接替代动作监督；仿真数据可控、便于自动生成失败和恢复轨迹，但物理细节、传感噪声和接触建模会影响迁移；通用图文/视频语言数据主要补语义和视觉知识，不能单独支撑操作策略学习。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 scalability 和 robot alignment 的定义，以及 Data Pyramid 的五层划分。图表部分如果包含数据集分布、不同数据源维度比较、近期模型数据配方对照，值得快速扫一遍。对预训练研究员更有用的是它的数据组织语言：如何把数据源按训练信号拆开，而不是只按模态或采集设备命名。无需细读所有具身模型案例，除非正在设计 VLA 或机器人 foundation model 的数据 mixture。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a data organization problem for embodied foundation models. Robot pretraining cannot simply copy the internet-scale recipe used for language and vision, because embodied agents need supervision over states, actions, contacts, dynamics, and executable behavior. Existing data sources provide these signals with different trade-offs, but the field lacks a clear framework for comparing and combining them.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not central to text LLM pretraining, but it is useful for thinking about data mixtures in embodied and multimodal pretraining. Its main contribution is a data-centric taxonomy: different sources are treated as different supervision channels rather than as interchangeable data pools. This is close in spirit to mixture design in LLM pretraining, where web text, code, math, synthetic data, and curated corpora contribute different gradients. The limitation is that the paper is a survey and framework piece; it does not introduce a new training recipe, scaling result, or controlled empirical law.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a five-level Data Pyramid: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric human interaction data, simulation data, and general vision-language data. The two primary axes are scalability and robot alignment. Real-robot data is directly aligned with the platform that produced it and has high physical fidelity, but it is expensive to collect and reset. UMI-style data removes the robot from the collection loop while retaining end-effector-centric manipulation signals, making it more scalable than robot demonstrations and more actionable than ordinary video. Human ego/exo video captures task structure, affordances, and hand-object interaction, but lacks robot-native action labels. Simulation provides controllable state-action trajectories, with transfer limited by assets, task coverage, and sim-to-real gaps. General vision-language data supplies broad semantic and perceptual priors but weak physical and action supervision. The paper further characterizes each source by quality, diversity, reusability, and physical fidelity.
summary_en.experiments: There are no new controlled training experiments. The evidence is mainly an organized analysis of representative datasets and recent embodied foundation models. The key observations are qualitative: real-robot data has the strongest execution alignment but the weakest scalability; UMI-style demonstrations offer a practical middle ground for manipulation; human videos are reusable for task decomposition and affordance learning but need action grounding; simulation is scalable and controllable but constrained by physical mismatch; general vision-language data helps perception and semantics but cannot replace interaction data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the definitions of scalability and robot alignment, the five-layer pyramid, and any tables or figures comparing data sources and model data recipes. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the data-mixture vocabulary: which supervision signal each source provides, what it fails to provide, and why scale alone is insufficient. The long catalog of embodied models can be read selectively unless you are actively designing a VLA or robot foundation model data pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫数据金字塔和模型配方表；它不能直接迁移到 LLM，但能校准多模态预训练里的“规模 vs 对齐”取舍。
recommendation.en: Skim the data pyramid and recipe tables; it will not transfer directly to LLMs, but it calibrates the scale-versus-alignment tradeoff in multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: From Data to Device: ELMOD An Efficient German-First 2.7B Language Model for Mobile Inference
paper.abstract: We present ELMOD - Efficient Language Model for On-Device Deployment - a compact (2.7B) German language model designed for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. ELMOD was trained on a limited computational budget (55k H100 GPU hours) using exclusively publicly available data. We developed a suite of German-specific data pre-processing, which differ from English-oriented counterparts in their handling of morphological variation, compounding, and orthographic conventions. Furthermo

summary.core_problem: 构建适合移动端资源受限硬件推理的高质量德语小语言模型，解决英语导向数据处理不适配德语形态、复合词、正字法特点的问题。
summary.importance: 特定语言的高效小模型预训练实践，贡献了德语专属的数据预处理与质量过滤方案，为小语种、端侧LM训练提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1）设计德语专属数据预处理流程，适配形态变化、复合词、正字法特点；2）引入质量过滤与改写步骤，提升数据教学质量，降低训练计算需求；3）结合架构与数据选择，在2.7B参数量下实现高性能。
summary.experiments: 模型参数量2.7B，训练算力55k H100 GPU小时，仅使用公开数据；德语任务性能为<3B规模最优，匹配7B参数模型的德语表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Build a high-quality small German language model suitable for inference on resource-constrained mobile hardware, addressing the mismatch between English-oriented data processing and German morphological, compounding, and orthographic features.
summary_en.importance: A practical pretraining case of a language-specific efficient small LM, contributing German-specific data preprocessing and quality filtering pipelines, providing reference for low-resource language and on-device LM training.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Design German-specific data preprocessing workflows adapted to morphological variation, compounding, and orthographic conventions; 2) Introduce a quality filtering and rephrasing step to improve data instructional quality and reduce training compute; 3) Combine architectural and data choices to achieve high performance at 2.7B parameters.
summary_en.experiments: 2.7B parameter model trained on 55k H100 GPU hours with exclusively public data; achieves top German performance among <3B models, matching the performance of 7B-parameter German models.

recommendation.zh: 德语端侧小模型的预训练实践，德语专属数据处理方案对小语种LM训练有参考价值，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Practical pretraining case of a German on-device small LM; German-specific data processing is referenceable for low-resource LM training, read abstract only.

paper.title: Content is What Remains: Invariant Speech Tokenization from Parallel Utterances
paper.abstract: Discrete speech tokenizers aim to disentangle semantic from acoustic information, yet targets from self-supervised learning (SSL) models like HuBERT retain non-linguistic variation: speaker identity, prosody, and channel conditions leak into the tokens, inflating entropy. Our key insight is that when enough speakers utter the same words under varying conditions, linguistic content is the only shared factor. We propose PINT (Parallel INvariant Tokenization), which fine-tunes an SSL encoder with a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是语音离散语义 token 的一个老问题：现有 tokenizer 虽然名义上在提取“语义”，但上游 SSL 表征里混入了大量非语言因素，尤其是说话人、韵律、情感、录制通道和噪声条件。结果是同一句话在不同说话人或不同声学条件下，会被编码成明显不同的 token 序列，导致 H(z|c) 居高不下。对语音 LM 来说，这不是小瑕疵，而是直接抬高序列熵、降低可压缩性、增加建模难度。作者的核心判断很明确：如果多个人在不同条件下说的是同一句内容，那么真正跨样本稳定存在的只剩 linguistic content；因此语义 tokenizer 不该继续被动继承 HuBERT/WavLM 的泄漏表征，而应显式利用 parallel utterances 去学习“内容不变、其余可变”的表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把语音 tokenizer 的好坏从“下游任务效果”重新拉回到“语言建模友好性”这个更基础的标准上：低条件熵、强可压缩性、对 AR LM 更可预测。这个视角和文本 tokenizer 的设计目标是对齐的。第二，它指出很多语音 codec / speech LM 系统的问题不一定在 decoder 或 codec 架构，而可能在 semantic target 本身就不干净；这意味着上游 token 质量可能是更强的瓶颈。第三，它给出了一条与 ASR 文本 token 不同的路线：不把语音压成文字，而是在保留帧级时间对齐的前提下，尽量逼近“只含内容”的离散表示。这对 AudioLM、Moshi、VALL-E 类系统，以及统一音频-文本 LM 的前端设计，都有直接启发。贡献量级上，这不是简单 probe 改善，而是同时在可分离性、ABX、压缩性和 LM perplexity 上形成一致收益，说明它触到了表示层面的关键约束。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，PINT 的设计很干净：从一个现成 SSL encoder 出发，利用真实 parallel speech 和伪 parallel augmentation 两类监督，把不同 realization 中共享的内容压出来。论文的关键不是重新发明 codec，而是把“语义目标”这件事单独拿出来优化。

训练数据分成几类。真实 parallel 语料来自 ARCTIC、CHAINS、CSTR-VCTK、EnDialects、ESD、TIMIT 等，覆盖不同说话人、口音、风格和情绪；非 parallel 语料用 LibriSpeech 960h、Tedlium-3 374h 扩展覆盖面，并通过同一语音的随机增强在线构造 pseudo-parallel 对；作者还用 Kokoro 合成额外 parallel 样本。这里的取舍很重要：只靠真实 parallel 数据，覆盖面不够；只靠增强，学到的多半是噪声不变性而不是说话人/韵律不变性，所以两者结合。

训练目标围绕“跨 realization 对齐”展开。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整公式，但从方法描述可以看出它同时约束连续表示和离散 token：一方面让相同 transcript 的不同语音在时间对齐后靠近，另一方面配合 aggressive augmentation，迫使模型把不稳定因素视为 nuisance。作者强调 word-level forced alignment，这说明他们不是做粗粒度句向量对齐，而是在局部时间轴上保留内容结构。这样做比直接蒸馏 ASR 文本更合适，因为文本会丢掉时长、停顿、局部边界等对 codec 和生成模型有用的帧级 grounding。

论文还把“好 token”的定义说得比较完整：不仅要 content capture，还要 nuisance invariance。很多已有方法只优化前者，比如保留足够音素信息；PINT 认为如果后者做不好，token 仍然不是好的 semantic token，因为同内容不同表面形式会映射到不同离散序列。这个定义直接解释了为什么后续可以配合 RLE 和 BPE 获得更高压缩率：重复帧和稳定片段被真正折叠了，而不是把 speaker/prosody 的抖动也编码进去。

与已有工作相比，PINT 和 ContentVec、DC-Spin、StableToken、NAST 有交集，但重点不同。ContentVec/DC-Spin 更偏 speaker invariance；StableToken 更偏噪声鲁棒；很多 codec 工作则默认 HuBERT/WavLM/Whisper 特征已经足够“语义”。PINT 的区别在于，它把 parallel data 作为核心监督信号，直接针对“同内容多实现”这个结构化事实做表示清洗，而且结果是 drop-in 的：可以作为现有 codec 或 speech LM 的 semantic target，而不要求重做整个系统。
summary.experiments:
实验最有说服力的地方在于指标链条比较完整，不是只挑一个 probe。论文报告的核心数字包括：说话人 probe 准确率从 93.1% 降到 1.2%，相当于 98.7% 的相对下降，说明 speaker 信息基本被压掉；ABX discriminability 提升 42%，说明内容区分能力没有因为去除 nuisance 而受损，反而更清晰；在相同 85M decoder-only Transformer 上，PINT token 的测试 perplexity 为 1.95，而 HuBERT/WavLM token 分别为 2.78/2.67，下降约 27–30%。更关键的是训练动态：PINT 在 23× 更少的 step 内就达到 WavLM token 的最终 perplexity，这说明收益不只是最终上限更高，也包括优化更容易、样本效率更好。

这些结果对预训练研究尤其重要，因为它们把 token 质量和 LM 训练难度直接连起来了。若只是 probe 更难恢复 speaker，未必说明 token 更适合生成；但 perplexity 和收敛速度同时改善，说明序列统计结构确实更接近“语言建模友好”的形式。

从文中描述看，作者还评估了压缩性和鲁棒性，并在严格数据切分上避免 transcript leakage：例如 CSTR-VCTK 按 speaker holdout，TIMIT/LibriSpeech 用标准划分，没有官方划分的数据则按 normalized transcript 成组切分。这一点值得注意，因为 parallel 训练很容易在相同文本上发生泄漏，进而夸大 invariance 效果。论文还使用 RAVDESS 做情感 probe、LibriLight 6k clean 子集训练 LM，说明评估覆盖了表示纯度和实际建模两个层面。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 里对 H(z|c) 的定义和动机，这一段把问题讲得很准：为什么“同一句话 token 不一致”会伤害压缩和 LM。然后重点看方法部分里数据构造与对齐方式，尤其是真实 parallel、pseudo-parallel augmentation、Kokoro 合成样本三者如何配合；这里决定了它学到的是哪种 invariance。再看实验里三类结果：一是 speaker/emotion 等 probe，确认 nuisance 是否真的被去掉；二是 ABX 或音素相关指标，确认内容没有塌缩；三是 LM perplexity 与训练曲线，这是最值得精读的部分，因为它直接回答“clean token 是否更适合做 LM target”。

如果时间有限，优先看：问题定义图表、token 稳定性/熵相关分析、LM perplexity 主表、训练步数对比曲线、以及消融实验。消融里最值得深挖的是：只用 augmentation、只用真实 parallel、是否联合优化连续与离散层、不同 SSL backbone 的差异。如果论文给了 RLE/BPE 压缩率或 token 重复统计，也建议仔细看，因为这部分最能连接到 tokenizer 设计和 AR 建模效率。

阅读时可以带着两个问题：第一，PINT 学到的是“语言内容”还是“对训练语料中平行句子稳定的残差”；第二，这种 invariance 是否会过度抹掉对生成有用的副语言信息。作者的实验倾向于说明没有明显伤害内容，但在 expressive speech generation 场景里，语义流和 acoustic residual 流如何重新分工，仍值得继续追。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a central weakness in current discrete speech tokenization: so-called semantic tokens are still contaminated by non-linguistic variation inherited from SSL encoders such as HuBERT or WavLM. The same uttered content can map to different token sequences depending on speaker identity, prosody, recording channel, or noise conditions. That raises conditional entropy H(z|c), hurts compressibility, and makes downstream language modeling unnecessarily harder. The paper’s key premise is simple and strong: if many speakers say the same words under varying conditions, the only factor that should remain invariant is linguistic content. A good semantic tokenizer should therefore be trained to preserve what is shared across parallel utterances and discard the rest.
summary_en.importance: This matters for pretraining in at least three ways. First, it reframes speech token quality in language-model terms rather than only downstream task terms: lower conditional entropy, better compressibility, and easier autoregressive prediction. That is the right lens if the tokens are meant to feed speech LMs. Second, it argues that many speech codec and speech-generation systems may be bottlenecked not by decoder architecture but by noisy semantic targets upstream. If the target sequence itself is unstable, the LM is forced to model nuisance variation that should never have been there. Third, it offers an alternative to collapsing speech into ASR text. PINT aims for content-only discrete units while preserving frame-level temporal grounding, which is important for codec-style generation and unified audio-language modeling. The contribution is not a narrow probe improvement; the gains line up across disentanglement, discriminability, compression, and LM perplexity, which suggests a real representation-level improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PINT starts from a pretrained SSL speech encoder and fine-tunes it using parallel utterances plus aggressive augmentations so that different realizations of the same content align in representation space and, ultimately, in discrete token space. The paper’s design choice is notable: instead of redesigning the codec stack, it isolates the semantic-target problem and improves the upstream representation that existing codec or speech-LM systems can consume as a drop-in replacement.

The training data mix is important. True parallel corpora include ARCTIC, CHAINS, CSTR-VCTK, EnDialects, ESD, and TIMIT, covering variation in speaker, accent, style, and emotion. Non-parallel corpora such as LibriSpeech 960h and Tedlium-3 374h are used to broaden linguistic and acoustic coverage; pseudo-parallel pairs are created online by applying stochastic augmentations to the same utterance. The paper also synthesizes additional parallel samples with Kokoro. This combination is a sensible compromise: real parallel data teaches invariance to speaker and style, while augmentation-based pseudo-parallel data expands coverage and robustness.

A key implementation detail is forced alignment at the word level. That suggests PINT is not learning only sentence-level invariance, but preserving local temporal structure while aligning content across realizations. This is one reason the method differs from using ASR text as the semantic target: text removes nuisance factors, but it also removes frame-level grounding that modern speech codecs and generators rely on.

Conceptually, the paper defines a semantic token with a dual criterion: content capture and nuisance invariance. Many prior methods emphasize the first and under-specify the second. PINT argues that without invariance, the token sequence is still not truly semantic, because identical content does not map to a stable discrete form. That framing also explains the compression angle: once nuisance variation is removed, run-length encoding and BPE can collapse repeated frames and stable spans more effectively, yielding lower bitrate and easier AR modeling.

Relative to prior work, PINT overlaps with ContentVec, DC-Spin, StableToken, and NAST, but the emphasis is different. ContentVec and DC-Spin focus more on speaker invariance; StableToken focuses more on noise robustness; many codec papers simply inherit HuBERT, WavLM, Whisper, or w2v-BERT features as semantic targets. PINT’s distinction is to use parallel data as the primary supervision signal for representation cleaning, explicitly exploiting the same-content/multiple-realizations structure.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story is convincing because the metrics form a coherent chain rather than a single isolated win. The headline numbers are: speaker probe accuracy drops from 93.1% to 1.2%, a 98.7% relative reduction, indicating that speaker information is largely removed; ABX discriminability improves by 42%, showing that phonetic/content distinctions are preserved or even sharpened rather than collapsed; and on the same 85M decoder-only Transformer, test perplexity on PINT tokens is 1.95 versus 2.78 and 2.67 for HuBERT and WavLM tokens, a 27–30% reduction. The training-dynamics result is especially important: PINT reaches WavLM’s final perplexity in 23× fewer steps, which points to better optimization and sample efficiency, not just a better endpoint.

For pretraining researchers, this is the most relevant part of the paper. Probe results alone would not prove that the tokens are better LM targets. But lower perplexity and faster convergence on a fixed LM architecture strongly suggest that the token sequence has become more predictable in the right way.

The paper also appears careful about evaluation hygiene. Splits are constructed to avoid transcript leakage, including speaker holdout for CSTR-VCTK and transcript-grouped splitting where official partitions do not exist. That matters because parallel-data methods can otherwise overstate invariance by leaking repeated text across train and test. Additional evaluations include emotion probing on RAVDESS and LM training on a 6k-hour clean subset of LibriLight, covering both representation purity and practical modeling utility.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction’s formulation around H(z|c). That section gives the cleanest statement of why unstable semantic tokens are a modeling problem rather than just a representation nuisance. Then move to the method section and focus on the data construction: true parallel data, pseudo-parallel augmentation, and synthetic parallel samples. The exact balance among these sources determines what kind of invariance the model can realistically learn.

After that, read the experiments in three passes. First, check the nuisance-removal evidence: speaker and emotion probes, token stability under perturbation, and any entropy or consistency analysis. Second, check the content-preservation evidence: ABX or phonetic discriminability. Third, spend most of the time on the LM results: perplexity tables, convergence curves, and any compression statistics. Those are the results that connect the tokenizer directly to pretraining efficiency.

If there are ablations, prioritize the ones that isolate the effect of real parallel data versus augmentation-only training, continuous-only versus joint continuous/discrete optimization, and backbone choice. Also pay attention to any RLE/BPE compression analysis. That part is easy to overlook, but it is where the paper most clearly links representation invariance to sequence modeling efficiency.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. First, is PINT learning linguistic content specifically, or merely the residual that stays stable across the available parallel corpora? Second, could stronger invariance remove para-linguistic information that some generation systems still need? The paper argues that content is preserved and modeling improves, but the division of labor between semantic and acoustic streams remains an open design question for expressive speech generation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变我对“HuBERT token 足够语义化”的默认假设，应复现 speaker probe 和 LM PPL 两组消融。
recommendation.en: This should weaken the default assumption that HuBERT tokens are semantic enough; reproduce the speaker-probe and LM-perplexity ablations.

paper.title: Moving Alphabet: A Controlled Study of Training Data for Text-to-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-video generation has advanced significantly over the past five years through scaling of model size, data, and compute. Unlike model architecture, training data is often underexplored. Real-world data curation is complex and non-trivial, involving clip selection from raw videos and captioning to create video-text pairs for learning text-to-video mappings. We study how data distribution and caption quality impact text-to-video models. To enable controlled experiments, we introduce Moving A

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关心的问题是：在 text-to-video 预训练中，数据分布、视频复杂度、clip 时长和 caption 质量分别怎样影响模型学习。真实视频数据有太多混杂因素，作者用可控的程序生成数据，把这些因素拆开测。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发大于对视频生成模型本身的贡献。它给出一个清晰结论：视频生成的可控性和训练效率很大程度受 caption 质量限制，尤其是 caption precision，即描述是否正确。caption recall，即描述是否完整，也重要，但在预算有限时，正确性优先于完整性。这个结论对大规模多模态预训练的数据管线有直接参考意义，尤其是视频 captioner、clip selection 和数据混合策略。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 Moving Alphabet 测试床：在黑色背景上渲染 1 到 3 个移动字母，控制字体、颜色、大小、位置、方向、速度和视频时长。因为所有视觉属性都来自已知元数据，所以可以生成准确 caption，也可以系统性破坏 caption 的 precision 和 recall。这样可以避免真实视频中语义标注不完整、动作边界不清、caption 主观性强等问题。方法重点不是提出新模型，而是建立可控数据分布，并用细粒度指标评估视觉质量和 prompt adherence。相比直接在真实视频上做统计相关性分析，这种设计牺牲了语义复杂度，但换来更干净的因果观察。
summary.experiments: 实验主要比较三类因素。第一是内容复杂度：只训练单一复杂度的模型不一定在对应复杂度上最好，混合 1-letter、2-letter、3-letter 的均衡数据，能匹配或超过专门训练在单一复杂度上的模型。第二是时长分布：混合 2 秒、4 秒、8 秒视频的训练集也表现更稳，说明预训练阶段不宜过早窄化到单一 duration。第三是 caption 质量：降低 precision 或 recall 都会显著损害性能，其中 precision 损害更大。caption 被污染后，模型可能需要约 2 到 4 倍 compute 才能达到 clean caption 模型的验证损失。后处理补救有限：classifier-free guidance 能改善一部分 prompt following，但不能消除差距；用少量 clean data fine-tuning 只能在中等污染条件下恢复最多约 55% 的 foreground PSNR 损失。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Moving Alphabet 数据构造部分，重点看 caption corruption 的定义、precision/recall 如何被操作化、以及评估指标如何对应视觉属性和 prompt adherence。实验部分优先看三组结果：复杂度混合、duration 混合、caption precision/recall 消融。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以读完主要信息。值得深挖的是它的实验范式：用程序生成数据做预训练数据因果分析。这种思路可以迁移到图像、语音、代码数据的 controllable ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how training data distribution, clip duration, visual complexity, and caption quality affect text-to-video model training. Instead of relying on real video corpora with many confounders, it builds a controlled procedural environment where these factors can be varied independently.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in pretraining data methodology rather than video model architecture. The key lesson is that caption correctness is a strong bottleneck for controllability and sample efficiency. Caption completeness also matters, but when annotation budget is constrained, correctness should come first. This is relevant to large-scale multimodal pretraining pipelines where clip selection and video captioning dominate data quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Moving Alphabet, a synthetic video testbed that renders one to three moving letters on a dark background. Attributes such as font, color, size, position, direction, speed, and duration are sampled from known distributions. Since the full metadata is available, the pipeline can generate perfect captions and then corrupt them in controlled ways to vary precision and recall. The contribution is not a new generative architecture. It is a controlled data-generation and evaluation setup that allows cleaner causal analysis than real-world video datasets.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments isolate three effects. First, balanced mixtures of 1-letter, 2-letter, and 3-letter scenes match or outperform specialists trained only on a single complexity level, even on the specialist distribution. Second, mixing 2-second, 4-second, and 8-second clips gives more robust training than using a narrow duration distribution. Third, caption corruption has a sharp effect on both validation loss and prompt adherence. Precision errors are more damaging than recall errors. Models trained on corrupted captions can require about 2x to 4x more compute to match the validation loss of models trained with ground-truth captions. Classifier-free guidance helps prompt following but does not close the gap. Fine-tuning on a small clean set recovers at most about 55% of lost foreground PSNR under moderate corruption.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction and the Moving Alphabet construction first. Then focus on how caption precision and recall are defined, how corruptions are injected, and how visual quality and prompt adherence are measured. The most useful plots are the ablations on complexity mixture, duration mixture, and caption corruption. A 20-30 minute read is enough for the main lessons. The deeper point is the experimental design: procedural data can be used to study pretraining data causally before running expensive real-data experiments.

recommendation.zh: 文生视频领域的干净可控数据实验，结论可直接迁移至LLM预训练的数据配比与语料质量优化，仅看实验发现与结论部分即可。
recommendation.en: Clean controlled data experiments for text-to-video generation; conclusions are directly transferable to LLM pretraining data mixture and corpus quality optimization, only read the experiment findings and conclusion sections.

paper.title: Knowledgeless Language Models: Suppressing Parametric Recall for Evidence-Grounded Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Language models encode substantial factual knowledge in their parameters, which can lead to unreliable behavior when this knowledge is outdated, incomplete, or misaligned with the provided context. In this work, we study whether modifying the pretraining signal can systematically shift models away from parametric recall and toward evidence-grounded reasoning. We introduce Knowledge--''Less'' Language Models (KLLMs), a fundamentally different epistemic training paradigm for LLMs, which are pretra

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：能否通过改变预训练语料中的事实监督信号，系统性压低模型的参数化事实回忆，让模型更依赖给定证据而不是“背答案”。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它不是再做一层 RAG 或后训练约束，而是直接改动预训练阶段的知识注入方式，讨论 LLM 的“认识论”设定：模型究竟应当把多少事实存进参数、又该如何在有上下文时优先使用外部证据。这对检索增强、幻觉控制、知识时效性和 pretrain↔posttrain 接口都有直接启发，属于预训练数据干预带来的范式性问题设定。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出 Knowledge-Less Language Models（KLLMs）：在预训练语料中对命名实体做匿名化处理，切断实体名称与事实表述之间最直接的监督通道，从而削弱实体绑定的参数记忆。核心不是改模型结构，而是改预训练数据分布与监督信号，让模型更多学习语言模式、关系推断和基于上下文的证据整合，而不是闭卷事实回忆。这个思路本质上属于“用数据手术改变模型知识形态”。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的实验结论是：在多个模型规模上，KLLM 相比同规模基线显著降低 closed-book factual recall，但在 contextual QA、fact verification、hallucination detection 上往往更好；尤其在 retrieval-grounded 设置下，模型更愿意依赖检索证据而不是参数记忆。摘要未给出具体参数量、训练 token 数和提升幅度，因此目前只能判断方向明确、设定干净，但还需要看正文确认匿名化比例、实体处理粒度、是否控制总 token 分布和训练 compute 一致。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 HPI / University of Potsdam、AIMS、Aalborg University、University of Copenhagen、University of Cape Town。Jan Buys 长期做语言建模、结构化生成与推理相关研究；Gerard de Melo 在知识表示、知识增强 NLP 方向有持续积累。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether pretraining can be modified to systematically suppress parametric factual recall, so that language models rely more on provided evidence than on memorized facts.
summary_en.importance: This matters because it intervenes at pretraining time rather than adding a retrieval or alignment patch afterward. It reframes a core epistemic question for LLMs: how much factual knowledge should live in parameters, and how should models behave when external evidence is available. That has direct implications for RAG, hallucination control, knowledge freshness, and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Knowledge-Less Language Models (KLLMs) anonymize named entities in the pretraining corpus, removing a primary channel of entity-linked factual supervision. The model architecture stays largely unchanged; the key intervention is on the data and supervision signal. The intended effect is to reduce entity-bound memorization while preserving language modeling ability and improving evidence-grounded reasoning from context.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, across multiple model scales KLLMs substantially reduce closed-book factual recall while often improving contextual QA, fact verification, and hallucination detection. The gains are especially emphasized in retrieval-grounded settings, where the models rely more on retrieved evidence. The abstract does not provide parameter counts, token budgets, or exact margins, so the main open question is whether the setup cleanly controls for token distribution, compute, and anonymization side effects.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from HPI / University of Potsdam, AIMS, Aalborg University, University of Copenhagen, and University of Cape Town. Jan Buys has a track record in language modeling and structured generation; Gerard de Melo is known for work on knowledge representation and knowledge-aware NLP.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接动你对“预训练该不该灌事实”的 prior；先看实验控制是否干净，若 token/compute 对齐成立，内部应立刻复现实体匿名化 ablation。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the prior that more factual supervision in pretraining is always better; if the token/compute controls are clean, entity anonymization deserves an immediate internal ablation.

paper.title: Extractable Memorization From First Principles
paper.abstract: Recent work on extractable memorization in LLMs suffers from two contrasting validity problems. Some studies overstate extraction, e.g., relying on sequences too short to distinguish memorization from predictability. Others imply that extraction is unreliable evidence of memorization, since models can also reproduce real-world text they weren't explicitly trained on. In different ways, both overlook what makes a valid extraction claim: the model must generate a training sequence with high enough

summary.core_problem: 解决现有LLM可提取记忆研究存在的效度缺陷，即无法区分模型生成是源于记忆还是可预测性，缺乏可靠的记忆提取判定标准。
summary.importance: 方法创新，从第一性原理出发形式化记忆提取的有效性判定框架，解决了过往研究要么高估记忆、要么低估记忆可靠性的核心矛盾。
summary.technical_approach: 提出匹配对比方法，通过对比训练序列与可比非训练序列的生成概率，以非训练序列概率作为可预测性基线，超过基线则为记忆证据；并形式化共形测试等两种实现方式。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验设置与量化结果，核心贡献为理论框架与形式化方法。
summary.authors_note: Google Research出品，Percy Liang为知名研究者，CRFM负责人、HELM基准创建者。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the validity flaws in existing LLM extractable memorization research, which cannot distinguish between memorization and predictability in model generation, lacking reliable criteria for memorization claims.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that formalizes a validity framework for extractable memorization from first principles, resolving the core contradiction of prior work that either overestimates memorization or underestimates extraction reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a matched-comparison method that compares generation probabilities of training sequences against comparable non-training sequences, using non-training sequence probabilities as a predictability baseline; formalizes two implementations including a conformal test.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose full experimental setup or quantitative results; core contribution is the theoretical framework and formalization.
summary_en.authors_note: From Google Research; Percy Liang is a well-known researcher, director of CRFM and creator of the HELM benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 匹配对比的思路解决了过往记忆检测的核心效度问题，§3的形式化框架可直接复用在内部预训练数据合规检测流程中。
recommendation.en: The matched-comparison framework fixes the core validity flaw in prior memorization detection work; the formalization in §3 can be directly reused for internal pretraining data compliance pipelines.

paper.title: Domain-Aware Scaling Laws Uncover Data Synergy
paper.abstract: Machine learning progress is often attributed to scaling model size and dataset volume, yet the composition of data can be just as consequential. Empirical findings repeatedly show that combining datasets from different domains yields nontrivial interactions. For instance, adding code improves mathematical reasoning, while certain mixtures introduce interference that reduces model performance. We refer to these effects collectively as data synergy, where the contribution of multiple domains exce

summary.core_problem: 建立面向语言模型预训练数据配比的 domain-aware scaling law，用来量化不同数据域之间的正向协同和负向干扰。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 scaling law 与数据配比方法论。它把 data mixture 从经验调参推进到可估计的直接域贡献和二阶域-域协同，对预训练配方设计、数据预算分配和 benchmark 预测都有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文利用开源权重 LLM 在不同预训练数据混合上的观测差异，估计两类效应：direct domain-to-benchmark synergy，即某一数据域对另一类 benchmark 表现的贡献；second-order domain-domain synergy，即能力需要多个数据域共同出现时产生的交互项。方法上不是只看总 token 数或单域 token 数，而是显式建模数据域之间的非加性项，以提升性能预测。
summary.experiments: 实验基于预训练数据混合不同的 open-weight LLM 观测数据，比较 domain-aware synergy 模型与不含交互项的预测基线。摘要明确称该框架提升了预测准确率，并能识别代码提升数学推理、某些混合造成干扰等现象；具体模型数量、域划分、benchmark 集合和提升幅度需看正文表格。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 MIT CSAIL、Microsoft Research 和 Harvard University。Lester Mackey 是 Microsoft Research 的知名机器学习研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper develops domain-aware scaling laws for language-model pretraining mixtures, with the goal of quantifying positive synergy and negative interference among data domains.
summary_en.importance: This is a scaling-law and data-mixture methodology contribution. It moves mixture design beyond aggregate token counts by estimating direct domain effects and second-order domain-domain interactions, which is directly useful for pretraining data allocation and benchmark prediction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework leverages observational variation across open-weight LLMs with diverse pretraining mixtures. It estimates direct domain-to-benchmark synergy, where one domain contributes to performance on another, and second-order domain-domain synergy, where capabilities arise from the co-occurrence of multiple domains. The key modeling choice is to include non-additive interaction terms among domains rather than only total tokens or independent domain volumes.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use open-weight LLMs with varied pretraining mixtures and compare the proposed domain-aware synergy model against predictive baselines without such interaction terms. The abstract reports improved predictive accuracy and captures examples such as code helping mathematical reasoning and some mixtures causing interference. Exact model counts, domain taxonomies, benchmark sets, and numerical gains require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with MIT CSAIL, Microsoft Research, and Harvard University. Lester Mackey is a well-known machine learning researcher at Microsoft Research.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看模型设定和残差分析；若交互项稳健，data mixture ablation 不能再只报单域 token 边际收益。
recommendation.en: Read the model specification and residual analysis first; if the interactions hold, mixture ablations should stop reporting only marginal single-domain token effects.

paper.title: MonkeyOCRv2: A Visual-Text Foundation Model for Document AI
paper.abstract: Mainstream visual encoders are pretrained on natural images and cannot be effectively applied to document images without document-oriented adaptation, as dense text and fine-grained character strokes demand character-level visual perception. We present MonkeyOCRv2, a visual-text pretrained model for document AI. First, we construct MonkeyDoc v2, to our knowledge the largest document-image pretraining corpus, comprising 113 million images spanning 17 languages. Second, we propose a pretraining st

summary.core_problem: 现有通用视觉编码器基于自然图像预训练，优化目标偏向高层语义抽象，缺失文档场景必需的字符级细粒度视觉感知能力；现有文档类预训练语料普遍规模偏小、语言覆盖有限、标注粒度不足，无法支撑文档基础模型的有效训练。
summary.importance: 面向文档AI场景完成视觉编码器的领域适配预训练，构建了亿级规模的多语言文档预训练语料，提出的语义生成+像素重建双目标预训练策略，为垂直领域视觉编码器适配、细粒度视觉表示学习提供了可复用的训练思路，产出的文档语料也可作为通用多模态大模型预训练的域内数据补充。
summary.technical_approach: 首先构建MonkeyDoc v2语料，包含1.13亿张覆盖17种语言的文档图像。预训练阶段采用双目标联合优化：一是图像到文本的生成目标，对齐视觉表示与对应文本内容，提供稠密的语义监督；二是像素级文档重建目标，约束编码器保留字符笔画、字形、布局结构等细粒度视觉细节，避免纯文本监督下局部视觉信息的丢失。
summary.experiments: 在文本识别、公式识别、文本检测、文档篡改检测、重叠文本分割5类下游任务上验证，将基线模型的视觉编码器替换为MonkeyOCRv2后均取得一致收益：困难英文、中文、遮挡文本识别任务平均带来5.4%的绝对精度提升；搭配MonkeyOCRv2的1.1亿参数公式识别模型，性能超过使用通用编码器的3.25亿参数基线模型；文本检测、篡改检测、重叠文本分割任务分别提升3.3%、7.5%、5.3%。乱序文本对照消融实验显示，低分辨率设置下，重建目标可将模型依赖语言上下文先验带来的精度差距缩小近一半。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第3节的双目标预训练设计、第5.1节的乱序文本对照消融实验，核心参考点是细粒度重建监督与语义对齐监督的互补机制，无需深挖工程实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: General visual encoders pretrained on natural images are optimized for high-level semantic abstraction, lacking the character-level fine-grained perception required for document image understanding. Existing document-specific pretraining corpora are limited in scale, language coverage, and annotation granularity, failing to support effective training of document foundation models.
summary_en.importance: This work presents a domain-adapted visual encoder pretraining pipeline for document AI, with a 113M-scale multilingual document pretraining corpus and a joint generative-reconstructive pretraining strategy. The design provides a replicable approach for vertical domain visual encoder adaptation and fine-grained visual representation learning, and the produced corpus can serve as in-domain data supplementation for general multimodal LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline first constructs MonkeyDoc v2, a corpus of 113 million document images covering 17 languages. Pretraining jointly optimizes two objectives: an image-to-text generation objective that aligns visual representations with corresponding textual content to provide dense semantic supervision, and a pixel-level document reconstruction objective that regularizes the encoder to preserve fine-grained visual details including character strokes, glyph shapes, and layout structures, preventing the loss of local visual signals under purely text-driven supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations across 5 downstream document analysis tasks (text recognition, formula recognition, text detection, document tampering detection, overlapping text segmentation) show consistent gains when replacing baseline visual encoders with MonkeyOCRv2: an average 5.4% absolute accuracy improvement on challenging English, Chinese, and occluded text recognition benchmarks; a 110M-parameter formula recognition model paired with MonkeyOCRv2 outperforms a 325M-parameter baseline using general visual encoders; absolute gains of 3.3%, 7.5%, and 5.3% on text detection, tampering detection, and overlapping text segmentation respectively. A controlled scrambled-text ablation demonstrates that the reconstruction objective reduces the accuracy gap caused by over-reliance on linguistic priors by nearly half under low-resolution settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim through the work, focusing on the dual-objective pretraining design in Section 3 and the scrambled-text ablation in Section 5.1. The key takeaway is the complementary mechanism between fine-grained reconstruction supervision and semantic alignment supervision; no need to dive deep into engineering implementation details. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim：文档不是普通图片，重建目标保笔画这个 prior 很实用；重点看数据构成和双目标消融。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming: documents are not natural images, and reconstruction for stroke preservation is a useful prior; focus on data composition and dual-objective ablations.

paper.title: TheBioCollection: Unified Pre-Training Scale LLM Corpus for Biology
paper.abstract: The push toward large language models for biology (BioLM) has created a need for training corpora that can endow models with a genuine understanding of biology. However, existing biological resources, such as molecular databases, protein repositories, genomic annotations, single-cell atlases, and pathway databases, are scattered across heterogeneous formats and remain unorganized into a cohesive corpus for language model training. We present TheBioCollection, a 52.6B-token pre-training-scale cor

summary.core_problem: 把分散在小分子、蛋白质、基因组、细胞和通路数据库中的生物资源整理成可用于 BioLM 预训练的统一大规模语料。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是领域预训练数据集和匹配评测集。它对通用 LLM 的直接价值有限，但对如何把异构科学数据转成 LM-ready corpus 有参考意义，尤其是 schema 统一、属性补全和任务覆盖设计。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 TheBioCollection，规模为 52.6B tokens；将分散的分子数据库、蛋白质库、基因组注释、单细胞图谱和通路数据库转换为统一训练格式，并用工具计算的生物属性增强记录；同时加入当前语料较少覆盖的新 instruction tasks。
summary.experiments: 配套 TheBioCollection-Eval，覆盖分子、蛋白质、基因组、细胞和通路上的 recognition、generation、prediction 能力。给定摘要未说明是否训练了具体 BioLM、模型参数规模、数据配比 ablation 或相对现有 BioLM 语料的端到端收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper organizes scattered biological resources across molecules, proteins, genomes, cells, and pathways into a unified corpus for BioLM pretraining.
summary_en.importance: This is a domain pretraining-data contribution with a matched evaluation suite. Its direct value for general LLM pretraining is limited, but it is useful as a case study in converting heterogeneous scientific databases into LM-ready data.
summary_en.technical_approach: TheBioCollection contains 52.6B tokens. It converts molecular databases, protein repositories, genomic annotations, single-cell atlases, and pathway databases into a unified training format, enriches records with tool-computed biological properties, and introduces instruction tasks for under-covered biological capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: The paper pairs the corpus with TheBioCollection-Eval, probing recognition, generation, and prediction across molecular, protein, genomic, cellular, and pathway domains. The provided abstract does not specify trained model sizes, mixture ablations, or end-to-end gains over existing BioLM corpora.

recommendation.zh: 可作为科学语料工程样例看数据 schema 和属性增强；没有训练消融的话，不必按通用 data-mixture 证据读。
recommendation.en: Useful as a scientific-corpus engineering example; without training ablations, do not treat it as general data-mixture evidence.

paper.title: UltraX: Refining Pre-Training Data at Scale with Adaptive Programmatic Editing
paper.abstract: As available training data approaches its physical limit, gains from Scaling Laws have begun to diminish. Consequently, improving Large Language Models (LLMs) now depends less on data expansion and more on higher-quality data utilization. However, in the context of large-scale corpora, existing refinement methodologies face significant limitations in quality, efficiency, and reliability: Rule-based approaches are constrained by fixed heuristics and struggle with instance-level variations; LLM-ba

summary.core_problem: UltraX 解决的是大规模预训练语料的“可扩展语义级编辑”问题。简单过滤会丢掉大量可修复样本，规则清洗只能覆盖固定模式，直接让强 LLM 重写文本又太慢、太贵，并且长文切分后容易引入边界不一致。UltraX 选择用轻量模型预测结构化编辑程序，而不是生成完整改写文本，以便在预训练语料规模上做插入、删除和修改。
summary.importance: 这是预训练数据方向值得精读的工作。贡献不在于又提出一个质量打分器，而是把 data refinement 从“筛掉低质样本”推进到“以程序化方式修复样本”。这个方向对数据利用率有直接意义：当高质量自然语料继续扩张变难，提升已有 token 的有效信息密度，比单纯扩大爬取规模更现实。UltraX 的量级贡献在工程范式上：用专家 LLM 生成监督，用轻量模型承担大规模推理，用结构化编辑保证吞吐和可控性。它也给 continual pretrain 和 domain mid-training 提供了一个接口：先对语料做可审计编辑，再进入训练，而不是把所有噪声交给模型吸收。
summary.technical_approach: UltraX 的核心选择是 function-calling refinement。模型不直接输出重写后的全文，而是输出编辑操作序列。操作空间包含删除、修改和插入，补齐了 ProX、RefineX 等方法中操作空间不完整的问题。监督构造分成几步：先做 dataset-adaptive prompt optimization，让专家 LLM 生成更稳定的 end-to-end refined text；再用 Line Alignment Mapping 把原文和改写文本对齐，抽取可执行的编辑程序；再用 Dynamic Context Replacement 处理局部上下文变化，降低连续操作相互干扰。训练数据还经过低置信样本过滤，并按不同操作组合做 ratio-controlled sampling，避免训练分布被某一类编辑主导。推理阶段采用 sliding-window prediction，应对长文；随后做 global operation aggregation，把窗口内预测合并成全局编辑程序；最后通过系统化 post-processing 规范化、校验和执行模型输出。和端到端重写相比，这一路线减少输出 token 数，也更容易处理长文切分后的重组边界。和纯规则相比，它可以做实例级语义修复；和强 LLM 在线重写相比，它把高成本推理转移到离线监督生成阶段。
summary.experiments: 已给出的全文片段显示，实验包含基于 1B 参数 MiniCPM 的从零预训练，用于验证 UltraX 处理后的语料是否能转化为下游模型收益。这个实验设计是关键，因为数据清洗论文常见问题是只报告编辑质量或分类器分数，而不做 pretrain-to-eval 闭环。文中还围绕函数空间、监督生成和执行稳定性设置了消融：插入/删除/修改的完整操作空间用于检验是否比删除-only 或不完整编辑更有效；Line Alignment Mapping、Dynamic Context Replacement、低置信过滤和 ratio-controlled sampling 用于检验监督质量；sliding-window、global aggregation 和 post-processing 用于检验长文和批量执行的可靠性。当前提供的内容没有包含最终表格数值、token 规模、语料规模和具体 benchmark 分数，因此不应补造数字。精读时需要核对预训练 token 数、UltraX 编辑比例、训练成本、baseline 数据处理方法、以及 1B MiniCPM 在语言建模 loss 和下游评测上的提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。优先看方法部分的三条链路：第一，编辑函数空间如何定义，尤其是插入、删除、修改之间的执行顺序和冲突处理；第二，原文-改写文本如何变成程序监督，重点看 Line Alignment Mapping 和 Dynamic Context Replacement 的伪代码或示例；第三，长文滑窗预测后如何做全局操作聚合，避免重复匹配和跨窗口冲突。实验部分重点看从零预训练设置，而不是只看自动编辑指标。需要特别关注几类表格：UltraX 数据相对原始数据、规则清洗、LLM 重写、ProX/RefineX 的预训练效果；不同操作空间的消融；低置信过滤和采样比例的消融；吞吐、输出 token 数和单位语料处理成本。值得深挖的问题是编辑是否改变数据分布、是否过度规范化文本风格、是否会删除罕见知识或长尾表达，以及轻量 refiner 在新领域语料上的迁移稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: UltraX targets scalable semantic editing for pretraining corpora. Rule-based cleaning is cheap but limited to fixed patterns. Filtering discards many recoverable documents. Direct LLM rewriting is too expensive at corpus scale and becomes fragile when long documents must be chunked and reassembled. UltraX reformulates refinement as structured edit-program prediction with a lightweight model.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong pretraining-data paper to read carefully. The main contribution is not another quality classifier; it is a scalable path from data selection to data repair. That matters because high-quality natural text is becoming harder to expand, so improving the utility of existing tokens is a practical lever. The framework also gives a useful interface for continual pretraining and domain mid-training: clean or repair data through auditable edit programs before training, rather than relying on the model to absorb all corpus noise.
summary_en.technical_approach: UltraX uses function-calling refinement instead of end-to-end text regeneration. The lightweight refiner emits edit operations, not the full rewritten document. Its operation space includes deletion, modification, and insertion, addressing the incomplete edit spaces in earlier function-calling refiners such as ProX and RefineX. Supervision is built through a multi-stage pipeline. Dataset-adaptive prompt optimization first guides an expert LLM to produce higher-quality refined texts. Line Alignment Mapping then converts original-refined text pairs into executable program supervision. Dynamic Context Replacement handles context changes caused by local edits and reduces interference between consecutive operations. Low-confidence examples are filtered, and ratio-controlled sampling balances different operation combinations. At inference time, UltraX uses sliding-window prediction for long documents, global operation aggregation to merge window-level outputs, and post-processing to normalize, validate, and execute the predicted programs. Compared with full-text rewriting, the programmatic route reduces output tokens and makes chunk recombination easier to control. Compared with static rules, it supports instance-level semantic repair.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt states that the evaluation includes from-scratch pretraining of 1B-parameter MiniCPM models, which is the right evidence path for a pretraining-data method. The useful part of the design is the closed loop from edited corpus to trained model quality, rather than only reporting edit accuracy or quality-classifier scores. The paper also appears to evaluate the function space, supervision pipeline, and execution reliability through ablations: complete insertion/deletion/modification operations versus restricted edit spaces; Line Alignment Mapping and Dynamic Context Replacement for supervision quality; low-confidence filtering and ratio-controlled sampling for training stability; and sliding-window prediction, global aggregation, and post-processing for long-document robustness. The supplied text does not include the final numeric tables, token counts, corpus scale, or benchmark scores, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental section before quoting. Key numbers to verify are pretraining token budget, edited-data ratio, throughput, processing cost, baseline cleaning methods, and the 1B MiniCPM gains in loss and downstream evaluations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read in detail. Start with the method sections that define the edit functions and their execution semantics, especially how insertion, deletion, and modification are ordered and how conflicts are resolved. Then inspect the supervision-construction pipeline, with special attention to Line Alignment Mapping and Dynamic Context Replacement examples or pseudocode. For long documents, focus on sliding-window prediction and global operation aggregation, since this is where many refinement systems fail through duplicate matching or cross-window inconsistency. In the experiments, prioritize from-scratch pretraining results over standalone editing metrics. The most important tables are likely the comparison against raw data, rule-based cleaning, LLM rewriting, ProX, and RefineX; ablations over operation space; filtering and sampling ablations; and throughput or cost measurements. The main risks to examine are distribution shift from editing, over-normalization of writing style, accidental removal of rare knowledge, and whether the lightweight refiner transfers cleanly to new domains.

recommendation.zh: 应优先读完整实验；若编辑后继续预训练收益干净，这类程序化数据修复值得进内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the full experiments first; if continued-pretraining gains are clean, programmatic corpus repair deserves an internal ablation.

paper.title: MedPMC: A Systematic Framework for Scaling High-Fidelity Medical Multimodal Data for Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Medicine is inherently multimodal, requiring clinicians to synthesize information across diverse data streams. Yet the development of multimodal foundation models is constrained by limited access to large-scale, high-quality clinical data. Although PubMed Central (PMC) offers a complementary source of expert-authored image-text data, existing PMC-derived resources remain limited in fidelity, reproducibility, and clinical validation. We introduce MedPMC, an automated, continuously updatable frame

summary.core_problem: 解决医学多模态基础模型缺少大规模、高保真、可复现 image-text 预训练数据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是预训练数据基础设施。它把开放许可的 PMC 文献转化为可持续更新的医学图文数据管线，并强调图文对齐、图像类型识别、多面板拆分和临床人工验证。相关性主要在数据清洗和高保真图文对齐流程，领域本身仍是医学垂直数据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MedPMC 自动化框架，处理 610 万篇 PMC 文章，经过初筛、多面板图检测、figure 分离、caption 分离与对齐、医学图像分类等步骤，构建医学 image-text pairs。方法重点不是新模型结构，而是可复现、可更新的数据抽取和质量控制 pipeline。
summary.experiments: 应用于 6.1M PMC articles，得到 11M medical image-text pairs。组件评估包括初筛 F1=93.2、多面板图检测 F1=96.5、figure separation mAP=89.8、caption separation/alignment F1=81.4、ROUGE-L=85.3、医学 figure 分类 F1=96.5。摘要提到 5 位标注者人工审查，但截断部分未给出完整结果。
summary.authors_note: 摘要信息不足，无法可靠确认机构背景；题目列表中标注 Serina S. Applebaum 为 notable，但无法仅凭给定信息判断团队完整背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the lack of large-scale, high-fidelity, reproducible image-text pretraining data for medical multimodal foundation models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a pretraining data infrastructure rather than a new model. It converts permissively licensed PMC literature into a continuously updatable medical image-text corpus, with emphasis on figure extraction, caption alignment, image-type classification, and clinical validation. Its relevance lies in data curation mechanics, although the domain remains medical.
summary_en.technical_approach: MedPMC is an automated pipeline applied to 6.1 million PMC articles. It performs initial article screening, multi-panel figure detection, figure separation, caption separation and alignment, and medical figure classification. The main technical value is a reproducible, quality-controlled extraction pipeline for medical image-text pairs, not a new architecture or training objective.
summary_en.experiments: The pipeline curates 11 million medical image-text pairs from 6.1M PMC articles. Component evaluations report F1=93.2 for initial screening, F1=96.5 for multi-panel figure detection, mAP=89.8 for figure separation, F1=81.4 and ROUGE-L=85.3 for caption separation/alignment, and F1=96.5 for medical figure classification. The abstract mentions manual review by five annotators but does not provide the full result due to truncation.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided metadata is insufficient to verify institutional background. Serina S. Applebaum is marked as notable in the input, but the broader team context cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 可看作垂直领域版图文预训练数据工厂；只需扫 pipeline 和质量指标，别把医学结论外推到通用 VLM。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a vertical image-text data factory; skim the pipeline and QA metrics, but do not overgeneralize the medical conclusions to general VLM pretraining.

paper.title: Inertia-1: An Open Exploration of Wearable Motion Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Wearable motion sensing provides a continuous and scalable window into human behavior and health, making it a natural fit for foundation models, yet its pretraining and scaling principles remain poorly understood. Prior work studies isolated design choices, such as sensor placement or sampling frequency, often under fixed settings and narrow downstream tasks that fail to capture real-world sensing diversity. We introduce Inertia-1, a fully open exploration of wearable motion foundation models. U

summary.core_problem: 解决可穿戴运动传感 foundation model 缺少系统性预训练与 scaling 认知的问题，尤其是数据形态、传感器设置、目标函数和模型规模如何共同影响泛化。
summary.importance: 这是一个非文本 foundation model 的开放式预训练研究，价值不在下游任务本身，而在于它把“数据选择—表示—目标函数—规模”放进同一受控框架里，属于可迁移到多模态/新模态预训练的经验研究。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 18.2M 小时加速度计语料，系统比较传感器模态、佩戴位置、采样率、窗口长度、模型架构、模型大小、预训练目标和数据规模等因素，试图给出 wearable motion foundation model 的训练规律。核心更偏向数据与实验设计，而不是提出单一新架构。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 18.2M 小时，评测覆盖 15 个数据集，任务包括人体活动识别、步态冻结等。摘要强调 controlled framework 和 extensive evaluations，但未在摘要中给出具体参数量、最强 baseline 或提升幅度；更值得看的是各因素的 ablation 和 scaling 曲线，而不是单点最好结果。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies the missing pretraining and scaling principles for wearable motion foundation models, asking how data choices, sensing setup, objectives, and model size jointly affect generalization.
summary_en.importance: This is a non-text foundation-model study whose value lies less in the downstream tasks and more in its controlled treatment of data, representation, objective, and scale—useful for researchers thinking about pretraining in new modalities.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a 18.2M-hour accelerometer corpus and systematically varies sensor modality, device placement, sampling rate, window length, architecture, model size, pretraining objective, and data scale to map out training behavior. The contribution is primarily in dataset design and controlled experimentation rather than a single new architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses 18.2M hours of data and evaluates on 15 datasets spanning tasks such as human activity recognition and freezing-of-gait. The abstract highlights a controlled framework and broad ablations, but does not provide parameter counts, strongest baselines, or exact gains; the main value is likely in the ablation tables and scaling plots rather than headline numbers.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但做新模态预训练的人可以看它怎么把 data/objective/scale 拆开做干净实验；只读 ablation 和 scaling 图就够了。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but if you care about pretraining in new modalities, study how they isolate data/objective/scale; the ablations and scaling plots are the only parts worth your time.

paper.title: How Data Shapes RoPE Frequency Usage: From Positional Scale Matching to Length Generalization
paper.abstract: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) provide transformers with a fixed grid of positional frequencies, yet trained models use these frequencies highly non-uniformly. We study what determines this frequency usage and propose a data-centered explanation: RoPE frequencies are selected to match the relative-distance structure of the training data. Viewing each frequency as a positional lens, we formalize a field-resolution tradeoff and show that, for a data-induced dependency profile of width $W$, the

summary.core_problem: 现有研究观察到训练后的Transformer对RoPE提供的固定频率网格使用极不均匀，但始终没有解释频率选择的决定机制，也没有清晰说明位置插值（PI）实现长度外推的生效边界，领域内长期存在“高频编码位置、低频编码语义”的模糊经验认知，缺乏定量的理论支撑。
summary.importance: 这是少有的从训练数据结构出发解释RoPE频率使用规律的工作，将注意力中的位置归纳偏置从固定架构属性重新定义为受训练数据塑造的习得属性，推导的频率匹配原则和PI适用条件可以直接指导RoPE超参数设计、预训练数据长度配比、长上下文适配方案选择，解释了此前多个仅靠经验总结无法说明的长上下文性能现象。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将每个RoPE频率定义为存在“视野-分辨率”权衡的位置透镜：高频的局部位置分辨率高，但相位缠绕速度快、有效感知视野短；低频的覆盖范围广，但对邻近位置的区分度低。其次定义训练数据的位置依赖剖面，即序列中不同相对距离上存在任务相关依赖的分布宽度W。通过分析注意力分数的位置对比度，证明频率匹配原则：对于宽度为W的依赖剖面，模型最优选择的频率满足θ* ∝ 1/W，训练过程会自动选择与数据依赖尺度匹配的频率带。在此基础上分析位置插值的作用机制：PI将每个频率的有效视野扩大α倍、局部分辨率降低α倍，仅当测试场景的依赖剖面是训练剖面的α倍拉伸（即满足自相似性）时，PI才能将训练阶段习得的最优频率映射到测试场景的最优频率，实现有效的长度外推。研究还设计了注意力分数级的能量度量来量化频率使用程度，排除了参数初始化、输入特异性波动的干扰，证明频率使用模式是训练收敛后稳定的、由数据决定的属性。
summary.experiments: 在合成数据上的控制实验验证：构造固定依赖宽度W的任务，模型习得的频率选择确实与1/W呈线性匹配关系。在自然语言数据上的验证显示：自然语言的多尺度依赖结构，恰好对应现有大模型中频率使用集中在中低频段的现象；系统性改变训练数据的依赖尺度，会使模型的频率使用分布发生对应偏移。PI边界条件的验证实验显示：PI在依赖结构满足自相似性的自然语言生成任务上效果稳定，在依赖尺度不随上下文长度拉伸的任务（如固定相对距离的“大海捞针”检索）上收益有限甚至带来性能下降。消融实验排除了QK范数初始化、输入差异的影响，证明收敛后的频率使用模式在不同输入下高度稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 这是需要精读的论文。重点关注三个核心部分：一是频率透镜的视野-分辨率权衡定义，以及频率匹配原则的推导，这是整个工作的理论支点；二是合成数据上的控制实验，其因果识别的实验设计有很强的参考价值；三是PI生效的自相似条件，结论可以直接落地到长上下文训练和适配的工程决策中。图表部分重点关注频率-依赖宽度匹配曲线、不同训练数据下的频率分布偏移、不同任务结构下的PI效果对比。值得延伸思考的方向包括：频率匹配原则是否可以用于指导预训练阶段的数据长度课程设计，是否可以解释YaRN、NTK-aware缩放等RoPE修正方法的效果边界。预计精读时间45分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Trained Transformers exhibit highly non-uniform usage of the fixed frequency grid provided by RoPE, but the mechanism driving frequency selection remains poorly understood. Existing work lacks clear boundary conditions for when position interpolation (PI) enables length generalization, leaving the vague, untested heuristic that 'high frequencies encode position, low frequencies encode semantics' as the dominant informal account of RoPE behavior.
summary_en.importance: This work presents a data-centered, quantitative framework for RoPE frequency selection, reframing positional inductive bias in attention as a learned property shaped by training data structure rather than a fixed architectural feature. The derived frequency matching principle and PI applicability conditions provide concrete guidance for RoPE hyperparameter design, pretraining data length mixture, and long-context adaptation, resolving multiple previously unexplained empirical observations about long-context model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each RoPE frequency is modeled as a positional lens with an inherent field-resolution tradeoff: higher frequencies offer sharper local position discrimination but have shorter effective range due to fast phase wrapping, while lower frequencies cover longer ranges but have coarser resolution for nearby positions. The work defines the positional dependency profile of training data as the width W of the distribution of task-relevant dependencies across relative positions. Analysis of positional contrast in attention scores proves a frequency matching principle: for a dependency profile of width W, the optimal selected frequency scales as θ* ∝ 1/W, meaning training automatically selects frequency bands matched to the dependency scales present in the data. The analysis of PI shows the operation scales each frequency's effective field by a factor of α while reducing resolution by the same factor. PI enables valid length generalization only if test-time dependency profiles are an α-stretched (self-similar) version of training-time profiles, which maps training-optimal frequencies to test-optimal frequencies. The work also introduces an attention score-level energy metric to quantify frequency usage, controlling for initialization effects and input-specific variation to show frequency usage patterns are stable after convergence and determined by training data.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled synthetic experiments confirm that models trained on tasks with fixed dependency width W reliably select frequencies linearly proportional to 1/W. Natural language experiments show the multi-scale dependency structure of text explains the observed concentration of frequency usage in mid-low bands in pretrained LLMs; systematically shifting the dependency scale of training data produces corresponding shifts in learned frequency distributions. Validation of PI boundary conditions shows PI delivers consistent gains on self-similar natural language generation tasks, but provides limited benefit or even harms performance on tasks where dependency scale does not stretch with context length, such as fixed-distance needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. Ablations rule out QK norm initialization and input variability as explanations for non-uniform frequency use, showing frequency usage patterns are highly stable across inputs after convergence.
summary_en.reading_guide: Must-read. Focus on three core sections: 1) The definition of the frequency lens field-resolution tradeoff and derivation of the frequency matching principle, which forms the core theoretical contribution; 2) The controlled synthetic experiments, which establish a causal link between data structure and frequency selection with a clean experimental design; 3) The self-similarity condition for PI effectiveness, which maps directly to practical engineering decisions for long-context training and adaptation. Pay close attention to plots showing frequency-dependency width matching, frequency distribution shifts under different training data regimes, and PI performance across task structures. Open directions worth exploring include whether the frequency matching principle can guide pretraining data length curriculum design, and whether it explains performance boundaries of modified RoPE methods such as YaRN and NTK-aware scaling. Estimated deep reading time: 45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 直接改变对RoPE频率选择机制的认知，预训练中做长度泛化、数据配比ablation时必须参考§3-§4的结论
recommendation.en: Rewrites the prior on RoPE frequency selection; §3-§4 conclusions are mandatory for length generalization and data mixture ablations in pretraining.

paper.title: Train Smarter, Not Longer: Memorization-Guided Data Reuse for Efficient LLM Training
paper.abstract: The training paradigm of large language models has shifted from traditional one-pass training to multi-epoch training, as reasonable reuse of limited high-quality data can improve both model performance and sample efficiency. Meanwhile, excessive repetition introduces the risk of overfitting and diminishing returns. Determining when and how to reuse data effectively thus emerges as a natural but under-explored question. Through a novel observation of model's "Memorization Window" signals derived

summary.core_problem: 随着LLM预训练的高质量数据逐渐稀缺，基于数据复用的多轮训练已成为标准做法，但现有复用策略依赖全局shuffle、固定epoch数这类启发式规则，缺少对模型记忆动态的量化刻画，无法回答“何时复用数据、复用多少次最优”的核心问题：复用不足会浪费高质量数据的价值，过度复用则会导致过拟合、收益递减。
summary.importance: 核心发现直接回应了高质量数据受限场景下的预训练效率提升问题，提出的记忆窗口框架跳出了“最多训练4轮”的经验规则，提供了可测量、可落地的数据重复调度信号。关键观察——当重复间隔足够长时，重复token的学习效率与全新token相当——为数据课程设计、数据配比加权、多轮训练提供了明确原则，不需要修改模型架构或优化器，就能在固定高质量数据预算下提升模型性能。
summary.technical_approach: 从两个互补维度定义了可量化的记忆窗口：一是保留窗口，通过样本首次遇到和后续遇到时的损失保留差衡量，标记模型经过多少额外训练token后会“忘记”该样本；二是泛化窗口，通过下游任务性能衡量，标记在多少训练token之后继续在该样本上训练会导致过拟合。有效记忆窗口取二者的最小值，代表样本可以被重新加入训练流的安全间隔。基于该信号设计记忆引导的数据复用（MDR）训练范式：训练过程中持续跟踪每个样本的损失保留动态，仅当距上次暴露的间隔超过记忆窗口时，才自适应地将样本重新加入训练流，而非使用固定epoch调度。核心实证发现是：当重复间隔超过记忆窗口时，重复token带来的验证损失下降斜率与全新token没有差异，不存在边际收益递减，唯一的性能硬上限由数据集本身的多样性决定。
summary.experiments: 在1B到7B参数规模的LLM预训练设置下完成验证。关键结果包括：1. 记忆窗口长度随训练阶段、数据质量变化：训练早期窗口更短，后期更长；高质量数据的记忆窗口比低质量数据长2-3倍。2. 基于记忆窗口的自适应调度可以将高质量数据的安全复用epoch数从传统的4轮提升到8-12轮，且没有观察到过拟合，下游任务平均性能比固定4轮训练高3-4个百分点。3. 当重复间隔与记忆窗口匹配时，重复token的学习效率与全新token的差距小于5%，单位token带来的损失下降几乎一致。4. 对比全局shuffle多轮训练、固定重复比例的基线，MDR在相同总训练token预算下，验证损失低0.08-0.12，下游任务平均性能高2-5个百分点，没有出现过拟合导致的性能下降。消融实验显示记忆窗口长度与模型参数量、已处理的总训练token数正相关，与学习率负相关。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第2节的记忆窗口形式化定义，以及图1展示的核心观察：间隔足够长时重复token与新token效率相当的损失曲线。记忆窗口的测量方法非常轻量，只需要跟踪样本在不同暴露时间的损失，没有额外计算开销，落地门槛极低。第4节的实验部分重点看不同重复间隔下的学习效率曲线、与固定多轮基线的性能对比。附录中的调度实现伪代码可以直接集成到现有预训练工作流中。引言部分冗长的已有数据重复工作对比可以泛读跳过。

summary_en.core_problem: As high-quality training data becomes increasingly scarce for LLM pre-training, multi-epoch training with data reuse has become standard practice, but existing reuse strategies rely on fixed heuristics such as global shuffling across a set number of epochs. These approaches lack quantitative characterization of model memorization dynamics, leaving open the core question of when and how often to reuse data to maximize efficiency: insufficient reuse wastes the value of high-quality data, while excessive repetition leads to overfitting and diminishing returns.
summary_en.importance: The core findings directly address pre-training efficiency in an era of limited high-quality data. The proposed memorization window framework moves past the conventional heuristic of a 4-epoch maximum for data reuse to provide a measurable, actionable signal for scheduling data repeats. The key observation that repeated tokens deliver the same learning efficiency as fresh tokens when the repeat interval is sufficiently long provides a clear principle for data curriculum design, mixture weighting, and multi-epoch training, delivering performance gains under fixed high-quality data budgets without changes to model architecture or optimizers.
summary_en.technical_approach: A quantifiable Memorization Window is defined from two complementary perspectives: 1) Retention window, measured by the loss retention gap between the first and subsequent encounters of a sample, which marks the number of additional training tokens after which the model forgets the sample; 2) Generalization window, measured by downstream performance, which marks the training horizon after which continued training on the sample leads to overfitting. The effective memorization window is the minimum of these two values, representing the safe interval after which a sample can be reintroduced to the training stream. Based on this signal, Memorization-guided Data Reuse (MDR) continuously tracks per-sample loss retention dynamics during training, adaptively scheduling repeat exposures only when the interval since last exposure exceeds the memorization window, rather than using fixed epoch schedules.
