summary.technical_approach: 论文的核心技术是 Natural Identifiers，简称 NIDs。NIDs 是由已知机制生成、在自然语料中真实存在的随机字符串。由于格式分布可复现，审计者可以针对某种 NID 类型生成大量同分布的 non-member 样本。对于 DP 审计，论文改造 Steinke et al. 的 one-run auditing 框架，用训练集中自然出现的 NID 作为事后 canary，再用生成的同分布 NID 构造审计集，从而不需要重新训练模型。对于 dataset inference，流程是先在可疑数据集里识别 NID 类型，再生成同类型 held-out 集，然后用已有 DI 方法比较模型在 suspect NIDs 和 generated non-member NIDs 上的行为差异。与人工注入 canary 的方法相比，这个方案不要求修改预训练数据，也不要求访问私有同分布验证集。
summary.experiments: 实验使用训练数据已知的开源模型和语料做受控验证，包括 Pythia 系列与 The Pile，以及 OLMo 与 Dolma。结果显示，NIDs 可以支持 post-hoc DP auditing，并且相比 Steinke et al. 的原始审计设置给出更强的隐私参数下界，同时降低所需 NID canary 数量。Dataset inference 实验表明，在包含 NID 的多个数据子集上可以判断其是否进入训练集，并报告没有 false positives。论文强调该方法适用于任何包含可识别 NID 类型的 suspect dataset，但有效性依赖 NID 的自然出现频率、格式生成器是否准确、以及模型是否对这些随机标识符产生了可测的记忆信号。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 DP auditing、membership inference、dataset inference 三者关系的梳理；方法部分看 NID 的定义、生成同分布 non-member 的条件，以及如何嵌入 Steinke et al. 和 Maini et al. 的审计流程；实验部分重点看 Pythia/Pile 与 OLMo/Dolma 的设置、false positive 控制、sample complexity 对比。若只关心预训练数据治理，可直接读 NID 类型统计和 dataset inference 结果。
summary.authors_note: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security；作者包括 Lorenzo Rossi、Bartłomiej Marek、Franziska Boenisch、Adam Dziedzic。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two practical blockers in LLM privacy and data audits. Formal DP audits usually require canaries to be inserted before training, which prevents cheap audits of already-trained models. Dataset inference needs an IID non-member held-out set for the suspect data, which is often unavailable in real cases.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about pretraining-data auditability. The paper identifies naturally occurring structured random strings as audit handles inside real corpora. Examples include cryptographic hashes, shortened URLs, and cryptocurrency addresses. Because their generation process is known, auditors can synthesize non-member strings from the same distribution. This creates a post-hoc alternative to injected canaries and makes dataset-level training membership tests more practical for pretrained LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method introduces Natural Identifiers, or NIDs. A NID is a naturally occurring random-looking string with a well-defined format and generator. The known generator lets the auditor create unlimited non-member samples that match the format distribution of the suspected member strings. For DP auditing, the paper adapts the one-run auditing framework of Steinke et al. by treating naturally present NIDs as retroactive canaries and generating matched audit strings after training. For dataset inference, it identifies NID types inside a suspect dataset, generates held-out NIDs of the same type, and applies DI procedures that compare model behavior on suspect strings versus generated non-members. The key difference from canary-injection approaches is that no retraining and no modification of the pretraining corpus are required.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical validation uses open models with known training corpora, including the Pythia suite trained on The Pile and OLMo trained on Dolma. The results show that NIDs enable post-hoc DP auditing and improve lower bounds on privacy parameters relative to the original Steinke-style audit setup, while reducing the number of required canaries. For dataset inference, the method detects membership of diverse data subsets containing NIDs and reports no false positives in the controlled experiments. The approach depends on having enough naturally occurring NIDs, an accurate generator for their format, and a measurable memorization signal in the audited model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Read the introduction for the audit setting and the distinction between DP auditing, membership inference, and dataset inference. Then inspect the NID definition and the conditions under which generated strings are valid IID non-members. The most useful experimental details are the Pythia/Pile and OLMo/Dolma setups, the false-positive analysis, and the sample-complexity comparison against canary-based auditing. For pretraining data governance, focus on the NID taxonomy and the dataset inference experiments.
summary_en.authors_note: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security; Lorenzo Rossi, Bartłomiej Marek, Franziska Boenisch, and Adam Dziedzic.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和误报分析；NID 是少数能落到真实预训练数据审计的信号，但 tokenizer/去重会决定上限。
recommendation.en: Read the method and false-positive analysis; NIDs are a practical audit signal, but tokenizer behavior and deduplication will set the ceiling.

paper.title: The African Language Tax: Quantifying the Cost, Latency, and Context Penalty of Tokenizing African Languages in Frontier LLMs
paper.abstract: Commercial large language models bill, scale latency, and budget context per token. Yet tokenizers assign more subword tokens to the same meaning in some languages than in others, so speakers of languages with high token-fertility pay a structural penalty before a model is ever invoked. This penalty is documented for multilingual settings in general, but it has not been measured systematically for African languages at the level of enterprise deployment economics and cognitive context capacity. W

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的不是多语言能力本身，而是 tokenizer 在不同语言上的结构性不公平，尤其是非洲语言在前沿 LLM 中被切得更碎，导致同样语义需要更多 token，进而带来更高 API 成本、更长延迟和更短有效上下文。论文要解决的核心问题是：这种“tokenization tax”在非洲语言上到底有多大，能否用严格可复现的并行语料测量方法，把它从抽象讨论变成可量化、可比较、可部署决策使用的指标。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在 tokenizer 和数据分布层面。第一，它提醒人们 tokenizer 不是中性的预处理，而是直接决定训练和推理经济性的建模组件。对基座模型来说，词表学习若长期偏向英语和高资源网页语料，就会把低资源语言的成本永久固化到系统里。第二，论文把 token fertility、context efficiency、成本和延迟连起来，说明 tokenizer 设计会影响真实可用上下文长度，这对长上下文训练、跨语言对齐、统一词表设计都很关键。第三，它提供了一个比较干净的测量框架：用 parallel corpus 固定语义内容，只看语言—tokenizer 对的编码效率差异。这种方法对后续做 multilingual tokenizer、byte-level / unigram / BPE 对比、词表再分配都很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是做一个基于并行语料的 tokenizer 审计。作者强调，若直接在非平行语料上比较 token 数，语言差异会和主题、文体、句长混在一起；而并行语料能固定“表达的意义”，使 token 数差异更接近语言形态、书写系统和 tokenizer 词表覆盖本身。为此，论文对 20 种非洲语言和 11 个当前前沿/开放 tokenizer 做统一测量。

指标设计比较扎实。基础计数包括统一 Unicode NFC 归一化后的 word count、token count、character count、UTF-8 byte count。token count 明确排除 special/BOS/EOS，避免固定序列开销污染比较。word segmentation 使用统一的 Unicode UAX-29 规则，而不是为某些语言手工定制，这样牺牲了一部分语言学细腻度，但换来跨语言可比性。核心指标有五个：fertility（tokens per word）、premium（相对英语的 fertility 倍数）、characters per token、bytes per token，以及固定窗口下的 context efficiency。论文还明确采用 corpus-level sum-then-divide，而不是 sentence-level mean-of-ratios，避免短句比例过高时统计不稳定。

在结果解释层，作者没有停留在 tokenizer 内部指标，而是把 fertility 映射到企业部署关心的量：美元和本地货币成本、生成延迟倍数、固定 context window 下可容纳真实内容的比例。这里的思路很实用：如果某语言的 fertility 是英语的 P 倍，那么在相同 API 定价和上下文窗口下，它天然要付出 P 倍左右的 token 成本，并损失相应的“操作记忆”。论文还把汇率波动纳入本地货币成本模型，这一点对非洲市场是现实问题，不只是学术装饰。
summary.experiments:
从全文可确认的实验设计看，作者评估了 20 种非洲语言、11 个 tokenizer，并给出 corpus-level aggregation 与 bootstrap confidence intervals。语言覆盖多种脚本和形态类型，包括拉丁、Geʿez/Ethiopic、Arabic/Ajami、N’Ko 等，这使得结果不只是“低资源语言更差”这么简单，而能分离脚本和形态复杂度的影响。论文还把结果实例化到三个部署场景：银行客服、临床分诊、农业短信咨询，用来展示 fertility 差异如何转化为实际预算、延迟和上下文损耗。

不过，就目前给出的全文片段，具体每种语言和每个 tokenizer 的主结果数值、最高 premium、不同 tokenizer 排名差异等细节没有完整展开，因此没法负责任地复述精确榜单数字。可以确定的是，作者的目标不是证明某一个 tokenizer 最好，而是建立一个可复现基线，并展示非洲语言的 tokenization penalty 明显高于英语，且这种惩罚会同时体现在成本、延迟和 context erosion 上。若阅读全文，最值得抓的应是各语言在不同 tokenizer 下的 premium 分布、脚本族之间的系统差异，以及 context efficiency 在 128k 窗口下的相对损失。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Definitions & Metrics，这两部分决定了论文是否站得住。重点确认三件事：为什么必须用 parallel corpus；为什么 fertility 要用 sum-then-divide 聚合；为什么要同时报告 bytes/token 和 context efficiency，而不只看 tokens/word。接着看主结果表和 leaderboard 式图，关注哪些 tokenizer 在非洲语言上更稳，哪些脚本族受到的惩罚最大。最后看 cost model 和三个 deployment scenario，判断这些数字是否足够接近真实生产约束。

预计 25–35 分钟可以读完主线。若想深挖，建议重点看附录里的语料来源、分词实现、异常样本处理和 bootstrap 细节，因为这类测量论文最容易在预处理上引入偏差。另一个值得追问的问题是：如果某些语言在 word segmentation 上天然不适合 UAX-29，那么 fertility 的绝对值会受多大影响；不过即便如此，只要所有语言使用同一规则，相对比较仍然有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a structural inefficiency in frontier LLM tokenizers: many African languages are segmented into far more tokens than English for the same semantic content. That creates a direct penalty in API cost, latency, and usable context length before model quality even enters the picture. The core problem is to measure this tokenization tax rigorously and reproducibly for African languages, rather than treating it as an anecdotal multilingual fairness issue.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is mainly through tokenizer design and data imbalance. Tokenization is not a neutral preprocessing step; it fixes part of the economics of both training and inference. If the vocabulary is learned mostly from English and other high-resource web languages, low-resource languages inherit a persistent efficiency penalty. The paper is also useful because it connects fertility to context efficiency, which matters for long-context modeling and multilingual system design. Methodologically, the use of parallel corpora gives a cleaner estimate of language–tokenizer efficiency than comparisons on unrelated corpora, so the work provides a solid measurement template for future multilingual tokenizer studies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main method is a parallel-corpus audit of tokenizers. The authors argue that non-parallel corpora confound language effects with topic, register, and sentence-length differences. By holding meaning constant across translations, differences in token counts can be attributed more directly to the interaction between language, script, morphology, and tokenizer vocabulary coverage. They evaluate 20 African languages against 11 current frontier and open tokenizers.

The metric design is careful. After Unicode NFC normalization, they compute word count, token count, character count, and UTF-8 byte count under a fixed convention shared across all languages. Token counts exclude BOS/EOS and other special tokens to avoid sequence-overhead artifacts. Word segmentation follows a uniform Unicode UAX-29 rule rather than language-specific heuristics, prioritizing comparability over linguistic tailoring. The paper then derives five metrics: fertility (tokens per word), premium relative to English, characters per token, bytes per token, and context efficiency under a fixed window size. Corpus-level aggregation uses sum-then-divide rather than mean-of-ratios, which is the right choice for stability.

A practical contribution is the translation of fertility into deployment-facing quantities: USD and local-currency costs, latency multipliers, and effective context-window erosion. This makes the tokenizer issue legible to system builders, not just NLP researchers. The inclusion of local-currency volatility in the cost model is also a realistic touch for the target deployment setting.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text content, the study evaluates 20 African languages and 11 tokenizers, with corpus-level aggregation and bootstrap confidence intervals. The language set spans multiple script families and morphological profiles, including Latin, Geʿez/Ethiopic, Arabic/Ajami, and N’Ko, which should make the analysis more informative than a generic multilingual average. The paper also instantiates the cost model in three deployment scenarios: bank customer service, clinical triage, and agricultural SMS assistance.

What is not fully visible in the provided text is the exact leaderboard of premiums, the worst-case language–tokenizer pairs, and the detailed ranking differences across tokenizers. So it would be unsafe to invent precise headline numbers. What is clear is the intended empirical claim: African languages incur a measurable and often substantial tokenization penalty relative to English, and that penalty compounds into higher cost, slower generation, and reduced effective context capacity. When reading the full paper, the most important results to inspect are the premium distributions by language and tokenizer, the script-family effects, and the relative context efficiency at the 128k window size.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim read, start with the introduction and the metrics section. Those two parts determine whether the measurement setup is credible. Focus on three design choices: why parallel corpora are necessary, why fertility is aggregated with sum-then-divide, and why bytes-per-token and context efficiency are reported alongside tokens-per-word. Then move to the main result tables or leaderboard plots to see which tokenizers are consistently better or worse for African languages and which scripts are most penalized. Finish with the cost model and deployment scenarios to judge whether the analysis maps cleanly to real production constraints.

A 25 to 35 minute read should be enough for the main thread. If reading more carefully, spend time on the appendix sections covering corpus construction, segmentation implementation, preprocessing edge cases, and bootstrap details. Measurement papers often live or die on these choices. One additional question worth checking is how sensitive the absolute fertility values are to the chosen word-segmentation standard for languages that do not align neatly with UAX-29.

recommendation.zh: 建议读结果表；它把 tokenizer fertility 从公平性口号落到成本和上下文预算，可反查内部词表盲点。
recommendation.en: Read the result tables; it turns tokenizer fertility from a fairness slogan into cost and context-budget accounting, useful for auditing internal vocabularies.

paper.title: LangMAP: A Language-Adaptive Approach to Tokenization
paper.abstract: Language-specific tokenizers improve tokenization quality and the downstream performance of models on those languages. However, using such a tokenizer comes at a cost: either a new model must be trained from scratch, or the vocabulary of an existing pretrained model must be adapted. We propose Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori (LangMAP) Tokenization, a tokenization scheme that extends the UnigramLM algorithm to the multilingual setting, producing language-specific tokenization from a single

summary.core_problem: 现有生产级多语言分词器普遍以英语统计为核心优化，导致非英语语言（尤其是黏着语、非拉丁脚本）分词过碎、词素边界对齐差，拉低下游性能、推高推理成本；而现有语言专属分词适配方案要么需要从头训练模型，要么需要修改预训练模型词表并适配参数，算力开销极高。很多时候分词质量差并非词表缺少对应词素，而是全局分词规则（如BPE中高优先级的th合并）会跨词素切分，现有方案存在不必要的开销。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的核心价值是：在不改动词表、不重新预训练/适配模型参数的前提下，仅通过调整分词的概率建模逻辑就能优化多语言/代码的分词质量，大幅降低多语言基座预训练的词表设计成本，以及英文主导预训练模型向小语种适配的迁移成本。UnigramLM框架的语言条件化扩展也为多语言分词的统一建模提供了新思路，避免了为不同语言维护独立分词器/词表的复杂度。
summary.technical_approach: 基于UnigramLM算法扩展出LangMAP（语言自适应最大后验分词），核心设计保留共享词表不变：1）训练阶段：在同一固定词表下，为每种语言单独学习一套token概率分布（替代原生UnigramLM的全局单一分布），仅需要带语言标签的语料，不需要修改词表或模型参数；2）推理阶段：对输入字符串，分别计算每种语言专属分布下的最大后验（MAP）分词结果，选择全局似然最高的结果输出，不需要输入显式语言标签。
summary.experiments: 针对9种自然语言+9种编程语言改造多个开源分词器，结果：1）自然语言：对基座词表脚本覆盖度高的语言，词素边界对齐准确率显著提升；对脚本覆盖度差的语言，提升接近0；2）代码：所有测试语言的AST叶子节点边界对齐准确率一致提升；3）微调实验（仅在分词变化最大的语言上测试）：LangMAP训练的模型在目标语言的MultiBLiMP（语法可接受性任务）上准确率高于同配置基线，黏着语提升最明显；常识推理（Global-PIQA）、阅读理解（Belebele）上无一致差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计20-25分钟。重点关注：引言中德语复合词Rathaus的分词例子（直观理解全局分词规则的核心缺陷）；分词方法章节中LangMAP与原生UnigramLM的公式对比（掌握共享词表下语言专属分布的设计逻辑）；实验部分的边界对齐结果与分语言微调表现（明确方法的适用边界：仅对词表脚本覆盖充分的语言有效）。不需要深抠EM优化的数学细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Most production multilingual tokenizers are optimized for English statistics, causing over-segmentation and poor morpheme boundary alignment for non-English languages (especially agglutinative languages and non-Latin scripts), which degrades downstream performance and inflates inference costs. Existing language-specific tokenization adaptation solutions require either full model retraining or vocabulary modification with parameter adaptation, incurring prohibitive compute overhead. Critically, poor segmentation often stems not from missing vocabulary coverage, but from global tokenization rules (e.g., high-priority 'th' merge in BPE) that cut across morpheme boundaries, making existing adaptation schemes unnecessarily costly.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, LangMAP demonstrates that tokenization quality for non-English languages and code can be improved via probability modeling adjustments alone, with no vocabulary changes, retraining, or parameter adaptation required. This sharply reduces the cost of vocabulary design for multilingual base models, as well as the migration cost of adapting English-centric pretrained checkpoints to low-resource languages. The language-conditional extension of the UnigramLM framework also provides a unified modeling path for multilingual tokenization, eliminating the complexity of maintaining independent tokenizers or vocabularies per language.
summary_en.technical_approach: LangMAP (Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori tokenization) extends the vanilla UnigramLM algorithm with two key adjustments while keeping the vocabulary fully fixed: 1) Training stage: Instead of learning a single global token probability distribution, it learns language-specific distributions over the shared fixed vocabulary, requiring only language-labeled corpus and no vocabulary or model parameter changes. 2) Inference stage: For an input string, it computes the MAP segmentation under each language-specific distribution, then selects the segmentation with the highest overall likelihood as output, with no explicit input language label required.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 9 natural languages and 9 programming languages across multiple open-source tokenizers. Results: 1) Natural language: Significant gains in morpheme boundary alignment for languages with scripts well-covered by the base vocabulary; near-zero gains for poorly covered scripts. 2) Code: Consistent improvements in AST leaf boundary alignment across all tested programming languages. 3) Fine-tuning experiments (only on languages with the largest segmentation changes): Models trained with LangMAP achieve higher target-language MultiBLiMP (grammatical acceptability) accuracy than identically configured baselines, with the largest gains on agglutinative languages; no consistent differences are observed on commonsense reasoning (Global-PIQA) or reading comprehension (Belebele).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, 20-25 minutes estimated. Focus on: The German compound word 'Rathaus' example in the Introduction (intuitive illustration of global tokenization rule flaws); formula comparison between LangMAP and vanilla UnigramLM in the Tokenization section (core design of language-specific distributions over a shared vocabulary); boundary alignment results and per-language fine-tuning performance in the experiments section (to clarify the method's applicability boundary: effective only for languages with well-covered scripts). No need to dive into mathematical details of EM optimization.

recommendation.zh: 一种优雅的无需修改词表的多语言分词适配方案，对多语言预训练和词表设计有启发，值得关注其 UnigramLM 扩展机制。
recommendation.en: An elegant multilingual tokenization adaptation scheme without modifying the vocabulary, inspiring for multilingual pretraining and vocabulary design; worth noting its UnigramLM extension mechanism.

paper.title: Data Pruning: Redundant, Problematic, and Interdependent Samples
paper.abstract: The performance of deep learning models is affected by not only data quantity but also data quality. Data pruning is a process by which practitioners can reduce the size of a dataset by only keeping the most important training data points, thereby achieving similar test set performance. We empirically investigate two popular data pruning methods under noisy and noiseless conditions and show that these methods fail in the presence of significant label noise. We highlight that the success of data

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论数据剪枝中的一个基础问题：常用的样本打分方法是否真的能识别“可以安全删除”的训练样本。作者指出，样本价值不是一个稳定的单点属性。它会被数据冗余、标签噪声或异常样本，以及样本之间的相互依赖共同影响。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发主要是负面的边界提醒。LLM 数据筛选常把单样本 loss、困惑度、梯度范数、早期学习动态等指标当作质量代理，但这类指标容易把“有价值的难样本”和“有害的噪声样本”混在一起。论文虽然实验对象是分类数据集和常规神经网络，不是 LLM 预训练，但它强调了一个可迁移的问题：静态、逐样本的 pruning score 很难刻画数据子集的联合价值。对大规模预训练而言，这意味着数据去重、质量过滤、难度课程和污染样本移除不能只依赖单一排序指标。
summary.technical_approach: 论文采用标准数据剪枝评估流程：先对训练样本打分，再按分数从低到高逐步删除样本，最后在剪枝后的数据上重新训练模型，并用测试集性能形成 ψ-curve。作者重点考察两类经典打分方法。第一类是 forgetting score，统计样本在训练过程中从“被正确分类”变成“被错误分类”的次数。第二类是 EL2N score，使用早期训练阶段模型预测分布与真实标签 one-hot 向量之间的 L2 误差来衡量样本难度。论文的关键观点不是提出新的剪枝算法，而是拆解剪枝成功或失败的条件：冗余样本多时，删除低价值样本可能不伤性能；存在错标或冲突样本时，高难度分数未必对应高信息量；样本之间有互补或替代关系时，一次性打分无法反映删除某些样本后的边际价值变化。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕常见分类 benchmark、不同神经网络架构、干净标签和注入标签噪声的设置展开。主要结论是：在无明显噪声且存在冗余的数据中，forgetting score 和 EL2N 这类方法可以在一定剪枝比例内保持测试性能；但在显著标签噪声下，这些方法会失效，因为高分样本可能包含错标、边界样本和真正有用的稀有样本，排序信号变得混杂。作者还强调，某些样本的存在会改变其他样本对泛化的贡献，因此“样本重要性”不是简单可加的。可见正文没有给出完整表格数值，精确剪枝比例和性能变化需要查看实验图中的 ψ-curve。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–20 分钟。重点看 Methods 中 pruning framework、forgetting score、EL2N score 的定义，再看实验部分中 clean/noisy 条件下的 ψ-curve。对 LLM 预训练研究者，最有用的是讨论部分关于 redundancy、problematic samples、interdependence 的分解。它可以帮助重新审视 loss-based filtering、dedup、quality classifier 和 data ablation 的解释边界。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether common data-pruning scores actually identify training examples that can be removed without hurting generalization. Its main point is that sample value is not an intrinsic scalar. It depends on redundancy, noisy or problematic examples, and interactions among samples.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining is mainly a caution about data selection signals. Large-scale LM pipelines often use per-example proxies such as loss, perplexity, gradient-related scores, or early training dynamics. This paper shows why such signals can be confounded: hard but useful examples and mislabeled or contradictory examples may receive similar scores, and the marginal value of an example can change after other examples are removed. The experiments are on classification datasets rather than LM pretraining, so the contribution is not a direct LLM recipe. The useful lesson is about the limits of static per-sample ranking for data filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper follows the standard pruning protocol: assign a score to each training sample, remove increasing fractions according to the ranking, retrain on the reduced dataset, and plot test performance as a pruning curve. It studies two established scores. Forgetting score counts how often an example changes from being classified correctly to incorrectly during training. EL2N measures the early-training L2 distance between the model prediction vector and the one-hot label. The technical contribution is an empirical and conceptual decomposition of pruning behavior. Redundancy makes pruning possible; problematic samples make difficulty-based scores unreliable; sample interdependence means that a fixed one-shot ranking cannot capture subset utility.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use standard classification benchmarks and neural network architectures under clean and noisy-label settings. The main finding is that pruning scores can work when the dataset is relatively clean and redundant, but they degrade under substantial label noise. In noisy settings, high-score examples mix mislabeled samples, boundary cases, and genuinely informative rare cases, so the ranking no longer cleanly separates useful from harmful data. The paper also shows that the contribution of one sample can depend strongly on the presence of others. The visible text does not provide the full numerical tables, so exact pruning ratios and accuracy changes should be read from the experimental pruning curves.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Read the method section for the pruning protocol and the definitions of forgetting score and EL2N. Then focus on the clean-versus-noisy pruning curves and the discussion of redundancy, problematic samples, and interdependence. For LM pretraining work, the main value is as a diagnostic frame for interpreting loss-based filtering, deduplication, quality classifiers, and data ablations.

recommendation.zh: 预训练数据剪枝团队需关注样本间依赖这一被忽略的维度，内部ablation应加入标签噪声鲁棒性测试，看§3-§4即可
recommendation.en: Pretraining data pruning teams should note the understudied sample interdependence dimension; add label-noise robustness tests in internal ablations, read §3-§4 only

paper.title: Where Does the Signal Live? A Web Data Recipe for Medical Encoder Pretraining
paper.abstract: Web data curation has been widely studied for decoder Large Language Model (LLM) pretraining. Encoders for dense-terminology domains such as medicine, by contrast, are pretrained on small, manually-curated corpora that limit scalability and writing style diversity, a bottleneck even more severe in non-English clinical settings. Whether web-scale data curation also benefits encoder Masked Language Modeling (MLM) in a dense-terminology domain remains an open question. To address this, we introduce

summary.core_problem: 密集术语领域（如医学）的MLM编码器仍依赖小规模人工语料预训练，尚未验证web规模数据策展对这类领域编码器的效果。
summary.importance: 首次验证web数据筛选与增强方法对垂直领域MLM编码器预训练的有效性，给出可落地的领域数据处理配方。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两个互补策略：一是医学术语密度过滤筛选高领域相关文档，二是用LLM对文档做信号增强重写，扩充实体上下文密度。在法语医疗NLP场景验证。
summary.experiments: 医学术语密度过滤效果优于通用教育质量过滤器，两者可互补；信号增强重写相比原始web数据有明显提升，与过滤语料混合后效果进一步提升。

summary_en.core_problem: MLM encoders for dense-terminology domains like medicine still rely on small manually curated corpora, with no existing validation of whether web-scale data curation benefits such domain encoders.
summary_en.importance: First validation of web data curation and augmentation methods for domain-specific MLM encoder pretraining, providing an actionable domain data processing recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose two complementary levers: medical-term density filtering to select domain-relevant documents, and LLM-based signal-amplifying rephrasing to increase entity context density; validate on French medical NLP tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Medical-term density filtering outperforms standard educational quality filters and the two are complementary; signal-amplifying rephrasing improves over raw web data, with further gains when mixed with filtered data.

recommendation.zh: 垂直医疗领域MLM编码器的数据筛选工作，术语密度过滤的思路对通用预训练专业语料处理有弱参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: A data curation recipe for domain-specific medical MLM encoders; the term-density filtering idea provides weak reference for general pretraining domain data processing, read abstract only.

paper.title: From Speech to Text Corpora: Evaluating ASR-Based Data Acquisition for Low-Resource Fongbe and Hausa
paper.abstract: Low-resource African languages lack text corpora needed for language model training. We investigate whether ASR pipelines can extend text resources for two typologically distinct West African languages: Fongbe (tonal, diacritic-rich) and Hausa (non-tonal). We fine-tune MMS-300M on a curated 12.3-hour Fongbe dataset, achieving 9.48% WER on the ALFFA benchmark - a 78% relative reduction from the prior 44.04% baseline - while preserving tonal diacritics critical to the language. For Hausa, we apply

summary.core_problem: 评估能否用 ASR 管线从公开视频中为 Fongbe 和 Hausa 这类低资源语言构建可用于语言模型训练的文本语料。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是低资源语料获取和质量审计；它与预训练数据建设有关，但范围集中在两个语言和 ASR 转写质量，不是通用数据配比或清洗方法。
summary.technical_approach: 对 Fongbe 使用 12.3 小时人工整理语音微调 MMS-300M，并保留声调和变音符号；对 Hausa 使用已有微调 Whisper-Small。随后从 YouTube 编目 1,553 个视频共 236 小时，按领域多样性和计算预算筛选子集转写。
summary.experiments: Fongbe 在 ALFFA benchmark 上达到 9.48% WER，相对先前 44.04% baseline 降低 78%。实际采集处理 424 个视频、45.49 小时，产出 6,770 个转写片段。每种语言随机 50 段人工评分，Hausa 平均 57.4/100，Fongbe 平均 36.5/100，说明 Hausa 接近可用，Fongbe 仍偏噪。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Carnegie Mellon University Africa 和 North-West University；主题偏低资源语言数据建设。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether ASR pipelines can turn public speech content into text corpora for low-resource Fongbe and Hausa language modeling.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining-data acquisition and quality-audit study for low-resource languages, but it is narrow in language scope and mainly studies ASR transcription viability rather than general data-mixture or filtering principles.
summary_en.technical_approach: For Fongbe, the authors fine-tune MMS-300M on a curated 12.3-hour dataset while preserving tonal diacritics. For Hausa, they use an existing fine-tuned Whisper-Small model. They then catalog 1,553 YouTube videos totaling 236 hours and process a compute-bounded, domain-diverse subset.
summary_en.experiments: The Fongbe ASR model reaches 9.48% WER on ALFFA, a 78% relative reduction from a 44.04% baseline. The pipeline processes 424 videos, 45.49 hours, and produces 6,770 transcribed segments. Human ratings on 50 sampled segments per language give 57.4/100 for Hausa and 36.5/100 for Fongbe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Carnegie Mellon University Africa and North-West University; the work is centered on low-resource language data creation.

recommendation.zh: 作为低资源语料获取的失败边界案例可备查；读质量评分即可，别把 ASR 文本默认当干净预训练数据。
recommendation.en: Useful as a boundary case for low-resource corpus acquisition; read the quality scores and do not assume ASR text is clean pretraining data.

institutions: Carnegie Mellon University Africa, Kigali, Rwanda

paper.title: Hubs or Fringes: Pretraining Data Selection via Web Graph Centrality
paper.abstract: The performance of modern language models depends critically on pretraining data composition. Yet existing data selection methods rely on auxiliary classifiers for document scoring or mixture optimization, adding computational overhead and dependence on labeled data. We propose WebGraphMix, a lightweight data selection framework that computes structural centrality scores over the Common Crawl host-level web graph and uses them to vary the proportion of central versus peripheral documents in the

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是预训练数据选择中过度依赖“单文档内容打分”的问题。现有数据管线通常把网页当作独立样本，用质量分类器、领域分类器或小规模 proxy 训练来决定采样权重。这类方法有两个限制：一是需要额外模型、标注或调参；二是忽略了网页之间的链接结构。WebGraphMix 的问题设定是：Common Crawl 不只是一个文档集合，也是一个大规模 Web 图；网页所在 host 的图位置，可能携带与预训练能力相关的信号。中心节点可能提供更可迁移的通用抽象，边缘节点可能提供更长尾、更专门的知识。
summary.importance: 这项工作的价值不在于给出一个复杂的新模型，而在于把“Web 图拓扑”引入预训练数据配比，并证明它和内容质量信号有互补性。对基座预训练研究来说，这是一类低成本、可复用、无需训练打分器的数据选择信号。它补上了 DCLM、FineWeb、RefinedWeb 等管线中较少显式建模的一块：网页之间的结构关系。贡献量级属于中等偏实用：不是替代质量过滤或领域 mixture optimization，而是提供一个可叠加的维度。尤其值得注意的是，中心数据和边缘数据对不同能力族的影响不同，这说明“高质量数据”不能只被压缩成一个标量分数；结构位置可能对应不同的能力增益。
summary.technical_approach: WebGraphMix 使用 Common Crawl 的 host-level hyperlink graph。图中每个节点是一个 host，例如 wikipedia.org；有向边表示 host 之间的超链接。论文使用的图规模为 13.9M 个节点、439.6M 条边。方法不是对每篇文档训练一个质量模型，而是先在 host 图上计算中心性分数，再把该 host 下的文档映射到对应分数，并据此构造预训练采样混合。主要测试两类中心性：Betweenness centrality 和 Katz centrality。Betweenness 衡量一个节点出现在大量最短路径上的程度，更像“桥接不同社区”的信号；Katz centrality 衡量一个节点与高影响节点的连接程度，带有传播式影响力的含义。论文也尝试了 PageRank，但没有观察到提升，这和 DCLM 中 PageRank 类信号效果有限的观察一致。实验设计上，作者构造偏中心、偏边缘、中心/边缘混合等数据子集，并固定 tokenizer、shuffle、优化器和训练流程，以尽量隔离数据选择本身的影响。进一步地，论文把中心性分数与 DCLM-fasttext 质量分类器结合，使用乘法和除法式打分来测试结构信号是否与内容质量信号互补。
summary.experiments: 实验接入标准化的 DataComp-LM pipeline。模型规模包括 400M 和 1B；训练 token 分别为 8B 和 28B。评测使用 DCLM CORE v2 的 23 个任务。中心性计算在完整 Common Crawl host 图上完成，总计算成本少于 9 个 GPU 小时，之后可以复用于不同训练实验。关键结果集中在 1B 规模：只采样结构中心 host 的文档，相比 uniform sampling，在 Symbolic & Algorithmic Reasoning 上提升约 +1.4%；采样结构边缘 host 的文档，则更有利于 Science & Factual Knowledge 以及 Commonsense & Reasoning。这个分化很重要，说明中心和边缘不是简单的优劣关系，而是携带不同类型的学习信号。最有效的基础混合是基于 betweenness 的 50% central + 50% peripheral，23 项平均分达到 41.4%，uniform sampling 为 39.8%。当中心性信号与 DCLM-fasttext 质量分类器组合后，平均分进一步达到 43.8%。这表明 Web 图结构不是质量分类器的重复版本，而是能补充内容打分无法直接看到的信息。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法部分中 host-level graph 的构造、中心性定义、文档到 host 分数的映射方式，以及采样 mixture 的具体实现。实验部分应重点看三类对比：central-only、peripheral-only、central/peripheral mixture；betweenness、Katz、PageRank 的差异；中心性分数与 DCLM-fasttext 质量分数结合后的结果。最值得深挖的是能力分组结果，而不只是 23 项平均分。中心 host 对符号和算法类任务更有帮助，边缘 host 对事实和常识类任务更有帮助，这一现象可能对数据课程、能力定向 mixture、long-tail data reweighting 都有启发。还应关注计算成本和可迁移性：中心性计算只需一次，成本远低于训练 proxy LM 或标注质量分类器。局限也需要一起读：host-level 聚合会丢失同一域名内部的页面差异；中心性分数可能受 SEO、站点模板、链接农场影响；28B token 训练规模仍偏小，结论需要在更大 token budget 和更强模型上验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies pretraining data selection beyond independent document scoring. Most current pipelines score or sample web documents using content-based quality classifiers, domain labels, or proxy training. These methods add cost and often ignore the hyperlink structure of the web. WebGraphMix asks whether a document’s position in the host-level web graph contains useful signal for LM pretraining. Central hosts may expose reusable abstractions and bridge heterogeneous topics, while peripheral hosts may carry specialized or long-tail knowledge.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a cheap and reusable structural signal for pretraining data curation. It does not replace quality filtering or domain mixture optimization, but adds a different axis: topology of the web graph. This is useful for pretraining research because large web corpora are not just bags of documents; their link structure encodes citation, topic, and authority patterns that standard document classifiers do not directly model. The empirical result that central and peripheral data help different capability groups is also important. It suggests that data quality should not always be reduced to a single scalar score, especially when the goal is to shape model capabilities rather than only improve average validation loss.
summary_en.technical_approach: WebGraphMix operates on the Common Crawl host-level hyperlink graph. Each node is a host, and each directed edge is a hyperlink between hosts. The graph used in the paper has 13.9M nodes and 439.6M edges. The method computes centrality scores on this graph, maps each document to the score of its host, and then constructs pretraining mixtures that emphasize central hosts, peripheral hosts, or a controlled combination of both. The main centrality measures are betweenness centrality and Katz centrality. Betweenness captures bridge-like nodes that lie on many shortest paths, while Katz centrality captures influence propagated through links to other influential nodes. The authors also test PageRank, but it does not improve results, matching a similar observation in DCLM. The experiments are integrated into the DataComp-LM pipeline, with tokenization, shuffling, and optimization held fixed to isolate the effect of data selection. The paper also combines graph centrality with the DCLM-fasttext quality classifier using multiplicative and divisive scoring, testing whether topology adds information beyond content-based quality.
summary_en.experiments: The paper trains 400M and 1B parameter models on 8B and 28B tokens, respectively, and evaluates on 23 tasks from DCLM CORE v2. Computing centrality on the full Common Crawl host graph takes less than 9 GPU hours in total, and the scores can be reused across experiments. At the 1B scale, selecting structurally central hosts improves Symbolic & Algorithmic Reasoning by about +1.4% over uniform sampling. Selecting peripheral hosts improves Science & Factual Knowledge and Commonsense & Reasoning. A 50/50 mixture of central and peripheral data based on betweenness reaches 41.4% average accuracy across the 23 tasks, compared with 39.8% for uniform sampling. Combining graph centrality with the DCLM-fasttext quality classifier further improves the average to 43.8%. The most useful empirical message is not just the average gain, but the capability split: central and peripheral web regions appear to provide different training signals.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the method section carefully for the host graph construction, the definition of centrality scores, the mapping from hosts to documents, and the sampling procedure. In the experiments, focus on three comparisons: central-only versus peripheral-only sampling, betweenness versus Katz versus PageRank, and graph centrality alone versus graph centrality combined with the DCLM-fasttext quality classifier. The capability-group breakdown is more informative than the overall average because it shows how structural data choices affect different skills. The most interesting follow-up questions are whether the same pattern holds at larger token budgets, whether host-level aggregation hides important page-level variation, and how robust the signal is to spam, SEO artifacts, and link farms. For a pretraining practitioner, the practical appeal is clear: the signal is unsupervised, cheap to compute once, and easy to combine with existing quality filters.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得认真看：它把“数据质量”从文本表面特征转到网页图结构，若实验干净，会直接影响你做 data mixture 的先验；先看 mixture sweep 和对 classifier baseline 的对照。
recommendation.en: Worth real attention: it shifts data selection from text-local quality signals to web-graph structure; if the controls are clean, it should update your prior on corpus mixture design—read the mixture sweep and classifier-baseline comparisons first.

authors: Vedant Badoni   Danqi Chen   Xinyi Wang{vedantbadoni, danqic}@princeton.eduwangxinyilinda@gmail.comPrinceton Language and Intelligence

paper.title: Characterizing Narrative Content in Web-scale LLM Pretraining Data
paper.abstract: The narrative composition of web-scale LLM pretraining corpora remains largely unexplored even though narrative is a fundamental mode of human communication. We present the first fine-grained study of narrative features in Dolma, a 3-trillion-token open pretraining corpus. Drawing on narrative theory, we design a framework spanning three core narrative elements (agency, setting, and events) operationalized as 11 interpretable dimensions. After sampling and annotating a diverse set of 400 passage

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：大规模网页预训练语料里到底包含什么样的叙事内容，以及这些叙事特征是否能被细粒度、可解释地测量。它不是做故事生成模型，而是把“叙事性”作为预训练数据的一个结构化属性来分析。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发点在于：数据源级别的配比太粗。DOLMA 这类开放语料通常按 books、Reddit、web、code 等来源来混合，但叙事能力相关的信号并不等价于某个来源标签。论文显示，叙事性是连续、多维的，并且在同一子语料内部也有明显差异。这会影响数据 mixture 的设计：如果只按来源降权或升权，可能无意中改变模型接触到的事件结构、人物视角、情绪表达、空间/时间 grounding 等分布。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一，作者基于叙事理论定义了 11 个可标注维度，覆盖三个核心元素：events，包括时间顺序和因果密度；agency，包括 focalization、emotion、cognition、state change、conflict；setting，包括 concreteness、temporal grounding、spatial grounding、sensory detail。多数维度用 1–5 Likert 分数表示，事件相关维度还包含比例型指标。第二，作者抽样并人工标注 400 个 DOLMA passage，用这些标注训练 NARRABERT，一个基于 RoBERTa 的多维叙事预测模型，并用人工与 LLM 标注做验证。第三，作者把模型应用到约 300 万个 DOLMA passage，构建 NARRADOLMA，用于分析不同来源和主题中的叙事结构分布。核心取舍是把叙事性建模为连续 profile，而不是二分类。这更适合网页语料，因为博客、论坛、新闻、说明文、评论经常混合事件、观点和场景描述。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是 DOLMA，一个约 3T token、包含 12 个子语料的开放预训练 corpus。论文先构建 400 条精标样本，再训练 NARRABERT 预测 11 个叙事维度，并额外用事件检测器导出 event density，形成 12 个特征。随后在约 300 万 passage 上生成 NARRADOLMA。主要发现包括：叙事结构可以在高度异质的网页语料中被稳定测量；叙事性不是单一轴，而是 agency、setting、events 的组合 profile；不同预训练来源和主题的叙事分布不均衡；同一来源内部也不应被视为叙事同质。摘要和正文片段没有给出 NARRABERT 的完整指标表，因此不适合夸大模型精度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对预训练数据 mixture 的动机，Figure 1 对 12 个叙事特征的定义，以及方法部分的标注框架。数据研究者可以重点看抽样策略、人工标注设计、NARRABERT 验证方式和 NARRADOLMA 的 source/topic 分析。真正值得带走的是维度设计，而不是 RoBERTa 分类器本身；分类器只是把小规模人工标注扩展到百万级样本的工具。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies what kinds of narrative structure exist in web-scale LLM pretraining data, and whether narrativity can be measured as a fine-grained, interpretable data attribute rather than a binary story/non-story label.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is about data mixture granularity. Source-level labels such as books, Reddit, web, or news are too coarse to describe the narrative exposure a model receives. The paper shows that narrative content varies continuously and unevenly across sources and topics, and also within the same source. This matters for models’ exposure to event structure, agency, perspective, emotion, conflict, and grounded settings. A mixture change that looks harmless at the source level may change these distributions substantially.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define 11 narrative dimensions grounded in narrative theory. The dimensions are grouped into events, agency, and setting: temporal ordering and causality for events; focalization, emotion, cognition, change of state, and conflict for agency; concreteness, temporal grounding, spatial grounding, and sensory detail for setting. Most dimensions are annotated on a 1–5 Likert scale, while event-related measures include passage-level proportions. They annotate 400 sampled DOLMA passages, train NARRABERT, a RoBERTa-based predictor for the 11 dimensions, validate it against human and LLM annotations, and then apply it to roughly 3 million DOLMA passages to produce NARRADOLMA. A separate event detector provides event density, giving 12 features in total.
summary_en.experiments: The study is conducted on DOLMA, a 3-trillion-token open pretraining corpus spanning 12 sub-corpora. The main pipeline moves from 400 manually annotated passages to a RoBERTa-based multi-dimension classifier and then to approximately 3 million labeled passages. The reported findings are qualitative but important for data analysis: narrativity is measurable at scale in heterogeneous web text; it forms a multidimensional profile rather than a single score; and narrative features are unevenly distributed across sources and topics. The provided text does not include the full NARRABERT performance table, so the main experimental takeaway is the corpus-level distributional analysis rather than the classifier accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the motivation in the introduction, the feature definitions around Figure 1, the annotation protocol, and the source/topic analyses in NARRADOLMA. For pretraining data work, the main value is the feature design and the argument against source-level homogeneity. The RoBERTa model is mainly a scaling mechanism from a small annotated set to a large corpus.

recommendation.zh: 读数据维度定义和 source-level 分布即可；它不会直接给 recipe，但会提醒你别只用 domain/quality 分桶看语料。
recommendation.en: Read the feature definitions and source-level distributions; it will not hand you a recipe, but it warns against viewing corpora only through domain and quality buckets.

paper.title: HumanScale: Egocentric Human Video Can Outperform Real-Robot Data for Embodied Pretraining
paper.abstract: Embodied foundation models are expected to benefit from data scaling like large language models, but face a much tighter data bottleneck. Teleoperated real-robot trajectories remain the dominant pretraining source due to their precise action supervision and embodiment alignment, yet their scalability is limited by high collection cost, acquisition difficulty, and low behavioral and environmental diversity. These limitations have sparked interest in egocentric human video as a scalable, substanti

summary.core_problem: 具身基础模型预训练面临严重数据瓶颈：主流的遥操作真实机器人数据成本高、难扩展、场景/行为多样性不足；第一人称人类视频虽规模大、成本低、多样性强，但作为预训练数据源，与遥操作机器人数据的效果对比缺乏受控的同规模定量验证。
summary.importance: 对具身多模态预训练的数据源选择、数据配比与scaling策略有直接指导价值：验证了预训练阶段「大规模、高多样性、弱标注但具身对齐不精确的数据」优于「小范围、低多样性、精确对齐的强标注数据」，这一结论与LLM预训练中大规模网页语料的价值逻辑一致，可迁移至跨模态统一预训练的数据 mixture 设计中。
summary.technical_approach: 开展严格控制变量的同规模对比实验：1）从HumanNet的第一人称子集中筛选5000小时数据（覆盖多样物体、技能、环境），通过人手重定向技术生成伪动作标签；2）构建同规模的多具身真实机器人遥操作数据集；3）使用完全相同的自回归世界动作模型（WAM，基于混合Transformer MoT架构，预测未来视频观测和后续动作）分别在两个数据集上预训练；4）预训练完成后，两个模型用完全相同的真实机器人数据集做后训练，在「已见任务（后训练数据的留存轨迹）」和「未见任务（后训练未使用的新任务）」两个拆分上评估，控制模型架构、数据规模、后训练数据、评估协议全部不变，唯一变量为预训练数据源。
summary.experiments: 三个核心定量结果：1）第一人称预训练呈现稳定scaling行为：数据量从数百小时增加到数千小时，下游验证损失单调下降，新增数据持续提供有效预训练信号；2）同规模下，第一人称预训练的下游性能优于机器人数据预训练，在未见任务上的提升幅度最大；3）真实机器人部署测试中，第一人称预训练的策略在未见物体的分布偏移下保持高成功率，无预训练基线性能接近崩溃。具体指标：分布外（OOD）任务成功率，第一人称预训练约92.5%，同规模机器人数据预训练约90%，无预训练基线约0%；分布内任务两者性能接近；第一人称预训练的OOD性能随数据量增加持续提升，机器人数据预训练更早进入饱和。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看论文引言中控制变量匹配对比的实验设计逻辑、数据源属性对比章节的两类数据差异分析、实验章节的scaling与分布外结果；泛读约15分钟，可跳过具体机器人平台的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Embodied foundation model pretraining faces a severe data bottleneck: the dominant teleoperated real-robot data is high-cost, hard to scale, and limited in behavior/environment diversity. Egocentric human video offers massive scale, low cost, and strong diversity as an alternative, but its effectiveness as a pretraining source has not been validated via controlled, matched-scale quantitative comparisons against teleoperated robot data.
summary_en.importance: It provides direct guidance for data source selection, data mixture design, and scaling strategies in embodied multimodal pretraining. It validates that large-scale, high-diversity, weakly labeled data with imperfect embodiment alignment outperforms small-scale, low-diversity, precisely aligned strongly labeled data in the pretraining stage — a conclusion consistent with the value of large-scale web corpora in LLM pretraining, and transferable to data mixture design for unified cross-modal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A strictly controlled, matched-scale comparison is conducted: 1) a 5,000-hour egocentric subset is curated from HumanNet (covering diverse objects, skills, environments), with pseudo action labels generated via human hand retargeting; 2) a same-scale multi-embodiment teleoperated real-robot dataset is constructed; 3) the identical autoregressive World Action Model (WAM, built on Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture, predicting future video observations and subsequent actions) is pretrained on each dataset separately; 4) after pretraining, both models are post-trained on the same real-robot dataset, and evaluated on two splits: Seen (held-out trajectories from post-training tasks) and Unseen (held-out tasks not used in post-training). All variables (model architecture, data scale, post-training data, evaluation protocol) are fixed, with the pretraining data source as the only varying factor.
summary_en.experiments: Three core quantitative findings: 1) Egocentric pretraining shows stable scaling behavior: as data volume grows from hundreds to thousands of hours, downstream validation loss decreases monotonically, with additional data continuing to deliver useful pretraining signal. 2) At matched scale, egocentric pretraining outperforms robot data pretraining on downstream tasks, with the largest gains observed on Unseen tasks. 3) In real-robot rollout tests, egocentric-pretrained policies maintain high success rates under distribution shift from unseen objects, while the no-pretraining baseline nearly collapses. Concrete metrics: Out-of-distribution (OOD) task success rate is ~92.5% for egocentric pretraining, ~90% for same-scale robot pretraining, and ~0% for the no-pretraining baseline; in-distribution performance is comparable between the two pretraining setups. OOD performance of egocentric pretraining improves continuously with data scale, while robot pretraining saturates much earlier.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the controlled variable matching experimental design in the paper’s introduction, attribute comparison between the two data sources in the dataset section, and scaling plus OOD results in the experiment section. Skim time: ~15 minutes, skip implementation details of specific robot platforms.

recommendation.zh: 具身预训练数据来源的关键对照，核心价值看第4节数据处理管线和第5节控制变量实验即可。
recommendation.en: Key controlled comparison on embodied pretraining data sources; focus on §4 data pipeline and §5 controlled ablations.

paper.title: RegMix-D: Dynamic Data Mixing via Proxy Training Trajectories
paper.abstract: Data mixture selection is critical for Large Language Model pretraining. Existing methods such as RegMix select a single static mixture by fitting a regression model on small-scale proxy runs. We propose RegMix-D, a simple extension of RegMix to dynamic mixing. Our key observation is that proxy runs produce not only endpoint losses, but also full loss trajectories, which can be used to further improve data mixture. By training regression model on these trajectories, we can predict optimal mixtur

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是预训练数据配比里的一个老问题：不同语料域的最优 mixture 并不是整个训练过程都不变，但现有像 RegMix 这样的做法只用 proxy run 的终点 loss 去选一个静态配比，等于默认“全程一个最优解”。作者要做的是在不引入复杂额外训练机制的前提下，把 proxy 训练轨迹里的时序信息利用起来，得到随训练阶段变化的动态 data mixture schedule。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义比较直接，而且量级不小。数据混合比例本来就是 pretrain recipe 里影响很大的自由度，但过去自动化方法大多停留在 static mixture。RegMix-D 的贡献在于证明：只要把 proxy run 从“一个终点样本”改成“多段轨迹样本”，就能在几乎不改变 RegMix 框架的情况下，把静态 mixture 搜索扩展成动态调度，而且还能降低 proxy compute 需求。它不是提出新的优化目标，也不是靠额外 teacher/reference model 做复杂控制，而是把已有 proxy 预算里的信息榨得更干净。这对大规模预训练很有现实意义，因为它同时碰到了两个核心点：data curriculum 和 proxy-based recipe search。
summary.technical_approach:
方法很简洁，关键是把回归目标从“mixture -> 最终 loss”改成“当前训练状态 -> 下一阶段 loss”。RegMix 原始做法是：采样若干 mixture，训练若干小 proxy 模型到固定步数，只记录终点验证损失，再拟合一个回归器预测某个 mixture 的终点 loss，最后选一个全程固定的 mixture。RegMix-D 则在 proxy 训练中按多个时间点记录 validation loss，把每条 proxy trajectory 切成若干相邻区间。对于给定的 switch point 数 N，会选出 N+1 个时间节点 t1...tN+1，并从每条轨迹构造 M×N 个训练样本。回归器 f_N 的输入是当前步点 t_l、当前 mixture m、当前 observed loss l_l，输出是下一时间点的 loss l_{l+1}。也就是说，它学的是局部转移，而不是全局终点映射。

在部署上有两个版本。Offline 版本在目标训练开始前递归生成完整 schedule：从初始 loss 出发，在每个 switch point 上搜索使预测下一段 loss 最低的 mixture，把预测出的 loss 再喂给下一段，直到生成整条 mixture schedule。这个版本不需要 target run 中途干预，但误差会递归累积。Online 版本则在 target training 的每个 switch point 上，用目标模型真实观测到的 validation loss 替代预测 loss，再调用同一个冻结回归器选择下一段 mixture。这样做的好处是把 proxy-to-target 的偏差限制在单段决策里，而不是沿整条 schedule 传播。

方法上的几个细节值得注意。第一，作者没有引入额外 RL、bandit 或 bilevel optimization 机制，仍然是回归 + candidate search，所以工程接入成本低。第二，初始阶段固定使用 human-curated Pile prior，而不是从第一个 segment 就让回归器自由选 mixture，这反映了一个现实假设：训练初期没有足够 target-state 信息，先验配比更稳。第三，mixture 搜索仍然通过 Dirichlet-sampled candidates 完成，说明作者追求的是在现有 RegMix 搜索框架内最小改动地升级为 dynamic mixing，而不是重新设计连续优化器。
summary.experiments:
实验设置沿用 RegMix 标准配置：在 Pile 上做 25B tokens 训练，目标模型为 1B 参数。论文的核心比较对象是静态 RegMix 与动态 RegMix-D，在不同 switch granularity 下比较 offline 和 online 两种部署。主结论有三条。第一，RegMix-D 在所有测试粒度上都优于 RegMix，既体现在 validation loss，也体现在 13 个下游任务的平均表现。第二，online 版本通常比 offline 更稳，因为它用真实 target loss 校正状态，避免递归预测误差累积；offline 仍然有效，但更依赖回归器外推质量。第三，数据效率明显提升：只用 128 个 proxy models，也就是 RegMix 512 个 proxy 配置约 25% 的预算，就已经能超过后者。这一点很关键，因为 proxy-based mixture search 真正的瓶颈往往不是方法本身，而是前期试验成本。

从摘要和正文可见信息看，作者强调的是“一致优于”而不是某个单点大幅提升。更值得注意的是消融逻辑：性能提升来自轨迹监督带来的更好状态建模，而不是单纯因为用了更多 proxy 标签；因为同一条 proxy run 的中间 loss 被重复利用，单位 proxy compute 产出的监督信号更多。另一个重要观察是，动态 mixture 的收益在训练不同阶段并不均匀，这间接支持了作者的出发点：域最优配比确实会随训练进展变化，静态 mixture 只能做折中。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇建议精读。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，把问题框成“static mixture selection 不够，因为最优域配比会漂移”。然后重点读 RegMix-D 方法部分，尤其是训练样本构造、f_N 的输入输出定义、offline 递归生成 schedule 的过程，以及 online 如何用真实 loss 做状态校正。这里真正的创新不在模型形式，而在问题重写：把 mixture search 从一次性全局选择改成局部状态转移预测。实验部分优先看三类结果：一是 validation loss 曲线，确认动态调度是否稳定优于静态；二是 13 个下游任务总表，判断收益是否泛化；三是 proxy 数量消融，理解它为什么能用更少 proxy 超过 RegMix。若时间有限，先抓住 offline vs online 的差别，再看不同 switch point 数 N 的敏感性。值得深挖的点有四个：其一，回归器是否真正学到了“阶段性域需求”，还是只是在拟合 loss 平滑趋势；其二，switch granularity 过细时是否会引入 schedule 抖动；其三，proxy-to-target 缩放在更大模型、更长训练上是否仍成立；其四，初始使用 human prior 的设计是否可以被更系统的 cold-start 策略替代。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central weakness in proxy-based data-mixture optimization for LLM pretraining: the best domain mixture is unlikely to stay constant throughout training, yet methods such as RegMix assume a single static optimum and fit regressors only on endpoint losses from proxy runs. RegMix-D turns the problem into dynamic mixture scheduling by exploiting the full loss trajectories already produced by those proxy runs.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining practice. Data mixture is one of the highest-leverage recipe choices, but most automated methods still search for one fixed mixture. RegMix-D shows that a dynamic schedule can be obtained with minimal changes to the existing RegMix pipeline, simply by using trajectory supervision instead of endpoint-only supervision. The practical significance is twofold: it improves target-model performance and reduces the amount of proxy compute needed to beat the static baseline. That makes it a meaningful contribution to data curriculum design and proxy-based recipe search.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key move is to replace a global regression target with a local transition model. In standard RegMix, each sampled mixture is used to train one proxy model to a fixed horizon, only the final validation loss is kept, and a regressor maps mixture to endpoint loss. The chosen mixture is then used for the entire target run. RegMix-D logs validation loss at multiple points along each proxy trajectory. For a chosen number of switch points N, it selects N+1 time anchors and converts each proxy trajectory into M×N training examples. The regressor f_N takes the current state (training step t_l, current mixture m, current loss l_l) and predicts the next loss l_{l+1}. In other words, it learns one-step loss transitions rather than a direct mixture-to-final-loss map.

This enables two deployment modes. In the offline mode, the schedule is generated before target training: starting from an initial loss, the method searches over candidate mixtures at each switch point, picks the one with the lowest predicted next-step loss, feeds that predicted loss into the next decision, and recursively builds a full schedule. In the online mode, the same frozen regressor is queried during target training, but the current loss is the actually observed target-model validation loss rather than the previously predicted one. This grounds each decision in the real target trajectory and limits error accumulation.

Several design choices are worth noting. The method does not introduce RL, bandits, or bilevel optimization; it stays within the regression-plus-search framework, which keeps the engineering overhead low. The first segment uses the human-curated Pile prior instead of a learned mixture, reflecting a cold-start assumption that early in training there is not enough target-state information to trust dynamic adaptation. Candidate mixtures are still searched via Dirichlet sampling, so the contribution is a minimal but effective extension of RegMix rather than a full redesign of the optimizer.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments follow the standard RegMix setup: a 1B-parameter target model trained on 25B tokens from the Pile. The main comparisons are static RegMix versus RegMix-D, with both offline and online variants evaluated under different switching granularities. The headline findings are consistent. First, RegMix-D outperforms RegMix at every tested granularity, both in validation loss and across 13 downstream tasks. Second, the online variant is generally more reliable than the offline one because it uses observed target losses to correct the state, whereas the offline schedule can accumulate recursive prediction error. Third, the method is notably more proxy-efficient: 128 proxy models, about 25% of the 512-proxy budget used by RegMix, are already enough to surpass the static baseline.

The important experimental point is not one unusually large gain, but the consistency of the improvement. The ablation logic also matters: the benefit comes from extracting more supervision from the same proxy runs, not from adding a new expensive optimization loop. By reusing intermediate losses, each proxy run yields many local transition labels. Another useful observation is that the gains from dynamic mixing are not uniform across training, which supports the paper’s premise that the preferred domain composition shifts over time and cannot be captured well by a single static mixture.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one deserves a close read. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to frame the problem correctly: static mixture selection is limited because the optimal domain composition drifts during training. Then focus on the RegMix-D section, especially how trajectory samples are constructed, what f_N predicts, how the offline recursive schedule is generated, and how the online variant replaces predicted losses with observed target losses. The main innovation is not a sophisticated model class; it is the reformulation of mixture search as local state-transition prediction. In the experiments, prioritize three pieces: validation-loss comparisons, the 13-task downstream table, and the proxy-budget ablation. If time is limited, first understand the offline-versus-online trade-off, then look at sensitivity to the number of switch points N. The deeper questions are whether the regressor is truly learning stage-dependent domain demand rather than just smoothing loss trends, whether very fine switching causes schedule instability, whether proxy-to-target transfer still holds at larger scales, and whether the human-prior cold start can be replaced by a more principled initialization strategy.

recommendation.zh: 应在内部 data-mixture ablation 里复现；重点看 trajectory 信号是否真能跨尺度迁移。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing in internal data-mixture ablations; the key question is whether trajectory signals transfer cleanly across scale.

paper.title: BLADE: Scalable Bi-level Adaptive Data Selection for LLM Training
paper.abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) datasets scale to trillions of tokens, data selection has emerged as a critical frontier to filter out uninformative noise and construct adaptive learning trajectories. Beyond static heuristic filtering, advanced data selection methods for LLM training largely follow two paradigms, each with fundamental limitations. Influence-based methods provide principled bi-level objectives but require intractable inverse-Hessian computations, while excess-loss methods are compu

summary.core_problem: BLADE 解决的是 LLM 预训练中的在线数据选择问题：如何在不计算 inverse-Hessian 的情况下，保留 bi-level data selection 的验证集目标，同时避免 excess-loss 方法中固定 reference model 信号过期的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练数据研究的启发在于，它把两类常见路线接了起来：influence-based 方法有清晰的双层优化目标，但在大模型上难以承受；excess-loss 方法便宜，但 reference model 通常静态，训练中后期会和当前模型状态错位。BLADE 的价值不是提出一个新的清洗启发式，而是给在线、模型感知的数据选择提供了一个更可扩展的优化解释。对真实预训练更有意义的点是动态 reference：选择信号随 proxy model 更新，而不是用训练前固定模型长期打分。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从标准 bi-level formulation 出发：外层选择 token 子集以降低 validation loss，内层是在被选择数据上训练模型。选择变量用连续松弛的 alpha 表示，约束为保留比例 gamma，但算法更新会落到离散 extreme points，因此仍对应实际 token 选择。传统 influence 方法需要对内层最优解求导，带来 inverse-Hessian 项。BLADE 改为把内层最优性条件作为约束，并通过 Lagrange multiplier 转成带惩罚项的单层目标，从而只需要一阶信息。这个推导给出了一个 excess-loss 风格的打分准则：比较 proxy model 与 reference model 在样本上的损失差异。关键区别是 reference model 不是预先训练好后冻结，而是在训练过程中和 proxy model 动态同步，并纳入 validation 信息。在线选择部分用 memoryless randomized block-coordinate Frank-Wolfe，每次只在局部 block 上更新选择，降低内存和计算压力。
summary.experiments: 提供材料显示，实验覆盖多种 LLM 训练场景，并与 influence-based、excess-loss 和常规数据选择基线比较；结论是 BLADE 能更快降低训练/验证损失，并在下游评测上优于静态 reference 的 excess-loss 方法。文中还声称给出一阶收敛保证。当前提供内容没有包含具体模型规模、token 数、保留比例、训练步数和性能提升数字，因此不宜补写定量结论。实验部分最值得关注的是动态 reference 是否在训练后期仍能提供稳定增益，以及 Frank-Wolfe block 选择是否真正降低了大规模 token-level selection 的额外开销。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读方法推导和算法部分，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 bi-level objective 如何转成 penalized single-level objective，以及 excess-loss criterion 是怎样从该目标中导出的。Algorithm 1 和 Figure 1 应该是理解工程流程的核心。实验部分优先看三类消融：固定 reference 与动态 reference 的差异、token-level selection 的保留比例敏感性、block-coordinate Frank-Wolfe 的计算开销。若关心真实预训练可用性，需要重点检查 proxy/reference 同步频率、validation set 构造，以及选择策略对数据多样性的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: BLADE targets online data selection for LLM training: how to keep the validation-driven bi-level objective of influence methods without inverse-Hessian computation, while avoiding the stale-reference problem in excess-loss selection.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution is the optimization bridge between two existing families. Influence-based selection has a principled validation objective but is difficult to scale. Excess-loss selection is cheap but usually depends on a frozen reference model whose signal drifts away as the proxy model changes. BLADE is more relevant to pretraining than another heuristic filter because it offers a scalable way to make model-aware selection adaptive during training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method starts with a bi-level formulation where the outer problem chooses tokens to minimize validation loss and the inner problem trains the model on the selected data. Selection is represented by a relaxed vector alpha under a keep-ratio constraint, while the optimization procedure maps naturally to discrete extreme points. Instead of differentiating through the inner optimum and estimating inverse-Hessian terms, BLADE introduces the inner optimality condition as a constraint and moves it into a penalized single-level objective through Lagrange multipliers. This yields a first-order, Hessian-free update and leads to an excess-loss-like scoring rule based on the discrepancy between a proxy model and a reference model. The important design choice is that the reference model is dynamically synchronized with the proxy and incorporates validation information, rather than being trained once and frozen. For online batch selection, the paper instantiates the method with a memoryless randomized block-coordinate Frank-Wolfe algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content states that experiments span multiple LLM training settings and show faster convergence and better results than influence-style, excess-loss-style, and standard selection baselines. It also reports first-order convergence guarantees. Exact model sizes, token budgets, keep ratios, training steps, and numerical gains are not present in the supplied text, so the reliable takeaway is qualitative: the reported gains come from adaptive reference synchronization and scalable block-wise selection, not from an offline data-quality heuristic.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should focus on the derivation and the algorithm, about 20–30 minutes. Read the transition from the bi-level objective to the penalized single-level objective, then check how the excess-loss score is derived. Figure 1 and Algorithm 1 are likely the fastest path to the workflow. In the experiments, prioritize ablations on dynamic versus frozen reference models, keep-ratio sensitivity, and the overhead of block-coordinate Frank-Wolfe. For pretraining use, inspect how the validation set is chosen and how often the proxy and reference models are synchronized.

recommendation.zh: 预训练数据筛选的核心方法创新，重点读§3的双层优化重构推导与两类范式的理论关联部分，可直接用于内部数据管线ablation。
recommendation.en: Core methodological innovation for pretraining data filtering; focus on §3 for the bi-level optimization reformulation and paradigm unification, directly applicable to internal data pipeline ablations.

paper.title: Dango: A Strictly L1-Only Large Language Model for Studying Second Language Acquisition
paper.abstract: We introduce Dango, a 1.8B-parameter large language model designed for controlled studies of L1-to-L2 (Japanese-to-English) transfer in second language acquisition (SLA). While previous studies have explored SLA in language models, they have predominantly relied on smaller or non-decoder models, limiting their ability to generate open-ended text and reducing their suitability as practical L2 simulators. We identify a key challenge when scaling models to this size: L2 contamination within the "mo

summary.core_problem: 构建一个严格日语 L1-only 的 1.8B LLM，用于研究从日语到英语的二语习得迁移，同时控制预训练语料中的英语污染。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是预训练数据控制和语言习得模拟。对基座研究的价值不在 SLA 应用本身，而在于它把“单语预训练语料是否真的单语”这个污染问题放到 1.8B decoder-only 模型上做了可控实验。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Dango，先用过滤方法降低日语单语预训练语料中的英语暴露，同时保留现实中不可避免的少量接触；随后用 LLM 生成的英语学习课程进行微调，模拟 L2 acquisition 过程。方法重点是语料污染控制和分阶段语言暴露。
summary.experiments: 模型规模为 1.8B 参数。论文比较过滤版 Dango、未过滤版本和标准多语言 baseline，评估其英语生成中的二语学习模式。摘要称 Dango 产生更接近人类 L2 的输出模式，并优于未过滤和常规多语言基线；同时释放模型、数据和代码。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a strictly Japanese L1-only 1.8B LLM to study Japanese-to-English second-language acquisition while controlling English contamination in pretraining data.
summary_en.importance: The relevant contribution for foundation-model researchers is data control, not SLA as an application. It highlights that supposedly monolingual corpora can contain enough L2 contamination to confound controlled pretraining studies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dango is pretrained on a filtered Japanese corpus designed to reduce premature English exposure while preserving a small amount of realistic exposure. The model is then fine-tuned on LLM-generated L2 learning lessons to simulate the acquisition process.
summary_en.experiments: The model has 1.8B parameters. The paper compares the filtered model with an unfiltered variant and standard multilingual baselines, reporting more human-like L2 production patterns and better results than the baselines. The model, data, and code are released.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫过滤规则和污染测量；SLA 结论偏窄，但语料“单语性”控制是预训练实验常见暗坑。
recommendation.en: Skim the filtering rules and contamination measurement; the SLA claim is narrow, but corpus monolinguality is a common hidden confound in pretraining studies.

paper.title: The Stanford EDGAR Filings Dataset: Reconstructing U.S. Corporate and Financial Disclosures into Layout-Faithful and Token-Efficient Pretraining Data
paper.abstract: As high-quality public web corpora become increasingly exhausted, clean long-context documents have become a scarce and expensive source of training data for large language models (LLMs). Existing long-context corpora are often proprietary and costly to acquire, synthetically generated, or concentrated in narrow domains such as programming. We introduce the Stanford EDGAR Filings Dataset (SEFD), an open reconstruction of SEC filings into layout-faithful MultiMarkdown for financial language model

summary.core_problem: 随着通用网页语料被逐步耗尽，高质量公开长上下文预训练语料日益稀缺。现有公开长文档语料多集中在代码等窄领域、为合成生成、或质量难以控制；SEC EDGAR作为全球最大的公开事实性长文档库，其原始文件是为浏览器视觉渲染设计的HTML，包含大量展示用脚手架代码，普遍存在结构破碎、语义元素分离的问题。此前的EDGAR文本提取方法要么丢失承载核心语义的布局信息（表格层级、缩进结构、数值与符号的绑定），要么token效率极低，无法直接用作高质量预训练语料。同时现有长文档/金融推理评测集普遍存在训练语料污染问题，缺少能可靠测试长上下文推理能力的干净基准。
summary.importance: SEFD是目前规模最大的公开低污染、布局保真长文档语料之一，首期公开快照达152B token，全量规模约550B token，与CommonCrawl来源语料重叠率低于0.1%，可作为通用预训练语料配方中高价值长文档部分的重要补充。其提出的“视觉优先”结构化解析思路，突破了传统DOM树线性文本提取的局限，在实现百倍级token压缩的同时完整保留布局承载的语义，这套方法可迁移到科研论文、专利、政府公告等其他结构化长文档源的加工流程中。配套的两个防污染评测基准采用时间切分和实体合成设计，避免了记忆带来的评测失真，为长文档推理、结构化信息提取能力的评估提供了可靠工具。
summary.technical_approach: SEFD的构建管线包含四个核心模块：第一，全量归档路由：覆盖1994年至今的1850万份SEC申报文件，基于文件头部SGML元数据完成类型分流，对应33种专用XML结构和350+细分申报类型（年报、季报、重大事件公告、内部人持股报告、机构持仓报告等）。第二，视觉优先解析：摒弃传统的线性DOM文本提取逻辑，将渲染后的文档映射为2D坐标网格，基于文本块的空间位置重建语义关联，还原缩进层级，拼接被HTML标记拆分的连续文本段。第三，结构专项修复：重点重建表格结构，识别跨列/跨行的合并单元格，将货币符号、正负号、百分号重新绑定到对应的数值上，消除纯文本提取中常见的标签-数值错位、表头重复、会计符号错误等问题。第四，token高效序列化：采用轻量MultiMarkdown格式编码内容，用简单标记表示表格的跨列、跨行结构，移除所有仅用于视觉渲染的HTML脚手架代码。管线同时包含规则质量校验、文档去重、跨语料重叠检测环节。配套评测设计上，EDGAR-Forecast采用严格时间切分：仅提供模型知识截止日之前5年的申报文件，要求预测截止日后发布的2026年财报数值，从根源杜绝记忆；EDGAR-OCR通过对真实表格做实体、数值、日期的替换合成，保留原有布局和算术校验关系，避免测试集泄漏到训练语料中。
summary.experiments: 语料规模统计显示，全量SEFD约550B token，首期公开的SEFD-v1覆盖2022年1月至2025年6月的申报文件，共152B token。质量评估显示，规则解析管线的结构和语义准确率超过99%，平均每100页仅出现1处影响理解的错误；与C4等CommonCrawl衍生语料的重叠率低于0.1%，语料独特性高。token效率方面，相对原始HTML文件实现超过99%的token压缩（百倍压缩比）——原始文件中绝大多数内容是企业披露管理平台生成的展示性标记，不承载实际语义。基准测试结果：EDGAR-Forecast上，参测的最强模型在覆盖50家公司的250道题上准确率为51.8%，任务难度较高，未出现因记忆导致的虚高分；EDGAR-OCR上，参测的Qwen3.6-35B-A3B取得最高75.78%的准确率，反映结构化表格理解任务仍有明显提升空间。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注数据集构建章节中的视觉优先解析管线、表格结构重建、MultiMarkdown序列化部分，这部分的方法论对所有结构化长文档的语料加工都有通用参考价值，不局限于金融领域。其次关注语料质量验证和重叠率分析部分，理解这类高价值结构化语料相对于通用网页语料的互补性。配套评测部分可快速浏览，重点掌握其防污染的设计思路即可，若不从事金融或长文档方向评测无需深入细节。核心内容预计阅读时间30分钟。值得深挖的方向包括：这类高信息密度长文档在通用预训练数据配比中的最优占比，布局语义保留对下游长文档推理能力的量化增益，视觉优先解析方法向arXiv论文、专利、法律文书等其他结构化文档源的迁移。

summary_en.core_problem: High-quality public long-context pretraining data is growing scarce as general web corpora are fully exploited. Existing public long-document datasets are typically narrow-domain (e.g., code), synthetic, or inconsistent in quality. The SEC EDGAR archive, one of the world's largest public repositories of factual long-form business documents, stores filings as render-optimized HTML dominated by presentation scaffolding, with fragmented semantic elements and broken structural cues. Prior EDGAR text extraction methods either discard layout-critical semantics (table hierarchies, indentation structure, symbol-value binding) or produce extremely token-inefficient output, making the archive unusable as high-quality pretraining data. Existing long-document and financial reasoning benchmarks also suffer from widespread training set contamination, lacking reliable measures of out-of-distribution long-context reasoning.
summary_en.importance: SEFD is one of the largest public, low-contamination, layout-faithful long-document corpora available, with a 152B token initial public release and 550B token full corpus, and <0.1% overlap with CommonCrawl-derived corpora, making it a strong candidate for the high-value long-document component of general pretraining mixtures. Its visual-first parsing pipeline moves beyond naive linear DOM extraction to preserve layout semantics while achieving 100x token compression relative to raw source files; this approach generalizes to processing other structured long documents including scientific papers, patents, and government filings. The two accompanying contamination-resistant benchmarks use time-split and synthetic design to avoid score inflation from memorization, providing more reliable evaluation for long-document reasoning and structured information extraction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The SEFD pipeline processes 18.5 million SEC filings dating to 1994. First, filings are routed via SGML header metadata to type-specific parsers covering 33 XML schemas and over 350 filing variants (annual reports, quarterly reports, event disclosures, insider trading reports, institutional holdings, etc.). Instead of linear DOM extraction, the parser uses a visual-first design that maps rendered documents to a 2D coordinate grid, reconstructing spatial relationships between text spans to recover indentation hierarchies and join text fragments separated by presentational markup. A dedicated table reconstruction module resolves merged cells, reattaches currency/percent/negative signs to associated numeric values, and fixes common extraction errors including misaligned labels, duplicated headers, and sign mismatches. Parsed content is serialized to lightweight MultiMarkdown, which uses simple syntax to represent table spans while removing all render-only HTML scaffolding. The pipeline includes rule-based quality checks, deduplication, and cross-corpus contamination measurement. Two benchmarks are released alongside the corpus: EDGAR-Forecast uses strict time splits, requiring models to predict values in post-knowledge-cutoff 2026 filings using only pre-cutoff documents to eliminate memorization; EDGAR-OCR uses synthetically modified real tables, with entities, dates, and values replaced while preserving layout and arithmetic consistency, to prevent training set leakage.
summary_en.experiments: The full SEFD corpus contains an estimated 550B tokens; the initial public SEFD-v1 release covers January 2022 to June 2025 filings, totaling 152B tokens. Quality evaluation shows the parser achieves >99% structural and semantic accuracy, with roughly one understanding-breaking error per 100 pages. Overlap with CommonCrawl-derived corpora such as C4 is <0.1%, indicating high complementarity to existing web data. Token compression relative to raw HTML exceeds 99% (100:1 ratio), as raw filings consist mostly of non-semantic presentation markup generated by enterprise disclosure platforms. On EDGAR-Forecast, the strongest tested model achieves 51.8% accuracy across 250 questions covering 50 companies, indicating high task difficulty with minimal memorization effects. On EDGAR-OCR, the top-performing tested model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) achieves 75.78% accuracy, demonstrating remaining headroom for structured table understanding.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the visual-first parsing pipeline, table reconstruction, and MultiMarkdown serialization sections, as these contain generalizable methodology for structured long-document processing applicable well beyond financial use cases. The quality validation and contamination analysis sections are useful for understanding the corpus's complementarity to existing web-scale datasets. The benchmark descriptions can be skimmed to grasp their anti-contamination design, unless working specifically on financial or long-document evaluation. Expected reading time for core content is 30 minutes. Promising follow-up directions include measuring the optimal mixture ratio of this high-density structured data in general pretraining, quantifying performance gains from preserved layout semantics on downstream long-context tasks, and extending the visual parsing pipeline to other structured document sources such as arXiv papers and government records.

recommendation.zh: 应把 SEFD 当作长文档数据 ablation 的候选源，重点检查 token efficiency、去重和版式转换对 loss 的影响。
recommendation.en: Treat SEFD as a candidate source for long-document data ablations; inspect token efficiency, deduplication, and the loss impact of layout conversion.

paper.title: FastMix: Fast Data Mixture Optimization via Gradient Descent
paper.abstract: While large and diverse datasets have driven recent advances in large models, identifying the optimal data mixture for pre-training and post-training remains a significant open problem. We address this challenge with FASTMIX, a novel framework that automates data mixture discovery while training only a single proxy model. Instead of relying on predefined heuristics or resource-intensive simulations, FASTMIX jointly optimizes mixture coefficients and model parameters, substantially improving effi

summary.core_problem: 预训练与后训练的数据 mixture 配比通常依赖启发式或多次重训搜索，成本极高，需要在单次代理模型训练内高效优化。
summary.importance: 把 data mixture 搜索明确写成双层优化，并推导出'按源均匀采样等价于按 mixture 系数做 per-source loss 重加权'的等价性，把 mixture 搜索变成端到端可微问题；是 data mixture 自动化方向的重要进展。
summary.technical_approach: FastMix 将 mixture 选择表述为 bilevel optimization；推导得到优化 mixture ratio 等价于在 uniform source sampling 下对每个 source 的 loss 赋权，从而可以在训练一个 proxy model 的过程中，用梯度同时更新模型参数和 mixture 系数，避免了多模型多次重跑。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验细节与具体模型/数据规模，但宣称显著优于依赖预定义启发式和多仿真的已有 mixture 搜索方法，在效率与可扩展性上提升明显。

summary_en.core_problem: Finding the optimal data mixture for pre-training and post-training is usually done by heuristics or costly repeated training runs.
summary_en.importance: Reformulates data mixture search as a bilevel optimization problem and shows an equivalence between optimizing mixture ratios and assigning per-source loss weights under uniform source sampling, turning mixture search into an end-to-end differentiable problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: FastMix jointly optimizes mixture coefficients and model parameters in a single proxy run: mixture ratios are embedded into a differentiable training objective via the derived reweighting equivalence, enabling gradient-based mixture updates without repeated full runs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims substantial efficiency and scalability gains over heuristic-based and simulation-heavy prior mixture optimization methods; full model and dataset details are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把 mixture search 从黑盒扫参变成可微双层优化，直接对应 data ratio 调参的真实痛点；应在内部小规模 proxy 上复现这个 reweighting 等价关系。
recommendation.en: Turns data-mixture search from black-box sweeps into differentiable bilevel optimization; worth reproducing the reweighting equivalence on an internal proxy setup.

paper.title: Data Augmentations for Data-Constrained Language Model Pretraining
paper.abstract: As AI labs approach a data ceiling where compute capacity outpaces the rate of new high-quality text generation, language model pretraining is shifting toward a data-constrained, compute-abundant regime that demands productive multi-epoch training on fixed corpora. Standard autoregressive (AR) pretraining overfits severely in this setting, reaching its optimum early and then continuously deteriorating. We investigate data augmentation as a regularizer to mitigate this overfitting and enable prod

summary.core_problem: 在数据受限、算力充裕的新预训练 regime 下，标准 AR 预训练在同一语料多 epoch 训练时严重过拟合，验证损失先升后降，无法有效利用剩余算力。
summary.importance: 范式创新：系统提出三类 AR 预训练数据增强（token 噪声、序列排列、目标偏移预测）用于延迟多 epoch 过拟合，是数据受限预训练 regime 下的首次系统化研究。
summary.technical_approach: 三类正交增强：(1) token 级噪声（masking、随机替换）；(2) 序列排列（右到左预测、Fill-in-the-Middle）；(3) 目标偏移预测（预测 x_{t+i}, i>1）。通过随机替换等方式在不改变数据量的前提下增加训练信号多样性。
summary.experiments: 在固定语料上进行数百 epoch 训练的系统 ablation；单个增强均延迟过拟合并降低验证损失；随机 token 替换取得最优最低验证损失；但未提供具体模型规模、基线对比数值或 SOTA 结论（摘要中未详述）。

summary_en.core_problem: In the data-constrained, compute-abundant pretraining regime, standard AR pretraining severely overfits under multi-epoch training on fixed corpora, reaching optimum early and then deteriorating, failing to utilize remaining compute.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation: first systematic investigation of data augmentation as a regularizer for AR pretraining under multi-epoch training, proposing three orthogonal augmentation categories to delay overfitting.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three orthogonal augmentation categories for AR pretraining: (1) token-level noise (masking, random replacement); (2) sequence permutations (right-to-left prediction, Fill-in-the-Middle); (3) target offset prediction (predict x_{t+i} for i>1). Increases training signal diversity without changing data volume.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic ablations across hundreds of epochs on fixed corpora; individual augmentations delay overfitting and lower validation loss; random token replacement achieves the best minimum validation loss; specific model sizes, baseline numerical comparisons, or SOTA claims not detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 数据受限预训练 regime 是未来方向，三类增强策略可直接复现到内部 ablation；重点看 token 噪声 vs 序列排列的对比实验和最优配置。
recommendation.en: Data-constrained pretraining is a future direction; the three augmentation strategies can be directly reproduced in internal ablations; focus on the comparison between token noise vs. sequence permutations and the optimal configuration.

paper.title: The Culture Funnel: You Can't Align What isn't in the Data
paper.abstract: Current cultural alignment approaches focus on inference-time interventions, assuming models already contain sufficient cultural knowledge. We argue modern LLM pipelines suffer from a cultural data funnel. Using a multidimensional tagging framework across pretraining, fine-tuning, alignment, and reasoning datasets, we show explicit cultural signals decline sharply during post-training, while geographically concentrated, task-specialized data dominates. Multilinguality enhances geographic diversi

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究文化对齐失败是否来自训练数据管线，而不是只来自推理时提示或对齐方法。核心观点是：预训练语料中可能存在一定文化信号，但经过 SFT、偏好对齐、推理数据和任务化数据筛选后，显式文化信息会被压缩，形成所谓 culture funnel。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发比较明确。它把文化对齐从“模型有没有文化知识”转成“训练阶段是否给了模型足够、均衡、可学习的文化信号”。这对 data mixture、post-training 数据配比、合成推理数据污染都有意义。现在很多后训练数据强调数学、代码、推理和通用帮助性，容易把地域、生活方式、社会规范、价值偏好等信号稀释掉。多语数据可以增加地域覆盖，但不能自动保证文化覆盖均衡，这一点对 multilingual pretraining 和 instruction tuning 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 工作构建了一个自动文化标注管线，对 5.6M 条样本做多维标签。标签维度包括文化类型、领域、任务意图、地理位置和语言。文化标签采用面向 NLP 的 taxonomy，包含 Culture as Knowledge、Dynamics、Preference、Bias，并额外区分 General Culture 和 No Culture。语言识别使用 FastText LangID，其余标注主要使用 Command-A。预训练语料按整段文本标注；后训练和对话数据只标注用户侧 prompt 或 instruction，因为这些部分决定了模型是否有机会学习文化语境。数据选择覆盖预训练、后训练、评测和真实用户对话，包括 CulturaX、Dolci Instruct-SFT、GeoFact-X、CultureBank、MultiNRC、Aya 原创标注、PRISM 和 ShareLM 等。
summary.experiments: 实验结果显示，显式文化信号在训练管线后段明显下降，后训练数据更集中在少数地理区域和任务类型上。多语言数据提升了地理多样性，但语言不是文化的充分代理，仍会出现覆盖不均。工作还报告了一个实用结果：加入显式文化标签后，下游文化 benchmark 表现提升，说明文化标记不只是分析工具，也可以作为训练或数据筛选信号。需要注意的是，标注依赖自动模型，结论更适合作为大规模数据分布诊断，而不是对单条样本文化充分性的人工判定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。先看数据选择和 tagging taxonomy，确认它如何定义文化、地理位置、任务意图和语言。然后看各训练阶段的文化信号变化图表，这是主要结论来源。最后看文化标签用于下游 benchmark 的实验，判断这些标签是否能转化为训练收益。对做数据配比的人，重点不是具体 benchmark 分数，而是它提供了一种审计 post-training 数据的方式：检查指令数据、偏好数据和推理数据是否系统性稀释了文化语境。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks whether failures in cultural alignment are caused by the training data pipeline rather than only by inference-time prompting or alignment methods.
